picture.alt: A sunny campus: a girl and a boy sit side by side on a wooden bench laid along wide outdoor stone steps in front of a school building, with green trees behind them. The girl (left) has short wavy brown hair and round glasses, a white shirt under a purple vest, olive-green trousers and a backpack on her back; she is talking and looking at the boy, one open hand held out toward him. The boy (right) has black hair, an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers; he smiles at her, one hand behind him at his waist and the other resting on his knee. A black bag stands on the bench beside him. Nobody is holding hands.

lines.english: Yes. I don't want to go to the afternoon class; I want to rest a bit in the dorm.

lines.english: You don't know each other well yet; you'd better not go alone. I happen to be free that day; I can go with you.

lines.simplified: 那你们常常一起出去玩吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen chángcháng yìqǐ chūqù wán ma?

prompt.english: What does the man think of the new student?

lines.traditional: 雖然我很想去，可是那天是我爸爸的生日，晚上我們家要一起去餐廳吃飯。
lines.simplified: 虽然我很想去，可是那天是我爸爸的生日，晚上我们家要一起去餐厅吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ hěn xiǎng qù, kěshì nà tiān shì wǒ bàba de shēngrì, wǎnshàng wǒmen jiā yào yìqǐ qù cāntīng chīfàn.
lines.english: Although I really want to go, that day is my dad's birthday, and my family is going out to a restaurant together that evening.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們下次再一起去吧，我也想介紹我的朋友給妳認識。
lines.simplified: 那我们下次再一起去吧，我也想介绍我的朋友给你认识。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xià cì zài yìqǐ qù ba, wǒ yě xiǎng jièshào wǒ de péngyǒu gěi nǐ rènshì.
lines.english: Then let's go together next time. I'd like you to meet my friends too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的這個禮拜六晚上要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的这个礼拜六晚上要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zhège lǐbàiliù wǎnshàng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the woman do this Saturday evening?

choices.pinyin: Zuò zài pángbiān kàn rén tiàowǔ.
choices.english: Sit on the side and watch people dance.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 那天是我爸爸的生日，晚上我們家要一起去餐廳吃飯: her family has a birthday dinner for her father, so she is not at the dance at all. Meeting his friends is only for next time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你每天都騎腳踏車來上課，是想多運動嗎？
lines.simplified: 你每天都骑脚踏车来上课，是想多运动吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān dōu qí jiǎotàchē lái shàngkè, shì xiǎng duō yùndòng ma?
lines.english: You ride your bike to class every day. Is it to get more exercise?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是。雖然騎車有點危險，可是比坐公車快。
lines.simplified: 不是。虽然骑车有点危险，可是比坐公车快。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Suīrán qí chē yǒudiǎn wéixiǎn, kěshì bǐ zuò gōngchē kuài.
lines.english: No. Although riding is a bit dangerous, it's faster than taking the bus.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我也想騎，可是不太敢在大馬路上騎。
lines.simplified: 我也想骑，可是不太敢在大马路上骑。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng qí, kěshì bú tài gǎn zài dà mǎlù shàng qí.
lines.english: I want to ride too, but I don't really dare to ride on the big roads.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 學校後面那條路車很少，妳可以先在那裡練習。
lines.simplified: 学校后面那条路车很少，你可以先在那里练习。
lines.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn nà tiáo lù chē hěn shǎo, nǐ kěyǐ xiān zài nàlǐ liànxí.
lines.english: The road behind the school has very few cars. You could practise there first.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，那這個週末你教我吧！
lines.simplified: 好啊，那这个周末你教我吧！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà zhège zhōumò nǐ jiāo wǒ ba!
lines.english: Great, then teach me this weekend!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼騎腳踏車來上課？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么骑脚踏车来上课？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme qí jiǎotàchē lái shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why does the man ride a bike to class?

choices.english: There are few cars behind the school.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 不是。雖然騎車有點危險，可是比坐公車快: he rides because it is faster. He says no to exercise, it is not safer, and the quiet road is only where she could practise.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你今天怎麼戴口罩？感冒了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么戴口罩？感冒了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme dài kǒuzhào? Gǎnmào le ma?
lines.english: Why are you wearing a mask today? Did you catch a cold?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，從昨天晚上就開始咳嗽了。要是明天發燒，我就請假去看醫生。
lines.simplified: 对，从昨天晚上就开始咳嗽了。要是明天发烧，我就请假去看医生。
lines.pinyin: Duì, cóng zuótiān wǎnshàng jiù kāishǐ késòu le. Yàoshì míngtiān fāshāo, wǒ jiù qǐngjià qù kàn yīshēng.
lines.english: Yes, I started coughing last night. If I have a fever tomorrow, I'll take a day off and see a doctor.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài zěnmele?
prompt.english: What's wrong with the man now?

choices.english: He has taken a day off.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: She asks 感冒了嗎 and he says 對: he has a cold. The fever and the day off only happen 要是明天發燒, if he has a fever tomorrow.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 從這裡到火車站，搭公車比坐捷運快嗎？
lines.simplified: 从这里到火车站，搭公车比坐捷运快吗？
lines.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào huǒchē zhàn, dā gōngchē bǐ zuò jiéyùn kuài ma?
lines.english: From here to the train station, is the bus faster than the MRT?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不，搭公車要四十分鐘，坐捷運比搭公車快十分鐘。
lines.simplified: 不，搭公车要四十分钟，坐捷运比搭公车快十分钟。
lines.pinyin: Bù, dā gōngchē yào sìshí fēnzhōng, zuò jiéyùn bǐ dā gōngchē kuài shí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: No. The bus takes forty minutes; the MRT is ten minutes faster than the bus.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們坐捷運吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们坐捷运吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen zuò jiéyùn ba.
lines.english: Then let's take the MRT.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 坐捷運到火車站要多久？
prompt.simplified: 坐捷运到火车站要多久？
prompt.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn dào huǒchē zhàn yào duōjiǔ?
prompt.english: How long does the MRT take to the train station?

questions.why: The bus takes forty minutes and the MRT is 快十分鐘, ten minutes faster: 40 − 10 = 30 minutes. Ten minutes is only the difference.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 放假的時候，你去花蓮了嗎？
lines.simplified: 放假的时候，你去花莲了吗？
lines.pinyin: Fàngjià de shíhòu, nǐ qù Huālián le ma?
lines.english: Did you go to Hualien over the holiday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來要去花蓮，後來聽說那幾天會下大雨，就去了高雄。
lines.simplified: 本来要去花莲，后来听说那几天会下大雨，就去了高雄。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái yào qù Huālián, hòulái tīngshuō nà jǐ tiān huì xià dà yǔ, jiù qù le Gāoxióng.
lines.english: I was going to go to Hualien, but then I heard it would rain heavily those days, so I went to Kaohsiung.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 高雄好玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 高雄好玩吗？
lines.pinyin: Gāoxióng hǎowán ma?
lines.english: Was Kaohsiung fun?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 很好玩，我還吃了很多好吃的東西。
lines.simplified: 很好玩，我还吃了很多好吃的东西。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎowán, wǒ hái chī le hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi.
lines.english: Lots of fun. I also ate lots of tasty food.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的放假去了哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 男的放假去了哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de fàngjià qù le nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where did the man go over the holiday?

questions.why: 本來要去花蓮，後來……就去了高雄: Hualien was only the first plan; because of the rain he went to Kaohsiung instead, and he did travel.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你跟你女朋友是怎麼認識的？
lines.simplified: 你跟你女朋友是怎么认识的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēn nǐ nǚpéngyǒu shì zěnme rènshì de?
lines.english: How did you and your girlfriend meet?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們是在網路上認識的。她是別的大學的學生，看了我寫的文章，給我留言。
lines.simplified: 我们是在网路上认识的。她是别的大学的学生，看了我写的文章，给我留言。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì de. Tā shì biéde dàxué de xuéshēng, kàn le wǒ xiě de wénzhāng, gěi wǒ liúyán.
lines.english: We met online. She's a student at another university; she read an article I wrote and left me a message.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你們第一次是在哪裡見面的？
lines.simplified: 那你们第一次是在哪里见面的？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐmen dì yī cì shì zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn de?
lines.english: So where did you first meet in person?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來想約在我們學校的圖書館，後來約在學校附近的一家咖啡廳。
lines.simplified: 本来想约在我们学校的图书馆，后来约在学校附近的一家咖啡厅。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng yuē zài wǒmen xuéxiào de túshūguǎn, hòulái yuē zài xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā kāfēitīng.
lines.english: We first thought of meeting at our school library, but in the end we met at a café near school.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們第一次在哪裡見面？
prompt.simplified: 他们第一次在哪里见面？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen dì yī cì zài nǎlǐ jiànmiàn?
prompt.english: Where did they first meet in person?

choices.pinyin: Zài nán de xuéxiào de túshūguǎn.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 後來約在學校附近的一家咖啡廳: they finally met at a café. The library was only the first idea, they got to know each other online, and her university is never a meeting place.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 喂，我已經到博物館門口了，妳到了嗎？
lines.simplified: 喂，我已经到博物馆门口了，你到了吗？
lines.pinyin: Wéi, wǒ yǐjīng dào bówùguǎn ménkǒu le, nǐ dào le ma?
lines.english: Hello, I'm already at the museum entrance. Are you here?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不好意思，我剛剛出了捷運站，可是不知道博物館在哪裡。我要往哪邊走？
lines.simplified: 不好意思，我刚刚出了捷运站，可是不知道博物馆在哪里。我要往哪边走？
lines.pinyin: Bùhǎoyìsi, wǒ gānggāng chū le jiéyùn zhàn, kěshì bù zhīdào bówùguǎn zài nǎlǐ. Wǒ yào wǎng nǎ biān zǒu?
lines.english: Sorry, I've just come out of the MRT station, but I don't know where the museum is. Which way do I go?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳從捷運站往右走，過了第二個路口，博物館就在左邊。
lines.simplified: 你从捷运站往右走，过了第二个路口，博物馆就在左边。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ cóng jiéyùn zhàn wǎng yòu zǒu, guò le dì èr ge lùkǒu, bówùguǎn jiù zài zuǒbiān.
lines.english: From the station go right. After the second intersection, the museum is on the left.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，我馬上到！
lines.simplified: 好，我马上到！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ mǎshàng dào!
lines.english: OK, I'll be right there!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的應該怎麼走？
prompt.simplified: 女的应该怎么走？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yīnggāi zěnme zǒu?
prompt.english: How should the woman go?

choices.pinyin: Wǎng yòu zǒu, guò yí ge lùkǒu.
choices.english: Go right and cross one intersection.
choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Wǎng yòu zǒu, guò liǎng ge lùkǒu.
choices.english: Go right and cross two intersections.
choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Wǎng zuǒ zǒu, guò yí ge lùkǒu.
choices.english: Go left and cross one intersection.
choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Wǎng zuǒ zǒu, guò liǎng ge lùkǒu.
choices.english: Go left and cross two intersections.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 從捷運站往右走，過了第二個路口: she goes right and crosses two intersections. 左邊 is only where the museum stands after that.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
妳放在桌上的蛋糕，我拿給同學吃了，真不好意思！下課以後，我會去麵包店買一個新的給妳。
妹妹
text.simplified:
姐姐：
你放在桌上的蛋糕，我拿给同学吃了，真不好意思！下课以后，我会去面包店买一个新的给你。
妹妹
text.pinyin:
Jiějie:
Nǐ fàng zài zhuō shàng de dàngāo, wǒ ná gěi tóngxué chī le, zhēn bùhǎoyìsi! Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ huì qù miànbāo diàn mǎi yí ge xīn de gěi nǐ.
Mèimei
text.english:
Big sister,
The cake you left on the table: I gave it to my classmates to eat. I'm really sorry! After class I'll go to the bakery and buy you a new one.
Your little sister

prompt.traditional: 姐姐的蛋糕怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 姐姐的蛋糕怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Jiějie de dàngāo zěnmele?
prompt.english: What happened to the older sister's cake?

choices.english: The younger sister's classmates ate it.
The younger sister ate it herself.

questions.why: 我拿給同學吃了: the younger sister gave the cake to her classmates, and they ate it. She did not eat it herself, and it is no longer on the table.

focus.en: gave it to classmates to eat

text.traditional:
張先生：
您好！您要買的那本書已經賣完了。下個星期三書會再到，到了以後，我們會再打給您。
大學書店 高小姐
text.simplified:
张先生：
您好！您要买的那本书已经卖完了。下个星期三书会再到，到了以后，我们会再打给您。
大学书店 高小姐
text.pinyin:
Zhāng xiānshēng:
Nín hǎo! Nín yào mǎi de nà běn shū yǐjīng mài wán le. Xià ge xīngqísān shū huì zài dào, dào le yǐhòu, wǒmen huì zài dǎ gěi nín.
Dàxué shūdiàn Gāo xiǎojiě
text.english:
Mr. Zhang,
Hello! The book you want to buy is sold out. More copies come in next Wednesday; when they arrive, we will call you again.
Miss Gao, University Bookstore

prompt.traditional: 書到了以後，書店會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 书到了以后，书店会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Shū dào le yǐhòu, shūdiàn huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the bookstore do when the books arrive?

choices.english: Mail the book to Mr. Zhang.
Sell the book to someone else.
Phone Mr. Zhang to tell him.

questions.why: 我們會再打給您: when the books arrive, the shop will phone Mr. Zhang. It does not say it will mail him the book, and his copy is not sold to anyone else.

text.traditional:
時間：這個星期六晚上八點到十一點
地方：學生餐廳二樓
不會跳舞也沒關係！舞會開始以前，七點半到八點，老師會先教大家跳。
歡迎帶朋友一起來參加！
text.simplified:
时间：这个星期六晚上八点到十一点
地方：学生餐厅二楼
不会跳舞也没关系！舞会开始以前，七点半到八点，老师会先教大家跳。
欢迎带朋友一起来参加！
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng bā diǎn dào shíyī diǎn
Dìfāng: Xuéshēng cāntīng èr lóu
Bú huì tiàowǔ yě méiguānxi! Wǔhuì kāishǐ yǐqián, qī diǎn bàn dào bā diǎn, lǎoshī huì xiān jiāo dàjiā tiào.
Huānyíng dài péngyǒu yìqǐ lái cānjiā!
text.english:
Time: this Saturday, 8 to 11 p.m.
Place: Student cafeteria, 2nd floor
Can't dance? No problem! Before the party, from 7:30 to 8:00, a teacher will teach everyone.
You're welcome to bring friends along!

versions.alt: A school dance poster pinned on a campus notice board

prompt.traditional: 不會跳舞的人，最好幾點到？
prompt.simplified: 不会跳舞的人，最好几点到？
prompt.pinyin: Bú huì tiàowǔ de rén, zuìhǎo jǐ diǎn dào?
prompt.english: What time should people who can't dance arrive?

questions.why: The teacher teaches 七點半到八點, before the party starts, so someone who can't dance should come at half past seven. At eight the lesson is over and the party begins.

10:00｜看老照片｜二樓

prompt.traditional: 想學書法的人，應該去幾樓？
prompt.simplified: 想学书法的人，应该去几楼？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng xué shūfǎ de rén, yīnggāi qù jǐ lóu?
prompt.english: Which floor should someone who wants to learn calligraphy go to?

questions.why: 書法 is writing with a brush (用毛筆寫字), which is on the 3rd floor. The 2nd floor has old photos and the 1st floor history stories.

versions.alt: An evening dance party in a big hall: round yellow paper lanterns and strings of small lights hang overhead, and the tall windows are dark blue with night. In front, a young man seen from behind (black hair, light-green shirt) dances facing a young woman (long dark-brown hair in a ponytail, coral-red shirt, long teal skirt). They hold each other's hands between them; she smiles and looks up at him as if they are talking. Behind them, other couples dance as dark shadows on a shiny floor. There are no photos or writing on the walls.

prompt.traditional: 兩個人＿＿跳舞，一邊笑著說話。
prompt.simplified: 两个人＿＿跳舞，一边笑着说话。

answer.traditional: 兩個人一邊跳舞，一邊笑著說話。
answer.simplified: 两个人一边跳舞，一边笑着说话。
answer.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén yìbiān tiàowǔ, yìbiān xiàozhe shuōhuà.
answer.english: The two of them are dancing while smiling and talking.

questions.why: The second half starts with 一邊, so the first half needs 一邊 too: 一邊跳舞，一邊說話, two things at the same time. 一下 and 一點 never come before a verb like this.

prompt.traditional: 男生穿著綠色的衣服，站＿＿女生的對面。
prompt.simplified: 男生穿着绿色的衣服，站＿＿女生的对面。

answer.traditional: 男生穿著綠色的衣服，站在女生的對面。
answer.simplified: 男生穿着绿色的衣服，站在女生的对面。
answer.pinyin: Nánshēng chuānzhe lǜsè de yīfu, zhàn zài nǚshēng de duìmiàn.
answer.english: The boy in the green shirt is standing across from the girl.

questions.why: 站在 + place says where he stands: 站在女生的對面. 給 needs a person who receives something, and 完 means finished.

prompt.traditional: 女生穿著紅色的衣服和一條長＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 女生穿着红色的衣服和一条长＿＿。

answer.traditional: 女生穿著紅色的衣服和一條長裙子。
answer.simplified: 女生穿着红色的衣服和一条长裙子。
answer.pinyin: Nǚshēng chuānzhe hóngsè de yīfu hé yì tiáo cháng qúnzi.
answer.english: The girl is wearing a red top and a long skirt.

questions.why: In the picture she wears a long skirt, not trousers. Her hair is long too, but you don't 穿 (wear) hair.

versions.alt: An evening dance party in a big hall: round yellow paper lanterns and strings of small lights hang overhead, and the tall windows are dark blue with night. In front, a young man seen from behind (black hair, light-green shirt) dances facing a young woman (long dark-brown hair in a ponytail, coral-red shirt, long teal skirt). They hold each other's hands between them; she smiles and looks up at him as if they are talking. Behind them, other couples dance as dark shadows on a shiny floor. There are no photos or writing on the walls.

prompt.traditional: 他們在一個很大的地方跳舞，上面有很多＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 他们在一个很大的地方跳舞，上面有很多＿＿。

answer.traditional: 他們在一個很大的地方跳舞，上面有很多燈籠。
answer.simplified: 他们在一个很大的地方跳舞，上面有很多灯笼。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen zài yí ge hěn dà de dìfāng tiàowǔ, shàngmiàn yǒu hěn duō dēnglóng.
answer.english: They are dancing in a big place with lots of lanterns overhead.

questions.why: Round paper lanterns (燈籠) hang above them. There are no photos or writing anywhere in the picture.

prompt.traditional: 他們拉著手，一邊跳舞，＿＿聊天。
prompt.simplified: 他们拉着手，一边跳舞，＿＿聊天。

answer.traditional: 他們拉著手，一邊跳舞，一邊聊天。
answer.simplified: 他们拉着手，一边跳舞，一边聊天。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen lāzhe shǒu, yìbiān tiàowǔ, yìbiān liáotiān.
answer.english: Holding hands, they dance and chat at the same time.

questions.why: 一邊跳舞 needs a second 一邊: 一邊跳舞，一邊聊天, two actions at once. 一點 and 一下 don't complete the pair.

prompt.traditional: 他們兩個人站＿＿別人的前面跳舞。
prompt.simplified: 他们两个人站＿＿别人的前面跳舞。
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén zhàn ＿＿ biérén de qiánmiàn tiàowǔ.
prompt.english: The two of them are dancing ___ front of the others.

answer.traditional: 他們兩個人站在別人的前面跳舞。
answer.simplified: 他们两个人站在别人的前面跳舞。
answer.pinyin: Tāmen liǎng ge rén zhàn zài biérén de qiánmiàn tiàowǔ.
answer.english: The two of them are dancing in front of the others.

questions.why: 站在 + place says where they stand: in front of the other couples. 站給 and 站完 don't say where.

passage.traditional: 上個星期六晚上，我第一次跟一個在網路上認識的女生約會。我們先去夜市，吃了很多好吃的東西，照了很多照片。走了一個晚上，她說腳有點{1}，我們就在夜市旁邊的咖啡廳坐了{2}。我很{3}，不知道要跟她說什麼。她看我不說話，就跟我開了一個{4}，我們兩個人都笑了。那天我們玩得很開心，我希望下次還能跟她約會。
passage.simplified: 上个星期六晚上，我第一次跟一个在网路上认识的女生约会。我们先去夜市，吃了很多好吃的东西，照了很多照片。走了一个晚上，她说脚有点{1}，我们就在夜市旁边的咖啡厅坐了{2}。我很{3}，不知道要跟她说什么。她看我不说话，就跟我开了一个{4}，我们两个人都笑了。那天我们玩得很开心，我希望下次还能跟她约会。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, wǒ dì yī cì gēn yí ge zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì de nǚshēng yuēhuì. Wǒmen xiān qù yèshì, chī le hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi, zhào le hěn duō zhàopiàn. Zǒu le yí ge wǎnshàng, tā shuō jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, wǒmen jiù zài yèshì pángbiān de kāfēitīng zuò le yíxià. Wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào gēn tā shuō shénme. Tā kàn wǒ bù shuōhuà, jiù gēn wǒ kāi le yí ge wánxiào, wǒmen liǎng ge rén dōu xiào le. Nà tiān wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn, wǒ xīwàng xià cì hái néng gēn tā yuēhuì.
passage.english: Last Saturday evening I went on a first date with a girl I met online. We went to the night market first, ate lots of tasty food and took lots of photos. After walking all evening, she said her feet hurt a little, so we sat for a while in the café next to the night market. I was very nervous and didn't know what to say to her. When she saw I wasn't talking, she made a joke, and we both laughed. We had a great time that day, and I hope I can go on another date with her.

questions.why: 腳有點疼: after walking all evening her feet hurt a little, so they sat down.
坐了一下: V + 一下 is a short action, they sat for a little while.
我很緊張，不知道要說什麼: on a first date he is nervous and can't think what to say.
開玩笑 splits around 一個: 開了一個玩笑, she made a joke and they laughed.

passage.traditional: 這個學期，我住在學校的{1}。我的同學個性很好，常常帶我去吃台灣小吃，她說台灣小吃不但好吃，也不貴。有一天，她介紹了一個好朋友{2}我認識。上個週末天氣很好，我們三個人一起去騎腳踏車。騎{3}以後，我們在公園休息了{4}，一邊喝飲料，一邊聊天。我覺得能認識這兩個朋友，我真的很幸運。
passage.simplified: 这个学期，我住在学校的{1}。我的同学个性很好，常常带我去吃台湾小吃，她说台湾小吃不但好吃，也不贵。有一天，她介绍了一个好朋友{2}我认识。上个周末天气很好，我们三个人一起去骑脚踏车。骑{3}以后，我们在公园休息了{4}，一边喝饮料，一边聊天。我觉得能认识这两个朋友，我真的很幸运。
passage.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí, wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè. Wǒ de tóngxué gèxìng hěn hǎo, chángcháng dài wǒ qù chī Táiwān xiǎochī, tā shuō Táiwān xiǎochī búdàn hǎochī, yě bú guì. Yǒu yì tiān, tā jièshào le yí ge hǎo péngyǒu gěi wǒ rènshì. Shàng ge zhōumò tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen sān ge rén yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē. Qí wán yǐhòu, wǒmen zài gōngyuán xiūxí le yíxià, yìbiān hē yǐnliào, yìbiān liáotiān. Wǒ juéde néng rènshì zhè liǎng ge péngyǒu, wǒ zhēn de hěn xìngyùn.
passage.english: This semester I live in the school dorm. My classmate has a great personality and often takes me to eat Taiwanese snacks; she says they're not only tasty but also cheap. One day she introduced a good friend to me. Last weekend the weather was lovely, and the three of us went bike riding together. After riding, we rested a while in the park, drinking and chatting. I feel really lucky to know these two friends.

questions.why: 住在學校的宿舍: the place she lives at school is the dorm.
介紹……給我認識: 給 marks who receives the introduction, so the friend is introduced to me.
騎完以後: after they finished riding, they rested.
休息了一下: V + 一下 is a short rest, a little while.

text.traditional: 我的妹妹是小學生，個性很害羞。上個週末，我帶她去動物園。看到小羊的時候，她很害怕，不敢摸，一直站在我後面。後來看到別的小孩都在摸，她也去摸了一下。雖然她只摸了一下，可是回家的時候，她一直說下次還要去。
text.simplified: 我的妹妹是小学生，个性很害羞。上个周末，我带她去动物园。看到小羊的时候，她很害怕，不敢摸，一直站在我后面。后来看到别的小孩都在摸，她也去摸了一下。虽然她只摸了一下，可是回家的时候，她一直说下次还要去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de mèimei shì xiǎoxuéshēng, gèxìng hěn hàixiū. Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dài tā qù dòngwùyuán. Kàndào xiǎo yáng de shíhòu, tā hěn hàipà, bù gǎn mō, yìzhí zhàn zài wǒ hòumiàn. Hòulái kàndào biéde xiǎohái dōu zài mō, tā yě qù mō le yíxià. Suīrán tā zhǐ mō le yíxià, kěshì huí jiā de shíhòu, tā yìzhí shuō xià cì hái yào qù.
text.english: My little sister is in elementary school and is very shy. Last weekend I took her to the zoo. When she saw the lambs she was scared, didn't dare touch them, and stayed behind me the whole time. Then she saw other kids touching them, so she went and touched one too. Although she only touched it for a moment, on the way home she kept saying she wants to go again next time.

prompt.traditional: 妹妹在動物園的時候，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹在动物园的时候，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei zài dòngwùyuán de shíhòu, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true about the little sister at the zoo?

choices.pinyin: Mèimei yìzhí bù gǎn mō xiǎo yáng.
choices.english: The sister never dared to touch the lambs.

choices.pinyin: Mèimei mō xiǎo yáng mō le hěn jiǔ.
choices.english: The sister touched the lambs for a long time.

choices.pinyin: Mèimei bǐ biéde xiǎohái xiān mō.
choices.english: The sister touched them before the other kids.

choices.traditional: 妹妹後來沒那麼害怕了
choices.simplified: 妹妹后来没那么害怕了
choices.pinyin: Mèimei hòulái méi nàme hàipà le.

questions.why: 雖然她只摸了一下，可是……一直說下次還要去: she was scared at first, then touched a lamb and wants to come back, so she is less afraid now. She did touch one, but only for a moment and only after the other kids did.

text.traditional:
美心：
謝謝妳那天告訴我的辦法！我請她跟她的朋友一起來參加舞會，她真的來了。她不但很會跳舞，也很愛開玩笑。舞會結束以後，我們還在學校裡散步。我很想趕快再跟她約會，可是不知道去哪裡好。妳可以幫我想一想嗎？
良介
text.simplified:
美心：
谢谢你那天告诉我的办法！我请她跟她的朋友一起来参加舞会，她真的来了。她不但很会跳舞，也很爱开玩笑。舞会结束以后，我们还在学校里散步。我很想赶快再跟她约会，可是不知道去哪里好。你可以帮我想一想吗？
良介
text.pinyin:
Měixīn:
Xièxie nǐ nà tiān gàosu wǒ de bànfǎ! Wǒ qǐng tā gēn tā de péngyǒu yìqǐ lái cānjiā wǔhuì, tā zhēn de lái le. Tā búdàn hěn huì tiàowǔ, yě hěn ài kāiwánxiào. Wǔhuì jiéshù yǐhòu, wǒmen hái zài xuéxiào lǐ sànbù. Wǒ hěn xiǎng gǎnkuài zài gēn tā yuēhuì, kěshì bù zhīdào qù nǎlǐ hǎo. Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ xiǎng yì xiǎng ma?
Liángjiè
text.english:
Meixin,
Thanks for the idea you told me the other day! I asked her to come to the dance party with her friends, and she really came. She not only dances well but also loves to joke. After the party we took a walk around campus. I really want to go on another date with her soon, but I don't know where to go. Could you help me think about it?
Ryosuke

prompt.traditional: 良介為什麼寫這個留言？
prompt.simplified: 良介为什么写这个留言？
prompt.pinyin: Liángjiè wèishénme xiě zhège liúyán?
prompt.english: Why did Ryosuke write this message?

choices.pinyin: Xièxie Měixīn gēn tā qù wǔhuì.
choices.english: To thank Meixin for going to the party with him.

choices.traditional: 請美心幫他約那個女生
choices.simplified: 请美心帮他约那个女生
choices.pinyin: Qǐng Měixīn bāng tā yuē nàge nǚshēng.
choices.english: To ask Meixin to ask the girl out for him.

choices.traditional: 問美心下次約會去哪裡
choices.simplified: 问美心下次约会去哪里
choices.pinyin: Wèn Měixīn xià cì yuēhuì qù nǎlǐ.
choices.english: To ask Meixin where to go on the next date.

choices.pinyin: Qǐng Měixīn jiāo tā zěnme tiàowǔ.
choices.english: To ask Meixin to teach him to dance.

questions.why: 不知道去哪裡好。妳可以幫我想一想嗎: he wants Meixin's help choosing where to go on the next date. Meixin only gave him the idea; she did not go to the party with him or ask the girl out for him.

text.traditional:
最近天氣很冷，感冒的人很多，請大家注意：
一、出去的時候，最好戴口罩。
二、吃東西以前，最好先洗手。
三、發燒或是一直咳嗽的人，最好先去看醫生。看完醫生以後，不要自己來藥局拿藥，請打電話給我們，我們會送藥給您。
時間：每天上午九點到晚上十點
text.simplified:
最近天气很冷，感冒的人很多，请大家注意：
一、出去的时候，最好戴口罩。
二、吃东西以前，最好先洗手。
三、发烧或是一直咳嗽的人，最好先去看医生。看完医生以后，不要自己来药局拿药，请打电话给我们，我们会送药给您。
时间：每天上午九点到晚上十点
text.pinyin:
Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn lěng, gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì:
Yī, chūqù de shíhòu, zuìhǎo dài kǒuzhào.
Èr, chī dōngxi yǐqián, zuìhǎo xiān xǐ shǒu.
Sān, fāshāo huòshì yìzhí késòu de rén, zuìhǎo xiān qù kàn yīshēng. Kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu, búyào zìjǐ lái yàojú ná yào, qǐng dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒmen, wǒmen huì sòng yào gěi nín.
Shíjiān: Měi tiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn
text.english:
It's been cold lately and many people have colds. Please note:
1. When you go out, you'd better wear a mask.
2. Before eating, you'd better wash your hands first.
3. If you have a fever or keep coughing, you'd better see a doctor first. After seeing the doctor, don't come to the drugstore for your medicine yourself: call us and we will bring the medicine to you.
Hours: every day, 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

versions.alt: A printed notice taped on the glass door of a small neighbourhood pharmacy

prompt.traditional: 發燒的人看完醫生以後，應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 发烧的人看完医生以后，应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Fāshāo de rén kàn wán yīshēng yǐhòu, yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What should someone with a fever do after seeing the doctor?

choices.english: Go to the drugstore for the medicine.
Wear a mask and go buy medicine.

choices.pinyin: Zài qù kàn yí cì yīshēng.

questions.why: 看完醫生以後，不要自己來藥局拿藥，請打電話給我們: after the doctor, a sick person phones the drugstore and it brings the medicine. Coming to the shop yourself is exactly what it asks people not to do, and the doctor has already been seen.

text.traditional: 我是從越南來的大學生，在台灣住了兩年了。雖然我很喜歡打籃球，可是還沒看過籃球比賽。上個星期，我的台灣同學買了兩張比賽的票，本來要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天剛好要上班，所以同學就送給我一張，我們一起去了。那天人很多，很熱鬧，我們看得很愉快。
text.simplified: 我是从越南来的大学生，在台湾住了两年了。虽然我很喜欢打篮球，可是还没看过篮球比赛。上个星期，我的台湾同学买了两张比赛的票，本来要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天刚好要上班，所以同学就送给我一张，我们一起去了。那天人很多，很热闹，我们看得很愉快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Yuènán lái de dàxuéshēng, zài Táiwān zhù le liǎng nián le. Suīrán wǒ hěn xǐhuān dǎ lánqiú, kěshì hái méi kàn guo lánqiú bǐsài. Shàng ge xīngqí, wǒ de Táiwān tóngxué mǎi le liǎng zhāng bǐsài de piào, běnlái yào gēn tā gēge yìqǐ qù, kěshì tā gēge nà tiān gānghǎo yào shàngbān, suǒyǐ tóngxué jiù sòng gěi wǒ yì zhāng, wǒmen yìqǐ qù le. Nà tiān rén hěn duō, hěn rènao, wǒmen kàn de hěn yúkuài.
text.english: I'm a college student from Vietnam and have lived in Taiwan for two years. Although I love playing basketball, I had never watched a basketball game. Last week my Taiwanese classmate bought two tickets to a game. He was going to go with his older brother, but his brother happened to have to work that day, so my classmate gave one ticket to me and we went together. It was crowded and lively, and we had a great time.

prompt.traditional: 這個越南學生上個星期為什麼能去看比賽？
prompt.simplified: 这个越南学生上个星期为什么能去看比赛？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège Yuènán xuéshēng shàng ge xīngqí wèishénme néng qù kàn bǐsài?
prompt.english: Why could the Vietnamese student go to the game last week?

choices.pinyin: Gēge sòng gěi tā yì zhāng piào.
choices.english: The brother gave the student a ticket.

choices.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ shàngwǎng mǎi le piào.
choices.english: The student bought a ticket online.

choices.pinyin: Tā lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
Tóngxué de gēge bù néng qù.

questions.why: 本來要跟他哥哥一起去，可是他哥哥那天剛好要上班，所以同學就送給我一張: the brother couldn't go, so the classmate gave the student his ticket. The ticket came from the classmate, not the brother, and the student didn't buy one.

text.traditional: 我哥哥大學畢業以後，在一家銀行工作。他說銀行的工作很辛苦，可是同事都很好。他每天早上八點上班，可是常常七點半就到辦公室了，因為他不喜歡遲到。下了班以後，他還去學日文，因為他希望以後能去日本工作。
text.simplified: 我哥哥大学毕业以后，在一家银行工作。他说银行的工作很辛苦，可是同事都很好。他每天早上八点上班，可是常常七点半就到办公室了，因为他不喜欢迟到。下了班以后，他还去学日文，因为他希望以后能去日本工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, zài yì jiā yínháng gōngzuò. Tā shuō yínháng de gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì tóngshì dōu hěn hǎo. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng bā diǎn shàngbān, kěshì chángcháng qī diǎn bàn jiù dào bàngōngshì le, yīnwèi tā bù xǐhuān chídào. Xià le bān yǐhòu, tā hái qù xué Rìwén, yīnwèi tā xīwàng yǐhòu néng qù Rìběn gōngzuò.
text.english: After graduating from university, my older brother started working at a bank. He says bank work is hard, but his colleagues are all nice. He starts work at eight every morning, but he often gets to the office at seven thirty, because he doesn't like being late. After work he also studies Japanese, because he hopes to work in Japan one day.

prompt.traditional: 哥哥常常幾點到辦公室？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥常常几点到办公室？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge chángcháng jǐ diǎn dào bàngōngshì?
prompt.english: What time does the brother usually get to the office?

questions.why: 八點上班 is when work starts, but 常常七點半就到辦公室了: 就 shows he is there early, at half past seven.

text.traditional: 我們本來打算這個週末去合歡山看雪，可是前幾天下了大雨，去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭。我們要先坐高鐵，再搭公車去日月潭，坐公車要一個多小時。我們打算在那裡住一個晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.simplified: 我们本来打算这个周末去合欢山看雪，可是前几天下了大雨，去合欢山的路坏了，不能开车上山，所以后来决定去日月潭。我们要先坐高铁，再搭公车去日月潭，坐公车要一个多小时。我们打算在那里住一个晚上，星期天下午再回台北。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái dǎsuàn zhège zhōumò qù Héhuān Shān kàn xuě, kěshì qián jǐ tiān xià le dà yǔ, qù Héhuān Shān de lù huài le, bù néng kāichē shàng shān, suǒyǐ hòulái juédìng qù Rìyuè Tán. Wǒmen yào xiān zuò gāotiě, zài dā gōngchē qù Rìyuè Tán, zuò gōngchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Wǒmen dǎsuàn zài nàlǐ zhù yí ge wǎnshàng, xīngqítiān xiàwǔ zài huí Táiběi.
text.english: We had planned to go to Hehuan Mountain this weekend to see the snow, but it rained heavily a few days ago and the road to Hehuan Mountain is damaged, so cars can't drive up. In the end we decided to go to Sun Moon Lake. We'll take the high-speed rail first and then a bus, which takes a bit over an hour. We plan to stay one night there and come back to Taipei on Sunday afternoon.

prompt.traditional: 他們後來為什麼決定去日月潭？
prompt.simplified: 他们后来为什么决定去日月潭？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen hòulái wèishénme juédìng qù Rìyuè Tán?
prompt.english: Why did they decide to go to Sun Moon Lake in the end?

choices.english: There's no snow on Hehuan Mountain.

choices.pinyin: Rìyuè Tán lí gāotiě zhàn hěn jìn.
choices.english: Sun Moon Lake is close to the high-speed rail station.

choices.traditional: 上合歡山的路不能走了
choices.simplified: 上合欢山的路不能走了
choices.pinyin: Shàng Héhuān Shān de lù bù néng zǒu le.
choices.english: The road up Hehuan Mountain can't be used.

choices.traditional: 他們想在日月潭住一晚
choices.simplified: 他们想在日月潭住一晚
choices.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎng zài Rìyuè Tán zhù yì wǎn.
choices.english: They want to stay a night at Sun Moon Lake.

questions.why: 去合歡山的路壞了，不能開車上山，所以後來決定去日月潭: the plan changed because the mountain road can't be used. Snow was why they first wanted to go, the bus ride from the train is over an hour (not close), and staying a night is the new plan, not its reason.

picture.alt: Inside a small restaurant on a sunny day, two young men are at a long wooden table. On the left, a young man with black hair stands with a black backpack over one shoulder, holding its strap; he wears a green shirt, open, over a red striped T-shirt, and dark trousers. He looks at the other young man with his mouth open, as if he is speaking. On the right, a young man with short light-brown hair, a blue-green T-shirt and dark-blue trousers leans over the table and wipes it with a white cloth; his other hand is held out, palm up, and he smiles and talks. On the table next to him is a grey plastic tub holding a stack of white bowls. Behind them are empty wooden chairs and tables, big windows with sunlight and green trees outside, a hanging lamp, a red cloth curtain over the kitchen door and shelves with stacked dishes. There are no customers and nobody is eating.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 黑頭髮的男生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 黑头发的男生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Hēi tóufǎ de nánshēng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the young man with black hair doing?

choices.pinyin: Tā zài bāng péngyǒu cā zhuōzi.
choices.english: He is helping his friend wipe the table.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He is eating at the restaurant.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He is talking with his friend.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: The black-haired young man stands with his bag on his shoulder and talks to his friend. He is not helping: only the young man with light-brown hair wipes the table, and there is no food, so nobody is eating.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 桌子上有什麼？
prompt.simplified: 桌子上有什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng yǒu shénme?
prompt.english: What is on the table?

choices.english: There are a lot of bowls.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: There are a lot of knives and forks.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: There is a lot of garbage.

questions.why: A grey tub full of white bowls stands on the table next to the young man who is wiping it. There are no knives and forks and no garbage on the table.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 球賽七點開始，我們走路去，好不好？
lines.simplified: 球赛七点开始，我们走路去，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Qiúsài qī diǎn kāishǐ, wǒmen zǒulù qù, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: The game starts at seven. Shall we walk there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 從這裡到那裡有多遠？
lines.simplified: 从这里到那里有多远？
lines.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ dào nàlǐ yǒu duō yuǎn?
lines.english: How far is it from here?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 差不多三公里。走路要四十分鐘，坐公車十五分鐘就到了。
lines.simplified: 差不多三公里。走路要四十分钟，坐公车十五分钟就到了。
lines.pinyin: Chàbùduō sān gōnglǐ. Zǒulù yào sìshí fēnzhōng, zuò gōngchē shíwǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
lines.english: About three kilometers. Walking takes forty minutes; by bus you are there in fifteen.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我今天腳有點疼，走那麼久，我沒辦法。
lines.simplified: 我今天脚有点疼，走那么久，我没办法。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, zǒu nàme jiǔ, wǒ méibànfǎ.
lines.english: My feet hurt a bit today. I can't walk that long.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們可能會怎麼去看球賽？
prompt.simplified: 他们可能会怎么去看球赛？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng huì zěnme qù kàn qiúsài?
prompt.english: How will they probably get to the game?

questions.why: She asked 有多遠 and heard it is forty minutes on foot; with sore feet she says 走那麼久，我沒辦法, so walking is out. She never says she won't go, and the bus (fifteen minutes) is the other way he named.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳妹妹現在有多高？上次看見她的時候，她還是小學生呢。
lines.simplified: 你妹妹现在有多高？上次看见她的时候，她还是小学生呢。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mèimei xiànzài yǒu duō gāo? Shàng cì kànjiàn tā de shíhòu, tā háishì xiǎoxuéshēng ne.
lines.english: How tall is your little sister now? The last time I saw her, she was still in elementary school.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她已經一百六十五公分了，比我高五公分。
lines.simplified: 她已经一百六十五公分了，比我高五公分。
lines.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng yìbǎi liùshíwǔ gōngfēn le, bǐ wǒ gāo wǔ gōngfēn.
lines.english: She's already 165 centimeters, five centimeters taller than me.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的有多高？
prompt.simplified: 女的有多高？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yǒu duō gāo?
prompt.english: How tall is the woman?

questions.why: Her sister is 165 cm and 比我高五公分, five centimeters taller than her, so the woman is 160 cm. 165 is the sister's height.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你還常常去游泳嗎？
lines.simplified: 你还常常去游泳吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hái chángcháng qù yóuyǒng ma?
lines.english: Do you still go swimming a lot?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 暑假的時候，我一個星期去游泳三次。可是開學以後太忙了，已經兩個星期沒去了。
lines.simplified: 暑假的时候，我一个星期去游泳三次。可是开学以后太忙了，已经两个星期没去了。
lines.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhòu, wǒ yí ge xīngqí qù yóuyǒng sān cì. Kěshì kāixué yǐhòu tài máng le, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi qù le.
lines.english: Over the summer vacation I swam three times a week. But since school started I've been too busy; I haven't been for two weeks.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true?

choices.traditional: 他現在一個星期去游泳三次。
choices.simplified: 他现在一个星期去游泳三次。
choices.pinyin: Tā xiànzài yí ge xīngqí qù yóuyǒng sān cì.
choices.english: Now he swims three times a week.
choices.speaker: N

choices.traditional: 他暑假的時候很少去游泳。
choices.simplified: 他暑假的时候很少去游泳。
choices.pinyin: Tā shǔjià de shíhòu hěn shǎo qù yóuyǒng.
choices.english: He seldom went swimming over the summer vacation.
choices.speaker: N

choices.traditional: 他這兩個星期都沒去游泳。
choices.simplified: 他这两个星期都没去游泳。
choices.pinyin: Tā zhè liǎng ge xīngqí dōu méi qù yóuyǒng.
choices.english: He hasn't been swimming at all these two weeks.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 已經兩個星期沒去了: for the last two weeks he hasn't been swimming at all. Three times a week was the summer vacation, so he didn't swim seldom then, and he doesn't swim that often now.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你的房間好亂！你多久沒打掃了？
lines.simplified: 你的房间好乱！你多久没打扫了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān hǎo luàn! Nǐ duōjiǔ méi dǎsǎo le?
lines.english: Your room is so messy! How long since you last cleaned it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我一直在準備考試，已經一個月沒打掃了。考試還有兩個星期才結束。
lines.simplified: 我一直在准备考试，已经一个月没打扫了。考试还有两个星期才结束。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí zài zhǔnbèi kǎoshì, yǐjīng yí ge yuè méi dǎsǎo le. Kǎoshì hái yǒu liǎng ge xīngqí cái jiéshù.
lines.english: I've been preparing for exams the whole time, so I haven't cleaned for a month. The exams aren't over for another two weeks.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是你媽媽下個星期就要來看你了。
lines.simplified: 可是你妈妈下个星期就要来看你了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ māma xià ge xīngqí jiù yào lái kàn nǐ le.
lines.english: But your mom is coming to see you next week.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的多久沒打掃了？
prompt.simplified: 男的多久没打扫了？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de duōjiǔ méi dǎsǎo le?
prompt.english: How long has it been since the man cleaned?

questions.why: 已經一個月沒打掃了: he hasn't cleaned for a month. Two weeks is how long his exams still go on, and his mother comes next week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我又把錢包丟了！
lines.simplified: 我又把钱包丢了！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòu bǎ qiánbāo diū le!
lines.english: I've lost my wallet again!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 又丟了？上個月妳在捷運上也丟了一次。
lines.simplified: 又丢了？上个月你在捷运上也丢了一次。
lines.pinyin: Yòu diū le? Shàng ge yuè nǐ zài jiéyùn shàng yě diū le yí cì.
lines.english: Again? Last month you lost it once on the MRT too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，這次是在夜市丟的。我好著急，裡面有很多錢。
lines.simplified: 对啊，这次是在夜市丢的。我好着急，里面有很多钱。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, zhè cì shì zài yèshì diū de. Wǒ hǎo zhāojí, lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō qián.
lines.english: Yes, this time I lost it at the night market. I'm so worried; there's a lot of money in it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從上個月到現在，女的丟了幾次錢包？
prompt.simplified: 从上个月到现在，女的丢了几次钱包？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng shàng ge yuè dào xiànzài, nǚ de diū le jǐ cì qiánbāo?
prompt.english: From last month until now, how many times has the woman lost her wallet?

questions.why: 又 means it has happened before: once on the MRT last month (上個月……也丟了一次) and again now at the night market (這次). That makes two.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 已經七點十分了，他怎麼還沒來？
lines.simplified: 已经七点十分了，他怎么还没来？
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng qī diǎn shí fēn le, tā zěnme hái méi lái?
lines.english: It's already ten past seven. Why isn't he here yet?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他又遲到了。上次我們約七點，他八點才到。
lines.simplified: 他又迟到了。上次我们约七点，他八点才到。
lines.pinyin: Tā yòu chídào le. Shàng cì wǒmen yuē qī diǎn, tā bā diǎn cái dào.
lines.english: He's late again. Last time we arranged to meet at seven, and he didn't turn up until eight.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們不要等他了，先進去吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们不要等他了，先进去吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen búyào děng tā le, xiān jìnqù ba.
lines.english: Then let's not wait for him. Let's go in first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.pinyin: Nàge rén jīntiān bú huì lái le.
choices.speaker: N

choices.traditional: 那個人上次七點就到了。
choices.simplified: 那个人上次七点就到了。
choices.pinyin: Nàge rén shàng cì qī diǎn jiù dào le.
choices.english: Last time that person was there by seven.
choices.speaker: N

choices.traditional: 那個人上次也沒準時到。
choices.simplified: 那个人上次也没准时到。
choices.pinyin: Nàge rén shàng cì yě méi zhǔnshí dào.
choices.english: Last time that person wasn't on time either.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 他又遲到了: 又 says it has happened before, and last time is his proof: they arranged seven, but he only came at eight (八點才到). He doesn't say the person won't come; not waiting is the woman's idea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 昨天晚上十一點我打電話給你，你怎麼沒接電話？
lines.simplified: 昨天晚上十一点我打电话给你，你怎么没接电话？
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ, nǐ zěnme méi jiē diànhuà?
lines.english: I called you at eleven last night. Why didn't you answer?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在我父母的餐廳幫忙。昨天客人特別多，十點才關門。
lines.simplified: 我在我父母的餐厅帮忙。昨天客人特别多，十点才关门。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǒ fùmǔ de cāntīng bāngmáng. Zuótiān kèrén tèbié duō, shí diǎn cái guān mén.
lines.english: I was helping at my parents' restaurant. There were lots of customers yesterday, so we didn't close until ten.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你們平常幾點關門？
lines.simplified: 你们平常几点关门？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen píngcháng jǐ diǎn guān mén?
lines.english: What time do you usually close?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 九點。關門以後，我還得洗碗筷、擦桌子，所以昨天十一點半才到家。
lines.simplified: 九点。关门以后，我还得洗碗筷、擦桌子，所以昨天十一点半才到家。
lines.pinyin: Jiǔ diǎn. Guān mén yǐhòu, wǒ hái děi xǐ wǎnkuài, cā zhuōzi, suǒyǐ zuótiān shíyī diǎn bàn cái dào jiā.
lines.english: Nine. After closing I still have to wash the dishes and wipe the tables, so yesterday I didn't get home until half past eleven.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那家餐廳昨天幾點關門？
prompt.simplified: 那家餐厅昨天几点关门？
prompt.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng zuótiān jǐ diǎn guān mén?
prompt.english: What time did that restaurant close yesterday?

questions.why: 昨天客人特別多，十點才關門: yesterday it closed at ten, later than the usual nine. Eleven is when she called him, and half past eleven is when he got home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你今天怎麼十點才來？我們八點半就開始打掃了，打算十一點半以前打掃完。
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么十点才来？我们八点半就开始打扫了，打算十一点半以前打扫完。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme shí diǎn cái lái? Wǒmen bā diǎn bàn jiù kāishǐ dǎsǎo le, dǎsuàn shíyī diǎn bàn yǐqián dǎsǎo wán.
lines.english: How come you only got here at ten? We started cleaning at half past eight and plan to finish before half past eleven.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對不起，我昨天很晚才睡覺，今天九點半才起床。
lines.simplified: 对不起，我昨天很晚才睡觉，今天九点半才起床。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ zuótiān hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào, jīntiān jiǔ diǎn bàn cái qǐchuáng.
lines.english: Sorry. I went to bed very late last night, and today I didn't get up until half past nine.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒關係，客廳已經打掃完了，你去廚房掃地吧。
lines.simplified: 没关系，客厅已经打扫完了，你去厨房扫地吧。
lines.pinyin: Méiguānxi, kètīng yǐjīng dǎsǎo wán le, nǐ qù chúfáng sǎodì ba.
lines.english: That's OK. The living room is done; go and sweep the kitchen floor.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，掃完地，我再去倒垃圾。
lines.simplified: 好，扫完地，我再去倒垃圾。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, sǎo wán dì, wǒ zài qù dào lèsè.
lines.english: OK. After sweeping, I'll take out the garbage.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今天幾點起床？
prompt.simplified: 男的今天几点起床？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīntiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
prompt.english: What time did the man get up today?

questions.why: 今天九點半才起床: he didn't get up until half past nine. Half past eight is when the others started cleaning, ten is when he arrived, and half past eleven is when they plan to finish.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我下個月就要畢業了，房間裡的東西太多，想送給朋友。
lines.simplified: 我下个月就要毕业了，房间里的东西太多，想送给朋友。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè jiù yào bìyè le, fángjiān lǐ de dōngxi tài duō, xiǎng sòng gěi péngyǒu.
lines.english: I graduate next month. There's too much stuff in my room, so I want to give it to friends.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那些舊衣服呢？丟了很可惜。
lines.simplified: 那些旧衣服呢？丢了很可惜。
lines.pinyin: Nàxiē jiù yīfu ne? Diū le hěn kěxí.
lines.english: What about those old clothes? It would be a pity to throw them away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 衣服上個星期送給樓下的鄰居了。這張舊桌子給你，好不好？

title.pinyin: Gěi zhù zài sùshè de tóngxué
title.english: To everyone living in the dorm

text.traditional:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房間門口和樓梯上，請大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房間門口。
二、每天晚上十點以前，請把垃圾拿到一樓的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九點，大家一起打掃樓梯。
text.simplified:
最近常常有人把垃圾放在房间门口和楼梯上，请大家注意：
一、不要把垃圾放在房间门口。
二、每天晚上十点以前，请把垃圾拿到一楼的垃圾桶。
三、星期六早上九点，大家一起打扫楼梯。
text.pinyin:
Zuìjìn chángcháng yǒu rén bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu hé lóutī shàng, qǐng dàjiā zhùyì:
Yī, búyào bǎ lèsè fàng zài fángjiān ménkǒu.
Èr, měi tiān wǎnshàng shí diǎn yǐqián, qǐng bǎ lèsè ná dào yī lóu de lèsè tǒng.
Sān, xīngqíliù zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn, dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo lóutī.
text.english:
Lately people keep leaving garbage at their room doors and on the stairs. Please note:
1. Don't leave garbage at your room door.
2. Every evening before ten, please take your garbage to the trash cans on the first floor.
3. Saturday at 9 a.m., everyone cleans the stairs together.

versions.alt: A printed notice taped on a dormitory hallway wall beside a staircase

prompt.traditional: 住在宿舍的同學，晚上應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 住在宿舍的同学，晚上应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Zhù zài sùshè de tóngxué, wǎnshàng yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What should the students living in the dorm do in the evening?

choices.english: Leave the garbage at the door.

questions.why: 請把垃圾拿到一樓的垃圾桶 every evening before ten: the garbage goes down to the first floor. Leaving it at the door is what the notice asks people to stop, and cleaning the stairs is on Saturday morning.

focus.en: take the garbage down to the first floor

text.traditional:
吃完以後，請把碗筷、湯匙放在桌子上，不用拿到廚房。
喝完的飲料杯，請丟到門口的垃圾桶。
時間：上午十一點到晚上九點
text.simplified:
吃完以后，请把碗筷、汤匙放在桌子上，不用拿到厨房。
喝完的饮料杯，请丢到门口的垃圾桶。
时间：上午十一点到晚上九点
text.pinyin:
Chī wán yǐhòu, qǐng bǎ wǎnkuài, tāngchí fàng zài zhuōzi shàng, búyòng ná dào chúfáng.
Hē wán de yǐnliào bēi, qǐng diū dào ménkǒu de lèsè tǒng.
Shíjiān: Shàngwǔ shíyī diǎn dào wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn
text.english:
When you finish eating, please leave your dishes and spoons on the table; there's no need to take them to the kitchen.
Please throw empty drink cups into the trash can by the door.
Hours: 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.

versions.alt: A laminated sign in a stand on a wooden table in a small noodle shop

prompt.traditional: 客人吃完以後，應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 客人吃完以后，应该怎么做？

choices.english: Take the dishes to the kitchen.

choices.pinyin: Bǎ yǐnliào bēi fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
choices.english: Leave the drink cups on the table.

choices.pinyin: Bǎ tāngchí fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
choices.english: Leave the spoons on the table.

questions.why: 請把碗筷、湯匙放在桌子上，不用拿到廚房: spoons stay on the table. Empty drink cups go in the trash can by the door, and nobody needs to carry dishes to the kitchen.

text.traditional:
姐姐：
我已經把碗筷洗完了，也擦乾了。垃圾太多，我先放在門口，等一下出門的時候再拿到樓下。我七點跟同學去看電影，十點以前會到家。
弟弟
text.simplified:
姐姐：
我已经把碗筷洗完了，也擦干了。垃圾太多，我先放在门口，等一下出门的时候再拿到楼下。我七点跟同学去看电影，十点以前会到家。
弟弟
text.pinyin:
Jiějie:
Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ wǎnkuài xǐ wán le, yě cāgān le. Lèsè tài duō, wǒ xiān fàng zài ménkǒu, děng yíxià chūmén de shíhòu zài ná dào lóuxià. Wǒ qī diǎn gēn tóngxué qù kàn diànyǐng, shí diǎn yǐqián huì dào jiā.
Dìdi
text.english:
Big sister,
I've finished washing the dishes and dried them too. There's a lot of garbage, so I've put it by the door for now; I'll take it downstairs when I go out in a bit. At seven I'm going to a movie with my classmates, and I'll be home before ten.
Your little brother

prompt.traditional: 弟弟已經做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟已经做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi yǐjīng zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What has the younger brother already done?

questions.why: 我已經把碗筷洗完了，也擦乾了: the dishes are done. The garbage only waits by the door until he goes out, and the movie is at seven, later.

女兒
text.simplified:
爸爸、妈妈：
今天中午我已经把家事都做完了，地扫了，桌子也擦了。下午我要跟同学去图书馆念书，晚饭在外面吃，九点以前会到家。
女儿

Bàba, māma:
Jīntiān zhōngwǔ wǒ yǐjīng bǎ jiāshì dōu zuò wán le, dì sǎo le, zhuōzi yě cā le. Xiàwǔ wǒ yào gēn tóngxué qù túshūguǎn niànshū, wǎnfàn zài wàimiàn chī, jiǔ diǎn yǐqián huì dào jiā.
Nǚ'ér
text.english:
Mom and Dad,
At noon today I finished all the housework: the floor is swept and the table wiped. This afternoon I'm going to the library to study with classmates. I'll have dinner out and be home before nine.
Your daughter

prompt.traditional: 女兒今天中午做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女儿今天中午做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ'ér jīntiān zhōngwǔ zuò le shénme?

questions.why: 中午我已經把家事都做完了，地掃了，桌子也擦了: at noon she finished the housework. The library is for this afternoon, and dinner is this evening, outside.

versions.alt: A bright stairwell seen from low down. A young man with short dark-brown hair is coming down the stairs toward us. He wears a green shirt, open, with its sleeves rolled up, over a red T-shirt with thin light stripes, black trousers and white sneakers with blue stripes. He smiles a little and looks down at his hand, which holds a full black garbage bag, tied at the top, over a big blue trash bin in the front right corner. Behind him at the top of the stairs a wooden door stands open. On the left is a dark metal railing, and at the far end of the hall an opening shows blue sky, a white cloud and a green tree. It is daytime.

prompt.traditional: 他手上拿著一個＿＿的袋子。
prompt.simplified: 他手上拿着一个＿＿的袋子。

answer.traditional: 他手上拿著一個黑色的袋子。
answer.simplified: 他手上拿着一个黑色的袋子。
answer.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng názhe yí ge hēisè de dàizi.
answer.english: He is holding a black bag.

prompt.traditional: ——你要去上課了嗎？——對，可是我得先把這些垃圾＿＿。
prompt.simplified: ——你要去上课了吗？——对，可是我得先把这些垃圾＿＿。

answer.traditional: ——你要去上課了嗎？——對，可是我得先把這些垃圾倒一倒。
answer.simplified: ——你要去上课了吗？——对，可是我得先把这些垃圾倒一倒。
answer.pinyin: ——Nǐ yào qù shàngkè le ma? ——Duì, kěshì wǒ děi xiān bǎ zhèxiē lèsè dào yí dào.
answer.english: "Are you off to class?" "Yes, but first I have to take out this garbage."

questions.why: Garbage is taken out (倒垃圾), and 把 + thing + V一V makes it a quick, light job: 把垃圾倒一倒. Nobody washes or wipes a bag of garbage.

prompt.traditional: 他已經把房間打掃＿＿，現在要去上課。
prompt.simplified: 他已经把房间打扫＿＿，现在要去上课。

answer.traditional: 他已經把房間打掃了，現在要去上課。
answer.simplified: 他已经把房间打扫了，现在要去上课。
answer.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo le, xiànzài yào qù shàngkè.
answer.english: He has already cleaned his room and is now off to class.

questions.why: 把 + thing + V了 says the job is done: 把房間打掃了. 打掃給 would need a person after it, and 把…打掃著 is not how a finished job is said.

versions.alt: A bright stairwell seen from low down. A young man with short dark-brown hair is coming down the stairs toward us. He wears a green shirt, open, with its sleeves rolled up, over a red T-shirt with thin light stripes, black trousers and white sneakers with blue stripes. He smiles a little and looks down at his hand, which holds a full black garbage bag, tied at the top, over a big blue trash bin in the front right corner. Behind him at the top of the stairs a wooden door stands open. On the left is a dark metal railing, and at the far end of the hall an opening shows blue sky, a white cloud and a green tree. It is daytime.

prompt.traditional: 他手上拿著垃圾，在＿＿樓梯。
prompt.simplified: 他手上拿着垃圾，在＿＿楼梯。

answer.traditional: 他手上拿著垃圾，在下樓梯。
answer.simplified: 他手上拿着垃圾，在下楼梯。
answer.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng názhe lèsè, zài xià lóutī.
answer.english: He is going down the stairs with garbage in his hand.

questions.why: The open door is at the top behind him and he is stepping down toward us, so he is going down (下) the stairs. He is not sweeping them.

prompt.traditional: 他想先把手上的垃圾＿＿，再去上課。
prompt.simplified: 他想先把手上的垃圾＿＿，再去上课。

answer.traditional: 他想先把手上的垃圾丟一丟，再去上課。
answer.simplified: 他想先把手上的垃圾丢一丢，再去上课。
answer.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiān bǎ shǒu shàng de lèsè diū yì diū, zài qù shàngkè.
answer.english: He wants to throw out the garbage in his hand first, then go to class.

questions.why: The garbage is in his hand, so he throws it out: 把垃圾丟一丟, a quick, light job. 掃 is for garbage on the floor, and nobody wipes a bag of garbage.

prompt.traditional: 他已經把廚房的垃圾倒＿＿，現在手上拿的是房間的垃圾。
prompt.simplified: 他已经把厨房的垃圾倒＿＿，现在手上拿的是房间的垃圾。

answer.simplified: 他已经把厨房的垃圾倒了，现在手上拿的是房间的垃圾。
answer.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bǎ chúfáng de lèsè dào le, xiànzài shǒu shàng ná de shì fángjiān de lèsè.
answer.english: He has already taken out the kitchen garbage; what he's holding now is the garbage from his room.

questions.why: 把 + thing + V了: 把廚房的垃圾倒了, that garbage is already out. 倒給 would need a person after it, and 把垃圾倒著 is not how a finished job is said.

passage.traditional: 開學以後，我每天都很忙，已經兩個星期沒打掃房間了。我的房間裡{1}都是書和衣服，桌子上還有沒吃完的東西。昨天晚上，我在床上看見了兩隻{2}，真不舒服。媽媽以前常常告訴我，房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人{3}會覺得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把髒衣服都{4}了，再把地掃一掃。
passage.simplified: 开学以后，我每天都很忙，已经两个星期没打扫房间了。我的房间里{1}都是书和衣服，桌子上还有没吃完的东西。昨天晚上，我在床上看见了两只{2}，真不舒服。妈妈以前常常告诉我，房间要每天打扫，住在里面的人{3}会觉得舒服。所以今天我很早就起床，先把脏衣服都{4}了，再把地扫一扫。
passage.pinyin: Kāixué yǐhòu, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le. Wǒ de fángjiān lǐ dàochù dōu shì shū hé yīfu, zhuōzi shàng hái yǒu méi chī wán de dōngxi. Zuótiān wǎnshàng, wǒ zài chuáng shàng kànjiàn le liǎng zhī chóngzi, zhēn bù shūfu. Māma yǐqián chángcháng gàosu wǒ, fángjiān yào měi tiān dǎsǎo, zhù zài lǐmiàn de rén cái huì juéde shūfu. Suǒyǐ jīntiān wǒ hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng, xiān bǎ zāng yīfu dōu xǐ le, zài bǎ dì sǎo yì sǎo.
passage.english: Since school started I've been busy every day, and I haven't cleaned my room for two weeks. There are books and clothes everywhere in my room, and leftover food on the desk. Last night I saw two bugs on my bed, which was really unpleasant. Mom always used to tell me a room should be cleaned every day; only then do the people living in it feel comfortable. So today I got up early, washed all my dirty clothes first, and then swept the floor.

questions.why: 到處都是…: books and clothes are everywhere in the messy room.
兩隻蟲子: 隻 counts animals and bugs, and he saw two of them on his bed.
房間要每天打掃，住在裡面的人才會覺得舒服: 才 brings in the result that comes only when the condition is met.
把 + thing + V了: 把髒衣服都洗了, he washed all the dirty clothes before sweeping the floor.

passage.traditional: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花蓮玩了一個星期。回家的時候，一打開門，就覺得味道很{1}。原來出門以前，哥哥忘了把廚房的窗戶{2}了，桌子上的水果也都壞了，到處都是小蟲子。那天晚上，我們{3}都沒吃，大家先一起打掃了兩個小時。媽媽說，下次出門以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡{4}不會有蟲子。
passage.simplified: 今年暑假，我跟家人去花莲玩了一个星期。回家的时候，一打开门，就觉得味道很{1}。原来出门以前，哥哥忘了把厨房的窗户{2}了，桌子上的水果也都坏了，到处都是小虫子。那天晚上，我们{3}都没吃，大家先一起打扫了两个小时。妈妈说，下次出门以前，一定要先把桌子上的水果吃完，家里{4}不会有虫子。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián shǔjià, wǒ gēn jiārén qù Huālián wán le yí ge xīngqí. Huí jiā de shíhòu, yì dǎkāi mén, jiù juéde wèidào hěn chòu. Yuánlái chūmén yǐqián, gēge wàng le bǎ chúfáng de chuānghù guān le, zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ yě dōu huài le, dàochù dōu shì xiǎo chóngzi. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen shénme dōu méi chī, dàjiā xiān yìqǐ dǎsǎo le liǎng ge xiǎoshí. Māma shuō, xià cì chūmén yǐqián, yídìng yào xiān bǎ zhuōzi shàng de shuǐguǒ chī wán, jiā lǐ cái bú huì yǒu chóngzi.
passage.english: This summer vacation my family and I spent a week in Hualien. When we got home and opened the door, it smelled awful. It turned out that before we left, my older brother had forgotten to close the kitchen window; the fruit on the table had gone bad, and there were little bugs everywhere. That night none of us ate anything; we all cleaned together for two hours first. Mom says next time we have to finish the fruit on the table before we leave; only then won't there be bugs at home.

questions.why: 味道很臭: after a week away, the bad fruit made the house smell awful.
把 + thing + V了: 把窗戶關了, close the window. He forgot to, so bugs came in.
什麼都沒吃: a question word + 都 + 沒 means "nothing at all"; they cleaned before eating anything.
先把桌子上的水果吃完，家裡才不會有蟲子: only when the fruit is finished first will there be no bugs.

text.traditional: 昨天弟弟沒去上課，他說他頭很痛，想在家休息。媽媽覺得他可能感冒了，可是他沒發燒，也不咳嗽，晚飯還吃了兩碗，功課也都寫完了。晚上媽媽問了他很久，他才說，他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的。
text.simplified: 昨天弟弟没去上课，他说他头很痛，想在家休息。妈妈觉得他可能感冒了，可是他没发烧，也不咳嗽，晚饭还吃了两碗，功课也都写完了。晚上妈妈问了他很久，他才说，他是因为把同学的小说丢了，才不敢去学校的。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān dìdi méi qù shàngkè, tā shuō tā tóu hěn tòng, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxí. Māma juéde tā kěnéng gǎnmào le, kěshì tā méi fāshāo, yě bù késòu, wǎnfàn hái chī le liǎng wǎn, gōngkè yě dōu xiě wán le. Wǎnshàng māma wèn le tā hěn jiǔ, tā cái shuō, tā shì yīnwèi bǎ tóngxué de xiǎoshuō diū le, cái bù gǎn qù xuéxiào de.
text.english: Yesterday my little brother didn't go to school; he said he had a bad headache and wanted to rest at home. Mom thought he might have a cold, but he had no fever, wasn't coughing, ate two bowls at dinner, and had finished all his homework. In the evening Mom asked him for a long time before he said that he had lost a classmate's novel, and that was the only reason he hadn't dared go to school.

prompt.traditional: 弟弟昨天為什麼沒去上課？
prompt.simplified: 弟弟昨天为什么没去上课？
prompt.pinyin: Dìdi zuótiān wèishénme méi qù shàngkè?
prompt.english: Why didn't the little brother go to school yesterday?

choices.pinyin: Tā de tóu tòng de bù néng qù.
choices.english: His head hurt too much to go.
He had a cold and a fever.

choices.pinyin: Tā de gōngkè hái méi xiě wán.
Tā diū le tóngxué de xiǎoshuō.
choices.english: He had lost a classmate's novel.

questions.why: 他是因為把同學的小說丟了，才不敢去學校的: losing a classmate's novel is the real reason. The headache was only his excuse, there was no fever or cough, and his homework was all done.

text.traditional: 我很喜歡看小說，可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放。上個月，我把一些小說送給了對面鄰居的兒子。鄰居說，以前她每天都叫兒子念書，可是他什麼書都不想看。後來是因為看了我送的小說，他才開始喜歡看書。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢看小说，可是房间太小，书太多，没有地方放。上个月，我把一些小说送给了对面邻居的儿子。邻居说，以前她每天都叫儿子念书，可是他什么书都不想看。后来是因为看了我送的小说，他才开始喜欢看书。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xiǎoshuō, kěshì fángjiān tài xiǎo, shū tài duō, méiyǒu dìfāng fàng. Shàng ge yuè, wǒ bǎ yìxiē xiǎoshuō sòng gěi le duìmiàn línjū de érzi. Línjū shuō, yǐqián tā měi tiān dōu jiào érzi niànshū, kěshì tā shénme shū dōu bù xiǎng kàn. Hòulái shì yīnwèi kàn le wǒ sòng de xiǎoshuō, tā cái kāishǐ xǐhuān kàn shū.
text.english: I love reading novels, but my room is too small and I have too many books, so there's nowhere to put them. Last month I gave some novels to my neighbor's son across the hall. My neighbor says she used to tell her son to study every day, but he didn't want to read any book at all. It was only after reading the novels I gave him that he started to like reading.

prompt.traditional: 這個人為什麼把小說送給鄰居的兒子？
prompt.simplified: 这个人为什么把小说送给邻居的儿子？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén wèishénme bǎ xiǎoshuō sòng gěi línjū de érzi?
prompt.english: Why did the writer give novels to the neighbor's son?

choices.traditional: 他的房間沒有地方放書
choices.simplified: 他的房间没有地方放书
choices.pinyin: Tā de fángjiān méiyǒu dìfāng fàng shū.
choices.english: His room has no space for books.

choices.pinyin: Línjū de érzi hěn ài kàn shū.
Línjū qǐng tā sòng yìxiē shū.
choices.english: The neighbor asked him for some books.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bú ài kàn xiǎoshuō le.

questions.why: 可是房間太小，書太多，沒有地方放: there is no space for the books, so he gave some away. He still loves novels, the neighbor never asked for books, and her son did not like reading at the time (什麼書都不想看).

text.traditional: 我們家有四個人，每個人都得做一件家事：爸爸做飯，媽媽洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做。後來媽媽說，吃飯吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我們都吃得很慢，可是現在大家都吃得很快。
text.simplified: 我们家有四个人，每个人都得做一件家事：爸爸做饭，妈妈洗衣服，我擦桌子，弟弟倒垃圾。可是洗碗这件事，我们谁都不想做。后来妈妈说，吃饭吃得最慢的人得洗碗。爸爸做的菜很好吃，以前我们都吃得很慢，可是现在大家都吃得很快。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā yǒu sì ge rén, měi ge rén dōu děi zuò yí jiàn jiāshì: bàba zuò fàn, māma xǐ yīfu, wǒ cā zhuōzi, dìdi dào lèsè. Kěshì xǐ wǎn zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen shéi dōu bù xiǎng zuò. Hòulái māma shuō, chī fàn chī de zuì màn de rén děi xǐ wǎn. Bàba zuò de cài hěn hǎochī, yǐqián wǒmen dōu chī de hěn màn, kěshì xiànzài dàjiā dōu chī de hěn kuài.
text.english: There are four of us at home, and each has one chore: Dad cooks, Mom does the laundry, I wipe the table, and my little brother takes out the garbage. But washing the dishes is something none of us wants to do. Then Mom said the slowest eater has to wash up. Dad's cooking is delicious and we used to eat slowly, but now everyone eats fast.

prompt.traditional: 現在他們家的人為什麼吃飯吃得很快？
prompt.simplified: 现在他们家的人为什么吃饭吃得很快？
prompt.pinyin: Xiànzài tāmen jiā de rén wèishénme chī fàn chī de hěn kuài?
prompt.english: Why does the family eat fast now?

choices.traditional: 他們都不想當洗碗的人
choices.simplified: 他们都不想当洗碗的人
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu bù xiǎng dāng xǐ wǎn de rén.
choices.english: None of them wants to be the one who washes up.

choices.traditional: 他們都很喜歡爸爸做的菜
choices.simplified: 他们都很喜欢爸爸做的菜
choices.pinyin: Tāmen dōu hěn xǐhuān bàba zuò de cài.

choices.traditional: 他們吃完飯都得做家事
choices.simplified: 他们吃完饭都得做家事
choices.pinyin: Tāmen chī wán fàn dōu děi zuò jiāshì.
choices.english: They all have chores to do after dinner.

choices.traditional: 弟弟吃完飯得去倒垃圾
choices.simplified: 弟弟吃完饭得去倒垃圾
choices.pinyin: Dìdi chī wán fàn děi qù dào lèsè.
choices.english: The little brother has to take out the garbage after dinner.

questions.why: 洗碗這件事，我們誰都不想做, and the slowest eater has to wash up, so nobody wants to be last. They do love Dad's cooking, but that is why they used to eat slowly, and nothing says the chores come right after dinner (Dad cooks before it).

text.traditional: 我是從高雄來台北念大學的。開學第一天，我在宿舍誰也不認識，晚飯也不知道要去哪裡吃。後來，住在我對面的同學來找我，帶我去學校附近的夜市。她說那裡的東西什麼都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗湯。現在我們常常一起去吃晚飯。
text.simplified: 我是从高雄来台北念大学的。开学第一天，我在宿舍谁也不认识，晚饭也不知道要去哪里吃。后来，住在我对面的同学来找我，带我去学校附近的夜市。她说那里的东西什么都好吃，可是我那天只喝了一碗汤。现在我们常常一起去吃晚饭。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Gāoxióng lái Táiběi niàn dàxué de. Kāixué dì yī tiān, wǒ zài sùshè shéi yě bú rènshì, wǎnfàn yě bù zhīdào yào qù nǎlǐ chī. Hòulái, zhù zài wǒ duìmiàn de tóngxué lái zhǎo wǒ, dài wǒ qù xuéxiào fùjìn de yèshì. Tā shuō nàlǐ de dōngxi shénme dōu hǎochī, kěshì wǒ nà tiān zhǐ hē le yì wǎn tāng. Xiànzài wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
text.english: I came from Kaohsiung to Taipei for university. On the first day of school I knew nobody in the dorm and didn't even know where to go for dinner. Then the student living across from me came over and took me to the night market near school. She said everything there is tasty, but that day I only had a bowl of soup. Now we often have dinner together.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.traditional: 對面的同學是從高雄來的
choices.simplified: 对面的同学是从高雄来的
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué shì cóng Gāoxióng lái de.
choices.english: The student across the hall is from Kaohsiung.

choices.traditional: 對面的同學覺得夜市的東西都好吃
choices.simplified: 对面的同学觉得夜市的东西都好吃
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué juéde yèshì de dōngxi dōu hǎochī.
choices.english: The student across the hall finds all the night market food tasty.

choices.traditional: 對面的同學那天只喝了湯
choices.simplified: 对面的同学那天只喝了汤
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué nà tiān zhǐ hē le tāng.
choices.english: The student across the hall only had soup that day.

choices.traditional: 對面的同學開學的時候誰也不認識
choices.simplified: 对面的同学开学的时候谁也不认识
choices.pinyin: Duìmiàn de tóngxué kāixué de shíhòu shéi yě bú rènshì.
choices.english: The student across the hall knew nobody when school started.

questions.why: 她說那裡的東西什麼都好吃: the student across the hall says everything at the night market is good. Coming from Kaohsiung, knowing nobody (誰也不認識) and having only soup are all about the writer.

text.traditional: 我的鄰居是一位老太太，她一個人住。她的個性很溫柔，不但對我們很客氣，也常常做包子送給我們吃。上個星期她背疼，不能出門，我就幫她去附近的藥局買藥。她說，能有我們這樣的鄰居，她覺得很幸運。
text.simplified: 我的邻居是一位老太太，她一个人住。她的个性很温柔，不但对我们很客气，也常常做包子送给我们吃。上个星期她背疼，不能出门，我就帮她去附近的药局买药。她说，能有我们这样的邻居，她觉得很幸运。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de línjū shì yí wèi lǎo tàitai, tā yí ge rén zhù. Tā de gèxìng hěn wēnróu, búdàn duì wǒmen hěn kèqì, yě chángcháng zuò bāozi sòng gěi wǒmen chī. Shàng ge xīngqí tā bèi téng, bù néng chūmén, wǒ jiù bāng tā qù fùjìn de yàojú mǎi yào. Tā shuō, néng yǒu wǒmen zhèyàng de línjū, tā juéde hěn xìngyùn.
text.english: My neighbor is an old lady who lives alone. She's gentle; she is not only polite to us but also often makes steamed buns for us. Last week her back hurt and she couldn't go out, so I went to a nearby pharmacy to buy medicine for her. She says she feels lucky to have neighbors like us.

prompt.traditional: 這位老太太怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这位老太太怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo tàitai zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is true of the old lady?

choices.traditional: 老太太跟家人住在一起
choices.simplified: 老太太跟家人住在一起
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai gēn jiārén zhù zài yìqǐ.
choices.english: The old lady lives with her family.

choices.traditional: 老太太常常幫鄰居買藥
choices.simplified: 老太太常常帮邻居买药
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tàitai chángcháng bāng línjū mǎi yào.
choices.english: The old lady often buys medicine for her neighbors.

choices.pinyin: Tā de bèi chángcháng hěn téng.

choices.traditional: 老太太上個星期沒辦法出門
choices.simplified: 老太太上个星期没办法出门

questions.why: 上個星期她背疼，不能出門: last week her back kept her at home. She lives alone (一個人住), the medicine was bought for her (not by her), and it was her back that hurt, not the writer's.

text.traditional: 我家離學校很近，走路十分鐘就到了。我姐姐的公司離家很遠，她每天得先坐公車到捷運站，再坐四十分鐘的捷運，一共要一個多小時。所以姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來。週末的時候，她都在家休息，哪裡都不去。
text.simplified: 我家离学校很近，走路十分钟就到了。我姐姐的公司离家很远，她每天得先坐公车到捷运站，再坐四十分钟的捷运，一共要一个多小时。所以姐姐每天早上六点就起床了，我七点半才起来。周末的时候，她都在家休息，哪里都不去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Wǒ jiějie de gōngsī lí jiā hěn yuǎn, tā měi tiān děi xiān zuò gōngchē dào jiéyùn zhàn, zài zuò sìshí fēnzhōng de jiéyùn, yígòng yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí. Suǒyǐ jiějie měi tiān zǎoshàng liù diǎn jiù qǐchuáng le, wǒ qī diǎn bàn cái qǐlái. Zhōumò de shíhòu, tā dōu zài jiā xiūxí, nǎlǐ dōu bú qù.
text.english: My home is very close to school: ten minutes on foot. My older sister's office is far from home. Every day she first takes a bus to the MRT station, then rides the MRT for forty minutes, over an hour in all. So she gets up at six every morning, while I don't get up until half past seven. On weekends she rests at home and goes nowhere.

prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.traditional: 姐姐的公司離她家只有十分鐘
choices.simplified: 姐姐的公司离她家只有十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie de gōngsī lí tā jiā zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's office is only ten minutes from home.

choices.traditional: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分鐘
choices.simplified: 姐姐到公司一共要四十分钟
choices.pinyin: Jiějie dào gōngsī yígòng yào sìshí fēnzhōng.
choices.english: The sister's trip to work takes forty minutes in all.

choices.traditional: 姐姐每天比這個人早起床
choices.simplified: 姐姐每天比这个人早起床
choices.pinyin: Jiějie měi tiān bǐ zhège rén zǎo qǐchuáng.
choices.english: The sister gets up earlier than the writer every day.

choices.traditional: 姐姐週末常常跟朋友出去玩
choices.simplified: 姐姐周末常常跟朋友出去玩
choices.pinyin: Jiějie zhōumò chángcháng gēn péngyǒu chūqù wán.
choices.english: The sister often goes out with friends on weekends.

questions.why: 姐姐每天早上六點就起床了，我七點半才起來: six is earlier than half past seven. Ten minutes is the writer's walk to school, her whole trip (bus, then forty minutes on the MRT) is over an hour, and on weekends she stays home (哪裡都不去).

picture.alt: Daytime, sunny. The view is from an apartment's open front door into a bright living room. In the doorway on the left stand two young people: a young man with black hair, an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt, black trousers and a black backpack, his hands in his pockets; and next to him a young woman with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top, wide white trousers and a black bag on her shoulder. Both smile at an older woman who stands inside the apartment facing them: her hair is in a bun and she wears a mustard-yellow cardigan over a long dark-green dress; she smiles, holds one open hand toward them and stretches her other arm out toward the rooms, inviting them in. Her hands are empty. Behind her is the living room: a white sofa with a yellow and a blue cushion, a low wooden table in front of it with a small plant and a book on it, a lamp with a white shade, a tall green plant, a framed picture on the wall and a big window with city buildings outside. There is no television and no bookshelf. On the right, through a wide opening, is the kitchen: a tall white refrigerator, wooden cupboards, a wooden table with chairs and a lamp hanging from the ceiling. Nobody is sitting down.

lines.simplified: 很不错！除了离公司很近，附近还有一个大公园，我每天早上都去那里跑步。

lines.english: It's great! Besides being close to my office, there's a big park nearby. I go running there every morning.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 房子大不大？
lines.simplified: 房子大不大？
lines.pinyin: Fángzi dà bú dà?
lines.english: Is the place big?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不太大，只有一間臥室，也沒有書房。可是我一個人住，夠了。
lines.simplified: 不太大，只有一间卧室，也没有书房。可是我一个人住，够了。
lines.pinyin: Bú tài dà, zhǐ yǒu yì jiān wòshì, yě méiyǒu shūfáng. Kěshì wǒ yígerén zhù, gòu le.
lines.english: Not very. There's only one bedroom and no study. But I live alone, so it's enough.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 房租呢？
lines.simplified: 房租呢？
lines.pinyin: Fángzū ne?
lines.english: And the rent?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一個月一萬八，不便宜，可是我很滿意。
lines.simplified: 一个月一万八，不便宜，可是我很满意。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè yíwàn bā, bù piányí, kěshì wǒ hěn mǎnyì.
lines.english: Eighteen thousand a month. It isn't cheap, but I'm very happy with it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的新租的房子怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的新租的房子怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xīn zū de fángzi zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the man's new place like?

choices.english: It's easy to get to a park.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 除了離公司很近，附近還有一個大公園: besides being close to his office, the place has a big park nearby, where he runs every morning. The rent (18,000) isn't cheap, and he has one bedroom and no study.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這張書桌，我們搬進臥室去吧。
lines.simplified: 这张书桌，我们搬进卧室去吧。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhāng shūzhuō, wǒmen bān jìn wòshì qù ba.
lines.english: Let's carry this desk into the bedroom.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 臥室裡已經有床和大衣櫃了，書桌放進去，就沒地方走路了。
lines.simplified: 卧室里已经有床和大衣柜了，书桌放进去，就没地方走路了。
lines.pinyin: Wòshì lǐ yǐjīng yǒu chuáng hé dà yīguì le, shūzhuō fàng jìnqù, jiù méi dìfāng zǒulù le.
lines.english: There's already a bed and a big wardrobe in the bedroom. If we put the desk in, there'll be no room to walk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那放在客廳吧，客廳比較大。
lines.simplified: 那放在客厅吧，客厅比较大。
lines.pinyin: Nà fàng zài kètīng ba, kètīng bǐjiào dà.
lines.english: Then let's put it in the living room. It's bigger.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是客廳太吵，我沒辦法念書。我們把衣櫃搬出來，放在客廳，書桌還是放進臥室去。
lines.simplified: 可是客厅太吵，我没办法念书。我们把衣柜搬出来，放在客厅，书桌还是放进卧室去。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì kètīng tài chǎo, wǒ méi bànfǎ niànshū. Wǒmen bǎ yīguì bān chūlái, fàng zài kètīng, shūzhuō háishì fàng jìn wòshì qù.
lines.english: But the living room is too noisy; I can't study there. Let's move the wardrobe out into the living room, and the desk still goes into the bedroom.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，聽你的。
lines.simplified: 好，听你的。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, tīng nǐ de.
lines.english: OK, we'll do it your way.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼放？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么放？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme fàng?
prompt.english: In the end, how did they decide to arrange things?

choices.traditional: 書桌和衣櫃都放在臥室
choices.simplified: 书桌和衣柜都放在卧室
choices.pinyin: Shūzhuō hé yīguì dōu fàng zài wòshì.
choices.english: The desk and the wardrobe both in the bedroom.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: The desk in the living room, the wardrobe in the bedroom.

choices.simplified: 书桌放卧室，衣柜放客厅
choices.pinyin: Shūzhuō fàng wòshì, yīguì fàng kètīng.

choices.english: The desk and the wardrobe both in the living room.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 我們把衣櫃搬出來，放在客廳，書桌還是放進臥室去: the wardrobe comes out into the living room and the desk goes into the bedroom after all. Both in the bedroom was the first idea; the desk in the living room was the woman's second idea.

focus.zh: 把衣櫃搬出來，書桌放進臥室去
focus.en: wardrobe out, desk into the bedroom

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個月我就要回美國了。這十本中文書，妳要不要？
lines.simplified: 下个月我就要回美国了。这十本中文书，你要不要？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ jiù yào huí Měiguó le. Zhè shí běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ yào bú yào?
lines.english: I'm going back to America next month. Do you want these ten Chinese books?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不帶回美國去嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不带回美国去吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú dài huí Měiguó qù ma?
lines.english: Aren't you taking them back to America?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 書太重了，我只帶三本回去，剩下的都送給妳。
lines.simplified: 书太重了，我只带三本回去，剩下的都送给你。
lines.pinyin: Shū tài zhòng le, wǒ zhǐ dài sān běn huíqù, shèngxià de dōu sòng gěi nǐ.
lines.english: Books are too heavy. I'm only taking three back; the rest are yours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 謝謝你！那你的腳踏車呢？
lines.simplified: 谢谢你！那你的脚踏车呢？
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ! Nà nǐ de jiǎotàchē ne?
lines.english: Thank you! What about your bike?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 已經賣給我室友了，他明天會來拿。
lines.simplified: 已经卖给我室友了，他明天会来拿。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng mài gěi wǒ shìyǒu le, tā míngtiān huì lái ná.
lines.english: I've sold it to my roommate. He's coming to get it tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的會送給女的幾本中文書？
prompt.simplified: 男的会送给女的几本中文书？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de huì sòng gěi nǚ de jǐ běn Zhōngwén shū?
prompt.english: How many Chinese books will the man give the woman?

questions.why: He has ten Chinese books and takes only three back to America (帶三本回去), so the other seven (剩下的) go to the woman. Three is what he keeps; ten is all of them.

focus.zh: 帶三本回去，剩下的送給妳
focus.en: takes three back, gives her the rest

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 昨天的球賽怎麼樣？好看嗎？
lines.simplified: 昨天的球赛怎么样？好看吗？
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān de qiúsài zěnmeyàng? Hǎokàn ma?
lines.english: How was yesterday's game? Was it good?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很好看！可是本來七點要開始，因為下雨，八點半才開始，我十一點才到家。
lines.simplified: 很好看！可是本来七点要开始，因为下雨，八点半才开始，我十一点才到家。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn! Kěshì běnlái qī diǎn yào kāishǐ, yīnwèi xiàyǔ, bā diǎn bàn cái kāishǐ, wǒ shíyī diǎn cái dào jiā.
lines.english: Very good! But it was supposed to start at seven; because of the rain it didn't start until half past eight, and I didn't get home until eleven.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 球賽是幾點開始的？
prompt.simplified: 球赛是几点开始的？
prompt.pinyin: Qiúsài shì jǐ diǎn kāishǐ de?
prompt.english: What time did the game start?

questions.why: 本來七點要開始……八點半才開始: it was meant to start at seven, but because of the rain it didn't start until half past eight. Eleven is when she got home.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我的手機呢？我記得放在桌子上了，房間裡也找了，都沒有。
lines.simplified: 我的手机呢？我记得放在桌子上了，房间里也找了，都没有。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī ne? Wǒ jìde fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le, fángjiān lǐ yě zhǎo le, dōu méiyǒu.
lines.english: Where's my phone? I remember putting it on the table, and I've looked in my room too. It isn't anywhere.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天回來的時候，把手機放在門口的鞋子旁邊了。我看到了。
lines.simplified: 你昨天回来的时候，把手机放在门口的鞋子旁边了。我看到了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān huílái de shíhòu, bǎ shǒujī fàng zài ménkǒu de xiézi pángbiān le. Wǒ kàndào le.
lines.english: When you came back yesterday, you put your phone next to the shoes by the door. I saw it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 手機在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 手机在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Shǒujī zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the phone?

questions.why: 把手機放在門口的鞋子旁邊了: yesterday he left his phone by the shoes at the door. He only thinks he put it on the table, and he has already looked in his room.

focus.en: put the phone by the door

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下午三點的電影，你要不要一起去看？
lines.simplified: 下午三点的电影，你要不要一起去看？
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ sān diǎn de diànyǐng, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù kàn?
lines.english: Do you want to come and see the three o'clock movie this afternoon?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我不能去。我得先把家裡打掃完，六點有客人要來我家吃飯。
lines.simplified: 我不能去。我得先把家里打扫完，六点有客人要来我家吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng qù. Wǒ děi xiān bǎ jiālǐ dǎsǎo wán, liù diǎn yǒu kèrén yào lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
lines.english: I can't. I have to finish cleaning the house first; guests are coming to my place for dinner at six.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們看晚上九點的那場，好不好？
lines.simplified: 那我们看晚上九点的那场，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen kàn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn de nà chǎng, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Then shall we see the nine o'clock showing?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊。可是客人吃完飯，我還得把碗筷洗完才能出門。我們九點在電影院門口見吧。
lines.simplified: 好啊。可是客人吃完饭，我还得把碗筷洗完才能出门。我们九点在电影院门口见吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Kěshì kèrén chī wán fàn, wǒ hái děi bǎ wǎnkuài xǐ wán cái néng chūmén. Wǒmen jiǔ diǎn zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu jiàn ba.
lines.english: OK. But after the guests have eaten, I still have to finish washing the dishes before I can go out. Let's meet at the cinema entrance at nine.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼不能看下午三點的電影？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么不能看下午三点的电影？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bù néng kàn xiàwǔ sān diǎn de diànyǐng?
prompt.english: Why can't the man see the three o'clock movie?

choices.english: He has to clean the house first.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He has to wash the dishes.
choices.speaker: N

choices.english: His guests are coming at three.
choices.speaker: N

choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kàn jiǔ diǎn nà chǎng.
choices.english: He wants to see the nine o'clock showing.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 我得先把家裡打掃完，六點有客人要來: he must finish cleaning the house before his guests come at six, so he can't go at three. The dishes come after dinner, and the nine o'clock showing is the woman's later idea.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳上個週末去花蓮了，玩得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 听说你上个周末去花莲了，玩得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù Huālián le, wán de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I heard you went to Hualien last weekend. How was it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 雖然下了兩天的雨，可是我們玩得很開心。
lines.simplified: 虽然下了两天的雨，可是我们玩得很开心。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán xià le liǎng tiān de yǔ, kěshì wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn.
lines.english: Although it rained for two days, we had a great time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下雨還能去哪裡玩？
lines.simplified: 下雨还能去哪里玩？
lines.pinyin: Xiàyǔ hái néng qù nǎlǐ wán?
lines.english: Where can you go when it rains?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第一天我們在旅館休息，晚上去夜市吃東西。第二天太魯閣不能去，我們就在海邊的咖啡廳一邊喝咖啡，一邊看海。
lines.simplified: 第一天我们在旅馆休息，晚上去夜市吃东西。第二天太鲁阁不能去，我们就在海边的咖啡厅一边喝咖啡，一边看海。
lines.pinyin: Dì yī tiān wǒmen zài lǚguǎn xiūxí, wǎnshàng qù yèshì chī dōngxi. Dì èr tiān Tàilǔgé bù néng qù, wǒmen jiù zài hǎibiān de kāfēitīng yìbiān hē kāfēi, yìbiān kàn hǎi.
lines.english: On the first day we rested at the hotel and went to the night market for food in the evening. On the second day we couldn't go to Taroko, so we sat in a café by the sea, drinking coffee and watching the sea.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的第二天做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的第二天做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dì èr tiān zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the woman do on the second day?

choices.english: Watched the sea from a café.
choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 第二天……一邊喝咖啡，一邊看海: on the second day they sat in a café by the sea, drinking coffee and watching the sea. The hotel and the night market were the first day, and Taroko was out because of the rain.

prompt.traditional: 住這間公寓，除了房租，每個月還要付什麼？
prompt.simplified: 住这间公寓，除了房租，每个月还要付什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhù zhè jiān gōngyù, chúle fángzū, měi ge yuè hái yào fù shénme?
prompt.english: Living in this apartment, what else do you pay every month besides the rent?

questions.why: The rent includes water and the internet but not electricity (不包括電費), so the electricity bill is paid on top of it every month. The deposit is paid once, not every month.

prompt.traditional: 房租最多一萬元，也要有洗衣機，應該租哪裡的房子？
prompt.simplified: 房租最多一万元，也要有洗衣机，应该租哪里的房子？
prompt.pinyin: Fángzū zuì duō yíwàn yuán, yě yào yǒu xǐyījī, yīnggāi zū nǎlǐ de fángzi?
prompt.english: With a rent of at most 10,000 a month and a washing machine, which place should you rent?
