lines.traditional: 假日的KTV常常客滿，我們最好先打電話訂位。
lines.simplified: 假日的KTV常常客满，我们最好先打电话订位。
lines.pinyin: Jiàrì de KTV chángcháng kèmǎn, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
lines.english: KTV is often full on holidays. We'd better call ahead and book.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我打過了，星期六已經客滿了，只好星期五晚上去。
lines.simplified: 我打过了，星期六已经客满了，只好星期五晚上去。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ guo le, xīngqíliù yǐjīng kèmǎn le, zhǐhǎo xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng qù.
lines.english: I've called. Saturday is already full, so we'll have to go on Friday evening.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 星期五我上課上到九點，等我下了課，就去找妳。
lines.simplified: 星期五我上课上到九点，等我下了课，就去找你。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ wǒ shàngkè shàng dào jiǔ diǎn, děng wǒ xià le kè, jiù qù zhǎo nǐ.
lines.english: On Friday I have class until nine. As soon as my class is over, I'll come and find you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的什麼時候會到KTV？
prompt.simplified: 男的什么时候会到KTV？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shénme shíhòu huì dào KTV?
prompt.english: When will the man get to the KTV?

questions.why: Saturday is fully booked, so they move to Friday evening; he has class until nine and comes 等我下了課，就…, so after nine on Friday.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 已經七點半了，你快點起來！八點的筆試你忘了嗎？
lines.simplified: 已经七点半了，你快点起来！八点的笔试你忘了吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng qī diǎn bàn le, nǐ kuài diǎn qǐlái! Bā diǎn de bǐshì nǐ wàng le ma?
lines.english: It's already half past seven. Get up, quick! Did you forget the eight o'clock written exam?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 筆試十點才開始，教授昨天晚上在網路上說的，九點半到教室就可以了。
lines.simplified: 笔试十点才开始，教授昨天晚上在网路上说的，九点半到教室就可以了。
lines.pinyin: Bǐshì shí diǎn cái kāishǐ, jiàoshòu zuótiān wǎnshàng zài wǎnglù shàng shuō de, jiǔ diǎn bàn dào jiàoshì jiù kěyǐ le.
lines.english: The written exam doesn't start until ten. The professor said so online last night. Getting to the classroom at half past nine is fine.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是嗎？那你先吃點東西吧，我買了兩個包子。
lines.simplified: 是吗？那你先吃点东西吧，我买了两个包子。
lines.pinyin: Shì ma? Nà nǐ xiān chī diǎn dōngxi ba, wǒ mǎi le liǎng ge bāozi.
lines.english: Really? Then eat something first. I bought two steamed buns.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 謝謝，可是我現在太緊張了，一點東西都吃不下。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，可是我现在太紧张了，一点东西都吃不下。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, kěshì wǒ xiànzài tài jǐnzhāng le, yìdiǎn dōngxi dōu chī bú xià.
lines.english: Thanks, but I'm too nervous right now. I can't eat a thing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你念了那麼多，一定沒問題的。不吃東西，考試的時候肚子餓了怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 你念了那么多，一定没问题的。不吃东西，考试的时候肚子饿了怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ niàn le nàme duō, yídìng méi wèntí de. Bù chī dōngxi, kǎoshì de shíhòu dùzi è le zěnme bàn?
lines.english: You've studied so much, you'll be fine. If you don't eat, what will you do if you get hungry during the exam?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我吃一個。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我吃一个。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ chī yí ge.
lines.english: All right, I'll eat one.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼要男的快點起來？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么要男的快点起来？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme yào nán de kuài diǎn qǐlái?
prompt.english: Why does the woman tell the man to get up quickly?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她以為筆試七點半開始
choices.simplified: 她以为笔试七点半开始
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì qī diǎn bàn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at half past seven.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì bā diǎn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at eight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她以為筆試九點半開始
choices.simplified: 她以为笔试九点半开始
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì jiǔ diǎn bàn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at half past nine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi bǐshì shí diǎn kāishǐ.
choices.english: She thought the exam started at ten.

questions.why: 快點起來 because she thinks the exam is at eight (八點的筆試你忘了嗎？). Half past seven is the time now, ten is when it really starts, and half past nine is when he needs to be there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的一開始為什麼不吃包子？
prompt.simplified: 男的一开始为什么不吃包子？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de yìkāishǐ wèishénme bù chī bāozi?
prompt.english: Why does the man at first not eat a bun?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng kǎo wán zài chī.
choices.english: He wants to eat after the exam.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He has no time to eat.

questions.why: 太緊張了，一點東西都吃不下: nerves leave him unable to eat (V不下). He has not eaten, and with the exam at ten he has time.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 期末考快到了，我們八個同學想找地方一起念書，圖書館的小教室坐得下嗎？
lines.simplified: 期末考快到了，我们八个同学想找地方一起念书，图书馆的小教室坐得下吗？
lines.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, wǒmen bā ge tóngxué xiǎng zhǎo dìfāng yìqǐ niànshū, túshūguǎn de xiǎo jiàoshì zuò de xià ma?
lines.english: Finals are coming, and eight of us want somewhere to study together. Is the library’s small room big enough?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 小教室只坐得下六個人。你們去系上的大教室吧，我明天打電話去系辦公室問問。
lines.simplified: 小教室只坐得下六个人。你们去系上的大教室吧，我明天打电话去系办公室问问。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo jiàoshì zhǐ zuò de xià liù ge rén. Nǐmen qù xì shàng de dà jiàoshì ba, wǒ míngtiān dǎ diànhuà qù xì bàngōngshì wènwen.
lines.english: The small room only seats six. Use the department's big classroom; I'll call the department office tomorrow and ask.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大教室常常有人用，妳快點打吧！
lines.simplified: 大教室常常有人用，你快点打吧！
lines.pinyin: Dà jiàoshì chángcháng yǒu rén yòng, nǐ kuài diǎn dǎ ba!
lines.english: The big classroom is often in use. Call them now!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 今天是星期天，辦公室沒有人啊。
lines.simplified: 今天是星期天，办公室没有人啊。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqítiān, bàngōngshì méiyǒu rén a.
lines.english: It's Sunday. There's nobody in the office.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對喔，那妳明天早上一下課就打，問到了就告訴我。
lines.simplified: 对喔，那你明天早上一下课就打，问到了就告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Duì o, nà nǐ míngtiān zǎoshàng yí xiàkè jiù dǎ, wèn dào le jiù gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: Oh right. Then call tomorrow morning as soon as your class ends, and tell me what they say.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，沒問題。
lines.simplified: 好，没问题。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, méi wèntí.
lines.english: OK, no problem.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 為什麼他們不在圖書館的小教室念書？
prompt.simplified: 为什么他们不在图书馆的小教室念书？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme tāmen bú zài túshūguǎn de xiǎo jiàoshì niànshū?
prompt.english: Why won't they study in the library's small room?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The small room isn't open on Sundays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dà jiàoshì chángcháng yǒu rén yòng.
choices.english: The big classroom is often in use.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen de rén tài duō le.
choices.english: There are too many of them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Nobody is in the office today.

questions.why: 小教室只坐得下六個人, but there are eight of them. Sunday and the empty office are about the phone call, and the busy big classroom is why he wants her to hurry.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的什麼時候會打電話？
prompt.simplified: 女的什么时候会打电话？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shénme shíhòu huì dǎ diànhuà?
prompt.english: When will the woman make the call?

questions.why: He first tells her 快點打 (call now), but it is Sunday and the office is empty, so they agree: 明天早上一下課就打, right after her class tomorrow morning.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你好，我是你們的文法老師。你今天沒來上課，所以我打電話告訴你明天考試的事。
lines.simplified: 你好，我是你们的文法老师。你今天没来上课，所以我打电话告诉你明天考试的事。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì nǐmen de wénfǎ lǎoshī. Nǐ jīntiān méi lái shàngkè, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎ diànhuà gàosu nǐ míngtiān kǎoshì de shì.
lines.english: Hello, this is your grammar teacher. You weren't in class today, so I'm calling to tell you about tomorrow's test.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次考試要從第三課考到第五課，第六課下次再考。因為我們的教室明天有別的課，所以要到三樓的大教室考。
lines.simplified: 这次考试要从第三课考到第五课，第六课下次再考。因为我们的教室明天有别的课，所以要到三楼的大教室考。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì yào cóng dì sān kè kǎo dào dì wǔ kè, dì liù kè xià cì zài kǎo. Yīnwèi wǒmen de jiàoshì míngtiān yǒu bié de kè, suǒyǐ yào dào sān lóu de dà jiàoshì kǎo.
lines.english: This test covers Lessons 3 to 5; Lesson 6 will be tested next time. Because our room has another class tomorrow, we'll take it in the big classroom on the third floor.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 考完以後，請把上次的報告交給我，作文下個星期再交就可以了。
lines.simplified: 考完以后，请把上次的报告交给我，作文下个星期再交就可以了。
lines.pinyin: Kǎo wán yǐhòu, qǐng bǎ shàng cì de bàogào jiāo gěi wǒ, zuòwén xià ge xīngqí zài jiāo jiù kěyǐ le.
lines.english: After the test, please hand me last time's report; the composition can wait until next week.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 明天的考試一共考幾課？
prompt.simplified: 明天的考试一共考几课？
prompt.pinyin: Míngtiān de kǎoshì yígòng kǎo jǐ kè?
prompt.english: How many lessons does tomorrow's test cover?

questions.why: 從第三課考到第五課: Lessons 3, 4 and 5, three lessons. Lesson 6 is tested next time (下次再考), so it is not four.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 考完試，這個學生要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 考完试，这个学生要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Kǎo wán shì, zhège xuéshēng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What must this student do after the test?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo yǐqián xiě hǎo de bàogào.
choices.english: Hand in the report written earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù sān lóu de jiàoshì shàngkè.
choices.english: Go to class on the third floor.

questions.why: 請把上次的報告交給我: after the test the student hands in the earlier report. The composition can wait until next week, and the third-floor room is where the test itself is.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，期末考快到了。圖書館平日本來開到晚上十點，從下個星期一開始，平日會開到半夜十二點，週末還是開到晚上九點。
lines.simplified: 大家好，期末考快到了。图书馆平日本来开到晚上十点，从下个星期一开始，平日会开到半夜十二点，周末还是开到晚上九点。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, qímòkǎo kuài dào le. Túshūguǎn píngrì běnlái kāi dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn, cóng xià ge xīngqíyī kāishǐ, píngrì huì kāi dào bànyè shí'èr diǎn, zhōumò háishì kāi dào wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. Finals are coming. On weekdays the library has closed at ten p.m.; from next Monday it will stay open until midnight on weekdays, and at weekends it still closes at nine p.m.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 平日三樓的小教室可以用到晚上十一點，坐得下六個人。想跟同學一起念書的，請先在網路上訂位。
lines.simplified: 平日三楼的小教室可以用到晚上十一点，坐得下六个人。想跟同学一起念书的，请先在网路上订位。
lines.pinyin: Píngrì sān lóu de xiǎo jiàoshì kěyǐ yòng dào wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn, zuò de xià liù ge rén. Xiǎng gēn tóngxué yìqǐ niànshū de, qǐng xiān zài wǎnglù shàng dìngwèi.
lines.english: On weekdays the small rooms on the third floor can be used until eleven p.m. and seat six. If you want to study with classmates, please book online first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，借了書的同學，請在學期結束以前把書還回來，要不然下個學期就不能再借書了。謝謝大家！
lines.simplified: 还有，借了书的同学，请在学期结束以前把书还回来，要不然下个学期就不能再借书了。谢谢大家！
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, jiè le shū de tóngxué, qǐng zài xuéqí jiéshù yǐqián bǎ shū huán huílái, yàobùrán xià ge xuéqí jiù bù néng zài jiè shū le. Xièxie dàjiā!
lines.english: Also, if you have borrowed books, please return them before the semester ends, or you will not be able to borrow books next semester. Thank you!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下個星期六，圖書館開到幾點？
prompt.simplified: 下个星期六，图书馆开到几点？
prompt.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqíliù, túshūguǎn kāi dào jǐ diǎn?
prompt.english: Until what time is the library open next Saturday?

questions.why: Saturday is a weekend day: 週末還是開到晚上九點. Ten was the old weekday time, midnight the new weekday time, and eleven is when the small rooms close.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 想用三樓的小教室，要怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 想用三楼的小教室，要怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng yòng sān lóu de xiǎo jiàoshì, yào zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What must you do to use a small room on the third floor?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān bǎ jiè de shū huán le.

questions.why: 請先在網路上訂位: the rooms are booked online first. Six is how many a room can seat, not a requirement, and returning books is a separate request.

title.traditional: 華語文中心 語言交換
title.simplified: 华语文中心 语言交换

text.traditional:
想多練習說中文嗎？想交台灣朋友嗎？
時間：12月每個星期三 18:30–20:30
教室：華語文中心2樓（坐得下30個人）
怎麼做：一個外國學生跟一個台灣學生一起聊天，第一個小時說中文，第二個小時說外國學生自己的語言。
費用：免費
參加：請先上網留言，告訴我們你的名字和電話。教室坐滿了就不能再參加
華語文中心 11/20
text.simplified:
想多练习说中文吗？想交台湾朋友吗？
时间：12月每个星期三 18:30–20:30
教室：华语文中心2楼（坐得下30个人）
怎么做：一个外国学生跟一个台湾学生一起聊天，第一个小时说中文，第二个小时说外国学生自己的语言。
费用：免费
参加：请先上网留言，告诉我们你的名字和电话。教室坐满了就不能再参加
华语文中心 11/20
text.pinyin:
Xiǎng duō liànxí shuō Zhōngwén ma? Xiǎng jiāo Táiwān péngyǒu ma?
Shíjiān: Shí'èr yuè měi ge xīngqísān shíbā diǎn sānshí dào èrshí diǎn sānshí
Jiàoshì: Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn èr lóu (zuò de xià sānshí ge rén)
Zěnme zuò: Yí ge wàiguó xuéshēng gēn yí ge Táiwān xuéshēng yìqǐ liáotiān, dì yī ge xiǎoshí shuō Zhōngwén, dì èr ge xiǎoshí shuō wàiguó xuéshēng zìjǐ de yǔyán.
Fèiyòng: Miǎnfèi
Cānjiā: Qǐng xiān shàngwǎng liúyán, gàosu wǒmen nǐ de míngzi hé diànhuà. Jiàoshì zuò mǎn le jiù bù néng zài cānjiā
Huáyǔwén zhōngxīn 11/20
text.english:
Want more practice speaking Chinese? Want to make Taiwanese friends?
Time: every Wednesday in December, 6:30–8:30 p.m.
Room: Chinese Language Center, 2nd floor (seats 30)
How it works: a foreign student and a Taiwanese student chat together, speaking Chinese in the first hour and the foreign student's own language in the second.
Fee: free
To join: leave a message online first and tell us your name and phone number. Once the room is full, no one else can join
Chinese Language Center, 11/20

versions.alt: A language-exchange poster pinned on the notice board of a university language center

prompt.traditional: 每次活動，外國學生說中文說多久？
prompt.simplified: 每次活动，外国学生说中文说多久？
prompt.pinyin: Měi cì huódòng, wàiguó xuéshēng shuō Zhōngwén shuō duō jiǔ?
prompt.english: In each session, how long does the foreign student speak Chinese?

questions.why: A session runs 18:30–20:30 (two hours): Chinese in the first hour, the foreign student's language in the second, so one hour of Chinese.

prompt.traditional: 為什麼有的人可能不能參加？
prompt.simplified: 为什么有的人可能不能参加？
prompt.pinyin: Wèishénme yǒu de rén kěnéng bù néng cānjiā?
prompt.english: Why might some people be unable to join?

choices.pinyin: Jiàoshì zhǐ néng zuò sānshí rén.
choices.english: The room only holds thirty people.

questions.why: The room 坐得下30個人, and 教室坐滿了就不能再參加: once the 30 seats are taken, nobody else can join. The activity is free for everyone, it runs in December (11/20 is only the notice's date), and it is for Taiwanese and foreign students together.

text.traditional:
美心：
妳不是說今天下午要去圖書館嗎？可以幫我把桌上那兩本書還了嗎？還有，圖書館三樓有一本日本歷史的書，我上網查過了，現在還沒有人借，請妳幫我借回來。我今天上課上到晚上八點，回來以後請妳吃東西。謝謝！
可欣 星期二早上
text.simplified:
美心：
你不是说今天下午要去图书馆吗？可以帮我把桌上那两本书还了吗？还有，图书馆三楼有一本日本历史的书，我上网查过了，现在还没有人借，请你帮我借回来。我今天上课上到晚上八点，回来以后请你吃东西。谢谢！
可欣 星期二早上
text.pinyin:
Měixīn:
Nǐ bú shì shuō jīntiān xiàwǔ yào qù túshūguǎn ma? Kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhuō shàng nà liǎng běn shū huán le ma? Hái yǒu, túshūguǎn sān lóu yǒu yì běn Rìběn lìshǐ de shū, wǒ shàngwǎng chá guo le, xiànzài hái méi yǒu rén jiè, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ jiè huílái. Wǒ jīntiān shàngkè shàng dào wǎnshàng bā diǎn, huílái yǐhòu qǐng nǐ chī dōngxi. Xièxie!
Kěxīn, xīngqí'èr zǎoshàng
text.english:
Meixin,
Didn't you say you're going to the library this afternoon? Could you return the two books on my desk for me? Also, there's a Japanese history book on the library's third floor; I checked online and nobody has borrowed it yet. Please borrow it for me. I have class until eight this evening. When I'm back, I'll treat you to something to eat. Thanks!
Kexin, Tuesday morning

prompt.traditional: 可欣請美心做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 可欣请美心做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Kěxīn qǐng Měixīn zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Kexin ask Meixin to do?

choices.pinyin: Tì tā shàngwǎng chá yì běn shū.
choices.english: Look a book up online for her.

choices.pinyin: Tì tā mǎi yì běn lìshǐ shū.
choices.english: Buy a history book for her.

choices.pinyin: Tì tā huán shū zài jiè shū.
choices.english: Return books and borrow one for her.

choices.pinyin: Xiàwǔ péi tā qù huán shū.
choices.english: Go with her to return books this afternoon.

questions.why: 妳不是說今天下午要去圖書館嗎？ reminds Meixin of her own plan; Kexin asks her to return two books and borrow the history book. Kexin already looked it up online herself, she wants it borrowed, not bought, and she is in class all day.

prompt.traditional: 可欣今天什麼時候會回來？
prompt.simplified: 可欣今天什么时候会回来？
prompt.pinyin: Kěxīn jīntiān shénme shíhòu huì huílái?
prompt.english: When will Kexin come back today?

questions.why: 上課上到晚上八點: her classes run until eight, so she gets back after eight. The library this afternoon is Meixin's errand, not hers.

passage.traditional: 期末考快到了，這個星期我每天都在圖書館念書，常常念{1}晚上十點才回宿舍。昨天回到房間，我發現室友已經把房間打掃得{2}的，還在桌上放了一個三明治。我問她：「妳今天{3}對我這麼好？」她笑著說：「看妳這麼累，想讓妳輕鬆一下。」可是我太累了，什麼都不想吃。我想把三明治放進冰箱，可是冰箱已經滿了，放{4}了，只好把它放在桌上，{5}就去洗澡、睡覺了。
passage.simplified: 期末考快到了，这个星期我每天都在图书馆念书，常常念{1}晚上十点才回宿舍。昨天回到房间，我发现室友已经把房间打扫得{2}的，还在桌上放了一个三明治。我问她：「你今天{3}对我这么好？」她笑着说：「看你这么累，想让你轻松一下。」可是我太累了，什么都不想吃。我想把三明治放进冰箱，可是冰箱已经满了，放{4}了，只好把它放在桌上，{5}就去洗澡、睡觉了。
passage.pinyin: Qímòkǎo kuài dào le, zhège xīngqí wǒ měi tiān dōu zài túshūguǎn niànshū, chángcháng niàn dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái huí sùshè. Zuótiān huí dào fángjiān, wǒ fāxiàn shìyǒu yǐjīng bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, hái zài zhuō shàng fàng le yí ge sānmíngzhì. Wǒ wèn tā: “Nǐ jīntiān zěnme duì wǒ zhème hǎo?” Tā xiào zhe shuō: “Kàn nǐ zhème lèi, xiǎng ràng nǐ qīngsōng yíxià.” Kěshì wǒ tài lèi le, shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī. Wǒ xiǎng bǎ sānmíngzhì fàng jìn bīngxiāng, kěshì bīngxiāng yǐjīng mǎn le, fàng bú xià le, zhǐhǎo bǎ tā fàng zài zhuō shàng, ránhòu jiù qù xǐzǎo, shuìjiào le.
passage.english: Finals are coming. This week I've studied in the library every day, often until ten at night before going back to the dorm. Yesterday when I got back, I found my roommate had cleaned the room spotless and put a sandwich on the desk. I asked her, “How come you're so nice to me today?” She smiled: “You look so tired. I wanted to let you relax a bit.” But I was too tired to want anything. I wanted to put the sandwich in the fridge, but the fridge was already full and there was no room, so I left it on the desk and then took a shower and went to bed.

questions.why: 念到晚上十點: V到 + a time says how long the studying went on. 念完 would need what was finished, and 念在／念給 don't take a time.
Cleaning (打掃) leaves a room 乾乾淨淨的, spotless. A room is not left happy, lively or sweet-smelling by cleaning; those doubled words describe people, busy places and food.
怎麼這麼好？ shows surprise: how come you're so nice today? 什麼這麼, 那麼這麼 and 多少這麼 are not Chinese.
冰箱已經滿了，放不下了: the fridge is full, so there is no room for the sandwich. 放不起, 放不到 and 放不懂 don't say there is no space.
The writer leaves the sandwich on the desk, 然後 (and then) showers and goes to bed: one action after another. 因為, 雖然 and 要是 would need a reason, a contrast or a condition.

passage.traditional: 我的弟弟是小學生。他說話說得很好，可是漢字寫得{1}好，作文裡常常有錯字，讓他很煩惱。上個星期老師要他們寫一篇三百字的作文，他一直寫{2}晚上十一點。我說：「你{3}這麼晚還不睡？明天再寫吧！」他說明天就要交了。後來他把每個字都寫得{4}的，老師給了他很好的成績。他說以後{5}有不會寫的字，就要多查字典。
passage.simplified: 我的弟弟是小学生。他说话说得很好，可是汉字写得{1}好，作文里常常有错字，让他很烦恼。上个星期老师要他们写一篇三百字的作文，他一直写{2}晚上十一点。我说：「你{3}这么晚还不睡？明天再写吧！」他说明天就要交了。后来他把每个字都写得{4}的，老师给了他很好的成绩。他说以后{5}有不会写的字，就要多查字典。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de dìdi shì xiǎoxuéshēng. Tā shuōhuà shuō de hěn hǎo, kěshì Hànzì xiě de bù zěnme hǎo, zuòwén lǐ chángcháng yǒu cuòzì, ràng tā hěn fánnǎo. Shàng ge xīngqí lǎoshī yào tāmen xiě yì piān sānbǎi zì de zuòwén, tā yìzhí xiě dào wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn. Wǒ shuō: “Nǐ zěnme zhème wǎn hái bú shuì? Míngtiān zài xiě ba!” Tā shuō míngtiān jiù yào jiāo le. Hòulái tā bǎ měi ge zì dōu xiě de qīngqīngchǔchǔ de, lǎoshī gěi le tā hěn hǎo de chéngjī. Tā shuō yǐhòu zhǐyào yǒu bú huì xiě de zì, jiù yào duō chá zìdiǎn.
passage.english: My younger brother is in primary school. He speaks well, but his characters aren't great, and his compositions often have wrong characters, which worries him. Last week the teacher had them write a 300-character composition, and he kept writing until eleven at night. I said, “How come you're still up so late? Write the rest tomorrow!” He said it was due tomorrow. In the end he wrote every character very clearly, and the teacher gave him a very good grade. He says that from now on, whenever there's a character he can't write, he'll look it up in the dictionary.

questions.why: 寫得不怎麼好: his characters are not very good (note the 錯字). Only 不怎麼 goes before a state verb like 好; 沒多少 counts an amount, 很少 says how often, and 沒什麼 goes before a noun.
一直寫到晚上十一點: he kept writing until eleven at night. 寫完／寫好 can't take a time, and 寫給 needs a person.
怎麼這麼晚還不睡？ shows surprise that he is still up so late. The other question words cannot go before 這麼 + a state verb.
Characters written so well that the grade is good are 清清楚楚的, very clear. Happy, lively and sweet-smelling don't describe handwriting.
只要……就……: whenever (as long as) there is a character he can't write, he will look it up. 雖然 needs 可是, 不但 needs 也／還, and 連 needs 都／也.

text.traditional: 我是從美國來的交換學生，在台灣學中文已經三個月了。老師每天都要我們用生字造句，還要我們用中文報告。我覺得最難的是聲調，因為以前在美國，我沒學過什麼聲調。有一次我去夜市吃牛肉麵，想跟老闆說「請多給我一點湯」，可是老闆笑著問我：「糖？吃麵要糖做什麼？」我回宿舍把這件事告訴一個台灣朋友，他說：「你說的不是『湯』，是『糖』啊！」後來，他每天晚上都陪我慢慢地練習。現在我說的中文好多了，連夜市的老闆都聽得懂了。
text.simplified: 我是从美国来的交换学生，在台湾学中文已经三个月了。老师每天都要我们用生字造句，还要我们用中文报告。我觉得最难的是声调，因为以前在美国，我没学过什么声调。有一次我去夜市吃牛肉面，想跟老板说「请多给我一点汤」，可是老板笑着问我：「糖？吃面要糖做什么？」我回宿舍把这件事告诉一个台湾朋友，他说：「你说的不是『汤』，是『糖』啊！」后来，他每天晚上都陪我慢慢地练习。现在我说的中文好多了，连夜市的老板都听得懂了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì cóng Měiguó lái de jiāohuàn xuéshēng, zài Táiwān xué Zhōngwén yǐjīng sān ge yuè le. Lǎoshī měi tiān dōu yào wǒmen yòng shēngzì zàojù, hái yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào. Wǒ juéde zuì nán de shì shēngdiào, yīnwèi yǐqián zài Měiguó, wǒ méi xué guo shénme shēngdiào. Yǒu yí cì wǒ qù yèshì chī niúròu miàn, xiǎng gēn lǎobǎn shuō “qǐng duō gěi wǒ yìdiǎn tāng”, kěshì lǎobǎn xiào zhe wèn wǒ: “Táng? Chī miàn yào táng zuò shénme?” Wǒ huí sùshè bǎ zhè jiàn shì gàosu yí ge Táiwān péngyǒu, tā shuō: “Nǐ shuō de bú shì ‘tāng’, shì ‘táng’ a!” Hòulái, tā měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu péi wǒ mànmàn de liànxí. Xiànzài wǒ shuō de Zhōngwén hǎo duō le, lián yèshì de lǎobǎn dōu tīng de dǒng le.
text.english: I'm an exchange student from the US, and I've been learning Chinese in Taiwan for three months. Every day the teacher has us make sentences with new words and give reports in Chinese. The hardest thing for me is the tones, because back in the US I hardly learned any tones. Once I went to the night market for beef noodles and wanted to ask the owner for “a little more soup (tāng), please”, but he laughed and asked me: “Sugar (táng)? What do you want sugar for with noodles?” Back at the dorm I told a Taiwanese friend, and he said: “You didn't say tāng, you said táng!” After that he practised with me slowly every evening. Now my Chinese is much better; even the night-market owner understands me.

prompt.traditional: 老闆為什麼問他吃麵要糖做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 老板为什么问他吃面要糖做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎobǎn wèishénme wèn tā chī miàn yào táng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: Why did the owner ask what he wanted sugar for with noodles?

choices.pinyin: Tā shuō xiǎng chī tián yìdiǎn de.
choices.english: He said he wanted it sweeter.

choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ shēngdiào shuō cuò le.
Lǎobǎn de niúròu miàn shì tián de.
choices.english: The owner's beef noodles are sweet.

choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn tīng bù dǒng tā de Yīngwén.
choices.english: The owner didn't understand his English.

questions.why: 湯 tāng and 糖 táng differ only in tone, and tones are his weak point: he wanted 湯 but said 糖 (你說的不是『湯』，是『糖』). He spoke Chinese, not English, and never asked for anything sweet.

prompt.traditional: 現在他說的中文怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 现在他说的中文怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiànzài tā shuō de Zhōngwén zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is his Chinese now?

choices.english: He still often gets tones wrong.

choices.pinyin: Shuō de bǐ péngyǒu hái hǎo.
choices.english: He speaks better than his friend.

choices.pinyin: Biérén tīng de dǒng tā de huà.

questions.why: 現在我說的中文好多了，連夜市的老闆都聽得懂了: others understand him now, not only his friend.

text.traditional: 上個學期我修了一門台灣歷史課。教授人很好，教法也很有意思，可是我那時候愛上了韓劇，每天晚上都看到半夜兩三點，上課的時候常常打瞌睡，教授說的話也沒聽到多少。有問題的時候，我只上網查一查。期末筆試的時候，有好幾題我都不會寫，就被當了。這學期我再修一次這門課。這次我每次上課都坐在最前面，認真地聽教授說的話，有不懂的地方就去辦公室問教授。有一天，教授說：「你最近上課很認真，跟上個學期不一樣了！」我想，這次我一定不會再被當了。
text.simplified: 上个学期我修了一门台湾历史课。教授人很好，教法也很有意思，可是我那时候爱上了韩剧，每天晚上都看到半夜两三点，上课的时候常常打瞌睡，教授说的话也没听到多少。有问题的时候，我只上网查一查。期末笔试的时候，有好几题我都不会写，就被当了。这学期我再修一次这门课。这次我每次上课都坐在最前面，认真地听教授说的话，有不懂的地方就去办公室问教授。有一天，教授说：「你最近上课很认真，跟上个学期不一样了！」我想，这次我一定不会再被当了。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xuéqí wǒ xiū le yì mén Táiwān lìshǐ kè. Jiàoshòu rén hěn hǎo, jiàofǎ yě hěn yǒu yìsi, kěshì wǒ nà shíhòu ài shàng le hánjù, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu kàn dào bànyè liǎng sān diǎn, shàngkè de shíhòu chángcháng dǎ kēshuì, jiàoshòu shuō de huà yě méi tīng dào duōshǎo. Yǒu wèntí de shíhòu, wǒ zhǐ shàngwǎng chá yì chá. Qímò bǐshì de shíhòu, yǒu hǎojǐ tí wǒ dōu bú huì xiě, jiù bèi dàng le. Zhè xuéqí wǒ zài xiū yí cì zhè mén kè. Zhè cì wǒ měi cì shàngkè dōu zuò zài zuì qiánmiàn, rènzhēn de tīng jiàoshòu shuō de huà, yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng jiù qù bàngōngshì wèn jiàoshòu. Yǒu yì tiān, jiàoshòu shuō: “Nǐ zuìjìn shàngkè hěn rènzhēn, gēn shàng ge xuéqí bù yíyàng le!” Wǒ xiǎng, zhè cì wǒ yídìng bú huì zài bèi dàng le.
text.english: Last semester I took a course on Taiwanese history. The professor was nice and taught in an interesting way, but I was hooked on Korean dramas then and watched until two or three every night. I often dozed off in class and didn't hear much of what the professor said. When I had questions, I only looked them up online. In the written final there were several questions I couldn't answer, and I failed. This semester I'm taking the course once more. This time I sit at the very front in every class, listen carefully to what the professor says, and go to the professor's office whenever I don't understand something. One day the professor said, “You've been very serious in class lately. You're different from last semester!” I think this time I surely won't fail again.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人上個學期上課的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人上个学期上课的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén shàng ge xuéqí shàngkè de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What was the writer like in class last semester?

choices.english: Sat at the very front and listened.

questions.why: Watching dramas until two or three, the writer 常常打瞌睡 in class last semester. The dramas were watched at night, not in class, and sitting at the front and listening carefully are this semester.

prompt.traditional: 這學期有不懂的地方，寫這篇文章的人怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 这学期有不懂的地方，写这篇文章的人怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè xuéqí yǒu bù dǒng de dìfāng, xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: This semester, what does the writer do when something is unclear?

choices.english: Looks for material in the library.

questions.why: This semester: 有不懂的地方就去辦公室問教授. Looking things up online is what the writer did last semester (只上網查一查).

text.traditional: 我是大學生，去年搬到學校附近的一個社區。這個社區很安全，大門旁邊還有很大的草地，天氣好的時候，鄰居常常帶家人在那裡野餐。我住的公寓在五樓，房東人很好，房租每個月八千塊，包括水費和電費，可是網路的錢要自己付。簽約的時候，我還付了兩個月的押金。最方便的是，附近就有一家便利商店，只要走兩分鐘就到了。有時候我念書念到很晚，肚子餓了，就去買點東西吃。我覺得住在這裡很幸福。
text.simplified: 我是大学生，去年搬到学校附近的一个社区。这个社区很安全，大门旁边还有很大的草地，天气好的时候，邻居常常带家人在那里野餐。我住的公寓在五楼，房东人很好，房租每个月八千块，包括水费和电费，可是网路的钱要自己付。签约的时候，我还付了两个月的押金。最方便的是，附近就有一家便利商店，只要走两分钟就到了。有时候我念书念到很晚，肚子饿了，就去买点东西吃。我觉得住在这里很幸福。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì dàxuéshēng, qùnián bān dào xuéxiào fùjìn de yí ge shèqū. Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, dàmén pángbiān hái yǒu hěn dà de cǎodì, tiānqì hǎo de shíhòu, línjū chángcháng dài jiārén zài nàlǐ yěcān. Wǒ zhù de gōngyù zài wǔ lóu, fángdōng rén hěn hǎo, fángzū měi ge yuè bāqiān kuài, bāokuò shuǐfèi hé diànfèi, kěshì wǎnglù de qián yào zìjǐ fù. Qiānyuē de shíhòu, wǒ hái fù le liǎng ge yuè de yājīn. Zuì fāngbiàn de shì, fùjìn jiù yǒu yì jiā biànlì shāngdiàn, zhǐyào zǒu liǎng fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Yǒu shíhòu wǒ niànshū niàn dào hěn wǎn, dùzi è le, jiù qù mǎi diǎn dōngxi chī. Wǒ juéde zhù zài zhèlǐ hěn xìngfú.
text.english: I'm a university student. Last year I moved to a community near the school. It's very safe, and next to the main gate there's a big lawn where the neighbours often picnic with their families when the weather is good. My apartment is on the fifth floor. The landlord is nice; the rent is NT$8,000 a month, including water and electricity, but I pay for the internet myself. When I signed the lease, I also paid two months' deposit. Best of all, there's a convenience store nearby, just a two-minute walk away. Sometimes when I study late and get hungry, I go and buy something to eat. I feel very happy living here.

prompt.traditional: 這個人每個月除了房租，還要付什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这个人每个月除了房租，还要付什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén měi ge yuè chúle fángzū, hái yào fù shénme?
prompt.english: Besides the rent, what does this person pay every month?

questions.why: Water and electricity are included in the rent (包括), and the deposit was paid once, at signing. Each month only the internet (網路的錢要自己付) is extra.

prompt.traditional: 天氣好的時候，鄰居常在草地上做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 天气好的时候，邻居常在草地上做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo de shíhòu, línjū cháng zài cǎodì shàng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What do the neighbours often do on the lawn in good weather?

choices.english: Lie on it and look at the stars.

questions.why: 鄰居常常帶家人在那裡野餐: a picnic is eating together outdoors. The passage never mentions ball games, camping or stargazing.

prompt.traditional: 那家便利商店怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 那家便利商店怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is true of that convenience store?

choices.english: It is next to the school.
It is next to the community's main gate.

choices.pinyin: Yào zuò chē cái néng dào.

choices.english: It is a short walk away.

questions.why: 附近就有一家便利商店，只要走兩分鐘就到了: a two-minute walk. The lawn is by the main gate, and it is the community, not the shop, that is near the school.

text.traditional: 上個月，我跟兩個朋友去花蓮玩了三天。我們本來想開車走蘇花公路，可是聽說最近常有石頭掉下來，只好坐火車去。我們趁平日人少的時候去，所以民宿不貴，一個人一個晚上才八百塊，還有免費的無線網路。民宿離火車站不遠，走路十分鐘就到了。第一天我們去國家公園，山上的風景美極了，我還買了幾張明信片寄給家人。晚上我們去逛夜市，那裡的小吃又便宜又好吃，我們一下子就把帶去的錢花光了。民宿的錢是朋友先付的。回台北以前，我用信用卡買了好幾包當地的名產，送給沒去的同學。
text.simplified: 上个月，我跟两个朋友去花莲玩了三天。我们本来想开车走苏花公路，可是听说最近常有石头掉下来，只好坐火车去。我们趁平日人少的时候去，所以民宿不贵，一个人一个晚上才八百块，还有免费的无线网路。民宿离火车站不远，走路十分钟就到了。第一天我们去国家公园，山上的风景美极了，我还买了几张明信片寄给家人。晚上我们去逛夜市，那里的小吃又便宜又好吃，我们一下子就把带去的钱花光了。民宿的钱是朋友先付的。回台北以前，我用信用卡买了好几包当地的名产，送给没去的同学。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ gēn liǎng ge péngyǒu qù Huālián wán le sān tiān. Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng kāichē zǒu Sūhuā gōnglù, kěshì tīngshuō zuìjìn cháng yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, zhǐhǎo zuò huǒchē qù. Wǒmen chèn píngrì rén shǎo de shíhòu qù, suǒyǐ mínsù bú guì, yí ge rén yí ge wǎnshàng cái bābǎi kuài, hái yǒu miǎnfèi de wúxiàn wǎnglù. Mínsù lí huǒchēzhàn bù yuǎn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Dì yī tiān wǒmen qù guójiā gōngyuán, shān shàng de fēngjǐng měi jíle, wǒ hái mǎi le jǐ zhāng míngxìnpiàn jì gěi jiārén. Wǎnshàng wǒmen qù guàng yèshì, nàlǐ de xiǎochī yòu piányí yòu hǎochī, wǒmen yíxiàzi jiù bǎ dài qù de qián huā guāng le. Mínsù de qián shì péngyǒu xiān fù de. Huí Táiběi yǐqián, wǒ yòng xìnyòngkǎ mǎi le hǎojǐ bāo dāngdì de míngchǎn, sòng gěi méi qù de tóngxué.
text.english: Last month, two friends and I spent three days in Hualien. We first wanted to drive the Suhua Highway, but we heard rocks had been falling recently, so we had to take the train. We went on weekdays, when there are fewer people, so the B&B was cheap: only NT$800 per person a night, with free Wi-Fi. The B&B wasn't far from the train station, a ten-minute walk. On the first day we went to the national park; the mountain scenery was beautiful, and I bought a few postcards to mail to my family. In the evening we strolled the night market, where the food was cheap and tasty, and in no time we had spent all the cash we brought. A friend paid for the B&B first. Before going back to Taipei, I bought several bags of local specialties with my credit card for classmates who hadn't come.

prompt.traditional: 他們住的民宿為什麼不貴？
prompt.simplified: 他们住的民宿为什么不贵？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zhù de mínsù wèishénme bú guì?
prompt.english: Why was their B&B cheap?

choices.pinyin: Tāmen zhǐ zhù yí ge wǎnshàng.

choices.english: The B&B was far from the station.
They didn't go at the weekend.

choices.pinyin: Tāmen shì zuò huǒchē qù de.

questions.why: 趁著平日去，所以民宿不貴: going on weekdays, not at the weekend, made it cheap. They stayed three days, the B&B was near the station, and the train is about the highway, not the price.

prompt.traditional: 他們在夜市的時候怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 他们在夜市的时候怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zài yèshì de shíhòu zěnme le?
prompt.english: What happened at the night market?

choices.pinyin: Xiǎochī tài guì chī bù qǐ.
choices.english: The food was too expensive to afford.

choices.pinyin: Qián hěn kuài jiù yòng wán le.
choices.english: Their money was soon used up.

choices.pinyin: Tāmen chī de tài bǎo le.

questions.why: 一下子就把帶去的錢花光了: their cash was soon all gone, spent on cheap, tasty food. Nothing was stolen, and the food was cheap, not too expensive.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人用信用卡做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人用信用卡做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén yòng xìnyòngkǎ zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer use the credit card for?

questions.why: 我用信用卡買了好幾包當地的名產: the card paid for the specialties, before going home. A friend paid for the B&B, and the night-market food used up their cash.

picture.alt: A sunny school campus: three young people walk side by side past a modern building with big glass walls. Through the glass you can see a basketball hoop and rows of blue exercise machines: it is a gym. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a light-blue face mask, a white short-sleeved shirt with a purple sweater vest, and green trousers; a white cloth bag hangs from her shoulder and she holds one hand up near her chest. In the middle, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers, with a black bag on her shoulder; she smiles and looks at the girl in the mask next to her. On the right, a young man with black hair wears an open green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and dark trousers; a blue sports bag hangs from his shoulder, and he smiles and holds out his other hand toward the gym. Trees with yellow-green leaves and a blue sky are behind them.

picture.alt: A sunny day at a school: three young people run side by side on a red running track. Inside the track is a green grass field with a soccer goal; school buildings and trees stand in the back under a blue sky with a few clouds. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a white T-shirt and green trousers with a white stripe. In the middle, a young man with black hair wears a red striped T-shirt and black shorts. On the right, a girl with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings wears a blue jacket over an orange top and dark leggings. All three wear white running shoes, smile and run easily with their arms bent; nobody is on the grass or playing ball.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳已經咳嗽一個星期了，到底要不要去看病？
lines.simplified: 你已经咳嗽一个星期了，到底要不要去看病？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yǐjīng késòu yí ge xīngqí le, dàodǐ yào bú yào qù kànbìng?
lines.english: You've been coughing for a week already. Are you going to see a doctor or not?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我想先去藥局買藥吃吃看，也許過兩天就好了。
lines.simplified: 我想先去药局买药吃吃看，也许过两天就好了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān qù yàojú mǎi yào chīchī kàn, yěxǔ guò liǎng tiān jiù hǎo le.
lines.english: I'd like to get some medicine at the drugstore first and see. Maybe it'll be better in a couple of days.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個星期也是這麼說的。今天下午我陪妳去吧。
lines.simplified: 你上个星期也是这么说的。今天下午我陪你去吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge xīngqí yě shì zhème shuō de. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ péi nǐ qù ba.
lines.english: You said the same thing last week. I'll go with you this afternoon.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我先去把報告交了，三點在學校門口等你。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我先去把报告交了，三点在学校门口等你。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ xiān qù bǎ bàogào jiāo le, sān diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
lines.english: All right. Then I'll hand in my report first and wait for you at the school gate at three.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的的意思是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de de yìsi shì shénme?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的可以先買藥吃吃看
choices.simplified: 女的可以先买药吃吃看
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de kěyǐ xiān mǎi yào chīchī kàn.
choices.english: She can try some medicine first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的今天就應該去看病
choices.simplified: 女的今天就应该去看病
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de jīntiān jiù yīnggāi qù kànbìng.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhǎo zài jiā duō xiūxí.
choices.english: She had better rest at home.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: 到底要不要去看病？ presses her for a real answer, and 妳上個星期也是這麼說的 shows he won't accept more waiting: he wants her to see a doctor today (今天下午我陪妳去). Trying medicine first and handing in the report are her own ideas, and nobody suggests staying home to rest.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 晚上想吃什麼？學校旁邊有一家新的漢堡店，要不要去吃吃看？還是我們去吃牛肉麵？
lines.simplified: 晚上想吃什么？学校旁边有一家新的汉堡店，要不要去吃吃看？还是我们去吃牛肉面？
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshàng xiǎng chī shénme? Xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā xīn de hànbǎo diàn, yào bú yào qù chīchī kàn? Háishì wǒmen qù chī niúròu miàn?
lines.english: What do you want for dinner? There's a new burger place next to the school. Shall we try it? Or shall we have beef noodles?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 都可以，你決定吧。
lines.simplified: 都可以，你决定吧。
lines.pinyin: Dōu kěyǐ, nǐ juédìng ba.
lines.english: Either's fine. You decide.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳每次都說都可以。妳到底想吃什麼？
lines.simplified: 你每次都说都可以。你到底想吃什么？

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那吃牛肉麵吧。我最近胖了，不想吃太油的東西。
lines.simplified: 那吃牛肉面吧。我最近胖了，不想吃太油的东西。
lines.pinyin: Nà chī niúròu miàn ba. Wǒ zuìjìn pàng le, bù xiǎng chī tài yóu de dōngxi.
lines.english: Then beef noodles. I've put on weight lately, and I don't want anything too oily.

prompt.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuān chī niúròu miàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā lǎoshì chī de tài duō.

choices.english: She never says what she wants to eat.

questions.why: 妳每次都說都可以。妳到底想吃什麼？: 每次 and 到底 show he is tired of her never saying what she wants. She picks the beef noodles herself, putting on weight is her own remark (he never says she eats too much), and the new burger place was his idea.

lines.simplified: 这家小吃店怎么样？

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 滷肉飯很好吃，肉也給得很多，可是湯鹹死了，我喝了一點就不敢再喝了。
lines.simplified: 卤肉饭很好吃，肉也给得很多，可是汤咸死了，我喝了一点就不敢再喝了。
lines.pinyin: Lǔròufàn hěn hǎochī, ròu yě gěi de hěn duō, kěshì tāng xián sǐ le, wǒ hē le yìdiǎn jiù bù gǎn zài hē le.
lines.english: The braised pork rice is good and they give you lots of meat, but the soup is terribly salty. After a little I didn't dare drink any more.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 吃太鹹對身體不好。下次我們去對面那家吧，那家的菜，油和鹽都放得比較少。
lines.simplified: 吃太咸对身体不好。下次我们去对面那家吧，那家的菜，油和盐都放得比较少。
lines.pinyin: Chī tài xián duì shēntǐ bù hǎo. Xià cì wǒmen qù duìmiàn nà jiā ba, nà jiā de cài, yóu hé yán dōu fàng de bǐjiào shǎo.
lines.english: Eating very salty food isn't good for you. Next time let's go to the place across the street; they use less oil and salt.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這家小吃店怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这家小吃店怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè jiā xiǎochī diàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of this snack shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāng fàng de yán tài duō.
choices.english: The soup has too much salt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: There is too little meat on the rice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cài fàng de yóu tài duō.
choices.english: The food has too much oil.

questions.why: 湯鹹死了 means the soup was far too salty, so he stopped drinking it. He says the rice is good and the meat generous, less oil and salt is what she says about the shop across the street, and he never mentions prices.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼一直吃餅乾？
lines.simplified: 你怎么一直吃饼干？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìzhí chī bǐnggān?
lines.english: Why do you keep eating cookies?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我餓死了！早上起晚了，來不及吃早飯，中午又忙得沒時間吃。
lines.simplified: 我饿死了！早上起晚了，来不及吃早饭，中午又忙得没时间吃。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ è sǐ le! Zǎoshàng qǐ wǎn le, láibùjí chī zǎofàn, zhōngwǔ yòu máng de méi shíjiān chī.
lines.english: I'm starving! I got up late this morning and had no time for breakfast, and at noon I was too busy to eat.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那也別吃那麼多，等一下就要吃晚飯了。先喝杯開水吧。
lines.simplified: 那也别吃那么多，等一下就要吃晚饭了。先喝杯开水吧。

lines.english: Still, don't eat so many. We're having dinner soon. Have a glass of water first.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，可是我還要再吃一塊。
lines.simplified: 好吧，可是我还要再吃一块。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, kěshì wǒ hái yào zài chī yí kuài.
lines.english: All right, but I'm having one more.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is the man now?

questions.why: 餓死了 says he is extremely hungry (死了 is even stronger than 得不得了): no breakfast, and no time to eat at noon. He was busy at noon, not now; the water is her idea, and he never says he is thirsty or tired.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想趁著春假去花蓮玩兩天，可是火車票已經賣光了。
lines.simplified: 我想趁着春假去花莲玩两天，可是火车票已经卖光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chèn zhe chūnjià qù Huālián wán liǎng tiān, kěshì huǒchē piào yǐjīng mài guāng le.
lines.english: I want to use spring break to spend two days in Hualien, but the train tickets are sold out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那坐巴士呢？
lines.simplified: 那坐巴士呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà zuò bāshì ne?
lines.english: What about the bus?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 巴士要坐六個小時，太累了。
lines.simplified: 巴士要坐六个小时，太累了。
lines.pinyin: Bāshì yào zuò liù ge xiǎoshí, tài lèi le.
lines.english: The bus takes six hours. Too tiring.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我哥哥那天要開車去花蓮，你可以坐他的車啊。
lines.simplified: 我哥哥那天要开车去花莲，你可以坐他的车啊。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēge nà tiān yào kāichē qù Huālián, nǐ kěyǐ zuò tā de chē a.
lines.english: My brother is driving to Hualien that day. You could ride with him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 謝謝，可是他要在那裡住一個星期。機票只要兩千多塊，我還是坐飛機吧。
lines.simplified: 谢谢，可是他要在那里住一个星期。机票只要两千多块，我还是坐飞机吧。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, kěshì tā yào zài nàlǐ zhù yí ge xīngqí. Jīpiào zhǐ yào liǎngqiān duō kuài, wǒ háishì zuò fēijī ba.
lines.english: Thanks, but he's staying there a week. A plane ticket is only a bit over two thousand. I'll fly.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼去花蓮？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么去花莲？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme qù Huālián?
prompt.english: How does the man plan to get to Hualien?

questions.why: The train tickets are sold out (賣光了), the bus takes too long, and her brother stays a week while he only wants two days, so he flies (我還是坐飛機吧).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期五晚上我們去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.simplified: 这个星期五晚上我们去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng wǒmen qù KTV chànggē, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Shall we go and sing at a KTV this Friday evening?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我星期五還有考試，等我考完了就去。
lines.simplified: 我星期五还有考试，等我考完了就去。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xīngqíwǔ hái yǒu kǎoshì, děng wǒ kǎo wán le jiù qù.
lines.english: I still have an exam on Friday. Once I've finished my exams, I'll go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你哪天考完？
lines.simplified: 你哪天考完？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǎ tiān kǎo wán?
lines.english: Which day do you finish?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個星期三下午。考完要慶祝一下，我們那天晚上就去吧！
lines.simplified: 下个星期三下午。考完要庆祝一下，我们那天晚上就去吧！
lines.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqísān xiàwǔ. Kǎo wán yào qìngzhù yíxià, wǒmen nà tiān wǎnshàng jiù qù ba!
lines.english: Next Wednesday afternoon. We should celebrate when it's over, so let's go that evening!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，那我先上網訂位。
lines.simplified: 好啊，那我先上网订位。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà wǒ xiān shàngwǎng dìngwèi.
lines.english: OK, then I'll book online.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們打算什麼時候去KTV唱歌？
prompt.simplified: 他们打算什么时候去KTV唱歌？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen dǎsuàn shénme shíhòu qù KTV chànggē?
prompt.english: When do they plan to go and sing at a KTV?

questions.why: 等我考完了就去: his last exam is next Wednesday afternoon, and he wants to celebrate straight after, so they go that evening (那天晚上). Wednesday morning he still has exams, and Thursday is never mentioned.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我下個月要跟同學去爬山，可是我的體力太差了。這個週末你陪我去運動，好不好？
lines.simplified: 我下个月要跟同学去爬山，可是我的体力太差了。这个周末你陪我去运动，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xià ge yuè yào gēn tóngxué qù páshān, kěshì wǒ de tǐlì tài chà le. Zhège zhōumò nǐ péi wǒ qù yùndòng, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Next month I'm going hiking with classmates, but my stamina is poor. Will you come and exercise with me this weekend?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊！天氣好的話，我們去河邊騎腳踏車；下雨的話，就去游泳或是去健身房。
lines.simplified: 好啊！天气好的话，我们去河边骑脚踏车；下雨的话，就去游泳或是去健身房。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Tiānqì hǎo dehuà, wǒmen qù hébiān qí jiǎotàchē; xiàyǔ dehuà, jiù qù yóuyǒng huòshì qù jiànshēnfáng.
lines.english: Sure! If the weather's good, we'll ride bikes by the river; if it rains, we'll go swimming or to the gym.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說這個週末會下大雨。下雨天在家休息不好嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说这个周末会下大雨。下雨天在家休息不好吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhège zhōumò huì xià dàyǔ. Xiàyǔ tiān zài jiā xiūxí bù hǎo ma?
lines.english: I heard it's going to pour this weekend. Isn't resting at home on a rainy day fine?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然不好！我以前也不愛運動，是醫生要我多運動，我才開始的，現在一個星期不運動就不舒服。
lines.simplified: 当然不好！我以前也不爱运动，是医生要我多运动，我才开始的，现在一个星期不运动就不舒服。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán bù hǎo! Wǒ yǐqián yě bú ài yùndòng, shì yīshēng yào wǒ duō yùndòng, wǒ cái kāishǐ de, xiànzài yí ge xīngqí bú yùndòng jiù bù shūfu.
lines.english: Of course not! I didn't like exercise either. I only started because my doctor told me to, and now if I go a week without it I feel bad.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，不過我不會游泳。
lines.simplified: 好吧，不过我不会游泳。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, búguò wǒ bú huì yóuyǒng.
lines.english: All right, but I can't swim.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就這樣決定了。
lines.simplified: 那就这样决定了。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù zhèyàng juédìng le.
lines.english: Then it's settled.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們這個週末最可能做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们这个周末最可能做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zhège zhōumò zuì kěnéng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will they most likely do this weekend?

questions.why: 下雨的話 they swim or go to the gym; heavy rain is coming, and she can't swim, so the gym is left. The bike ride is the fine-weather plan, and resting at home is her idea, which he turns down.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想運動？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想运动？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng yùndòng?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to exercise?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Her doctor told her to exercise more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她想讓自己的體力好一點
choices.simplified: 她想让自己的体力好一点
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng ràng zìjǐ de tǐlì hǎo yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants to build up her stamina.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng ràng zìjǐ shòu yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants to lose a little weight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō jiāo yìxiē péngyǒu.
choices.english: She wants to make more friends.

questions.why: 我下個月要跟同學去爬山，可是我的體力太差了: she wants more stamina before next month's hike. The doctor is the man's story, and she never mentions her weight or making friends.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想三個月減五公斤。晚上只喝開水的話，是不是會瘦得比較快？
lines.simplified: 我想三个月减五公斤。晚上只喝开水的话，是不是会瘦得比较快？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng sān ge yuè jiǎn wǔ gōngjīn. Wǎnshàng zhǐ hē kāishuǐ dehuà, shì bú shì huì shòu de bǐjiào kuài?
lines.english: I want to lose five kilos in three months. If I only drink water in the evening, will I lose weight faster?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣不好。晚上只喝水，半夜一定會餓，最後還是會跑去便利商店買餅乾。
lines.simplified: 这样不好。晚上只喝水，半夜一定会饿，最后还是会跑去便利商店买饼干。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng bù hǎo. Wǎnshàng zhǐ hē shuǐ, bànyè yídìng huì è, zuìhòu háishì huì pǎo qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi bǐnggān.
lines.english: That's not good. If you only drink water in the evening, you'll be hungry at midnight and end up running to the convenience store for cookies.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我晚上吃完飯去散步，好不好？
lines.simplified: 那我晚上吃完饭去散步，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ wǎnshàng chī wán fàn qù sànbù, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Then how about a walk after dinner?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 飯後散步走得太慢，沒什麼用。你每天要走得快一點，走半個小時，比去健身房跑步容易做到。
lines.simplified: 饭后散步走得太慢，没什么用。你每天要走得快一点，走半个小时，比去健身房跑步容易做到。
lines.pinyin: Fàn hòu sànbù zǒu de tài màn, méi shénme yòng. Nǐ měi tiān yào zǒu de kuài yìdiǎn, zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí, bǐ qù jiànshēnfáng pǎobù róngyì zuò dào.
lines.english: A walk after dinner is too slow to do much good. You need to walk fast for half an hour every day. That's easier to keep up than running at the gym.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來不難，我明天就開始。
lines.simplified: 听起来不难，我明天就开始。
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái bù nán, wǒ míngtiān jiù kāishǐ.
lines.english: Sounds doable. I'll start tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得晚上只喝開水會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得晚上只喝开水会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde wǎnshàng zhǐ hē kāishuǐ huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think will happen if he only drinks water in the evening?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sān ge yuè néng shòu wǔ gōngjīn.
choices.english: He can lose five kilos in three months.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He will want to eat at midnight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng huì shuì de bǐjiào hǎo.
choices.english: He will sleep better at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He will have no energy in the morning.

questions.why: She answers his plan to drink only water in the evening: 半夜一定會餓，最後還是會…買餅乾, so he would be hungry at night and end up eating anyway. Five kilos in three months is only his hope, and she says nothing about sleep or energy in the morning.

focus.en: will surely be hungry at midnight

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的要男的每天做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的要男的每天做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yào nán de měi tiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman want the man to do every day?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Stroll for an hour after dinner.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Run at the gym every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān kuài zǒu bàn ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: Walk fast for half an hour every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Jog for twenty minutes every day.

questions.why: 你每天要走得快一點，走半個小時: a brisk half-hour walk every day. She says a walk after dinner is too slow to do any good, the gym run is only what she compares it with, and she never says to jog.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 李先生，您好，我是健身房的教練。您昨天說想減三公斤，我幫您想了一個計畫。
lines.simplified: 李先生，您好，我是健身房的教练。您昨天说想减三公斤，我帮您想了一个计划。
lines.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng, nín hǎo, wǒ shì jiànshēnfáng de jiàoliàn. Nín zuótiān shuō xiǎng jiǎn sān gōngjīn, wǒ bāng nín xiǎng le yí ge jìhuà.
lines.english: Hello, Mr. Li, this is your coach at the gym. Yesterday you said you'd like to lose three kilos, so I've worked out a plan for you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很多人一開始就每天都來，可是對剛開始健身的人來說，一個星期來三次就夠了，每次一個小時。
lines.simplified: 很多人一开始就每天都来，可是对刚开始健身的人来说，一个星期来三次就够了，每次一个小时。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yìkāishǐ jiù měi tiān dōu lái, kěshì duì gāng kāishǐ jiànshēn de rén lái shuō, yí ge xīngqí lái sān cì jiù gòu le, měi cì yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Many people come every day right from the start, but for someone just starting to work out, three times a week is enough, an hour each time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，上下班的時候別坐公車了，騎腳踏車去，對減體重也很有幫助。
lines.simplified: 还有，上下班的时候别坐公车了，骑脚踏车去，对减体重也很有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, shàngxiàbān de shíhòu bié zuò gōngchē le, qí jiǎotàchē qù, duì jiǎn tǐzhòng yě hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: Also, stop taking the bus to and from work. Riding a bike there helps with losing weight too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 您的第一堂課是星期三晚上七點，請穿運動服來。
lines.simplified: 您的第一堂课是星期三晚上七点，请穿运动服来。
lines.pinyin: Nín de dì yī táng kè shì xīngqísān wǎnshàng qī diǎn, qǐng chuān yùndòngfú lái.
lines.english: Your first session is on Wednesday at seven in the evening. Please come in sportswear.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教練覺得李先生一個星期來幾次就夠了？
prompt.simplified: 教练觉得李先生一个星期来几次就够了？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoliàn juéde Lǐ xiānshēng yí ge xīngqí lái jǐ cì jiù gòu le?
prompt.english: How many times a week does the coach think is enough for Mr. Li?

questions.why: 對剛開始健身的人來說，一個星期來三次就夠了: for a beginner like him, three times a week. Coming every day (seven times) is what many people do (很多人一開始就每天都來), and one is the number of hours per session.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 教練說，除了來健身房，做什麼對減體重也有幫助？
prompt.simplified: 教练说，除了来健身房，做什么对减体重也有帮助？
prompt.pinyin: Jiàoliàn shuō, chúle lái jiànshēnfáng, zuò shénme duì jiǎn tǐzhòng yě yǒu bāngzhù?
prompt.english: Besides coming to the gym, what does the coach say also helps with losing weight?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Taking the bus to and from work.

questions.why: 上下班的時候別坐公車了，騎腳踏車去，對減體重也很有幫助: cycling to work instead of taking the bus. She never mentions walking to work or drinking less cola.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是你們這學期的體育老師。我們每個星期有兩堂體育課，星期二在操場跑步，星期四打籃球。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是你们这学期的体育老师。我们每个星期有两堂体育课，星期二在操场跑步，星期四打篮球。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì nǐmen zhè xuéqí de tǐyù lǎoshī. Wǒmen měi ge xīngqí yǒu liǎng táng tǐyù kè, xīngqí'èr zài cāochǎng pǎobù, xīngqísì dǎ lánqiú.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. I'm your PE teacher this semester. We have two PE classes a week: running on the sports field on Tuesdays and basketball on Thursdays.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對很多同學來說，跑步是最累的，所以一開始我們只跑八百公尺，以後再慢慢增加。
lines.simplified: 对很多同学来说，跑步是最累的，所以一开始我们只跑八百公尺，以后再慢慢增加。
lines.pinyin: Duì hěn duō tóngxué lái shuō, pǎobù shì zuì lèi de, suǒyǐ yìkāishǐ wǒmen zhǐ pǎo bābǎi gōngchǐ, yǐhòu zài mànmàn zēngjiā.
lines.english: For many of you, running is the most tiring, so at first we'll only run 800 meters and slowly add more later.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道大家都覺得打籃球比較好玩，可是跑步對體力比較有幫助，所以星期二的課也一定要來。
lines.simplified: 我知道大家都觉得打篮球比较好玩，可是跑步对体力比较有帮助，所以星期二的课也一定要来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào dàjiā dōu juéde dǎ lánqiú bǐjiào hǎowán, kěshì pǎobù duì tǐlì bǐjiào yǒu bāngzhù, suǒyǐ xīngqí'èr de kè yě yídìng yào lái.
lines.english: I know you all find basketball more fun, but running does more for your stamina, so you must come to Tuesday's class too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，上課的時候，請穿運動服，別穿牛仔褲。
lines.simplified: 还有，上课的时候，请穿运动服，别穿牛仔裤。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu, shàngkè de shíhòu, qǐng chuān yùndòngfú, bié chuān niúzǎikù.

passage.traditional: 以前我很少運動，覺得跑步累死了。上個月醫生說我太胖了，{1}我每天去操場慢跑。一開始我跑十分鐘就想休息，可是越跑{2}輕鬆，現在已經能跑半個小時了。慢跑不但讓我瘦了兩公斤，{3}讓我晚上睡得比較好。以前我上課{4}打瞌睡，現在比較有精神了。我覺得運動對念書也很有{5}，所以現在常常請同學跟我一起去跑。
passage.simplified: 以前我很少运动，觉得跑步累死了。上个月医生说我太胖了，{1}我每天去操场慢跑。一开始我跑十分钟就想休息，可是越跑{2}轻松，现在已经能跑半个小时了。慢跑不但让我瘦了两公斤，{3}让我晚上睡得比较好。以前我上课{4}打瞌睡，现在比较有精神了。我觉得运动对念书也很有{5}，所以现在常常请同学跟我一起去跑。
passage.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hěn shǎo yùndòng, juéde pǎobù lèi sǐ le. Shàng ge yuè yīshēng shuō wǒ tài pàng le, jiànyì wǒ měi tiān qù cāochǎng mànpǎo. Yìkāishǐ wǒ pǎo shí fēnzhōng jiù xiǎng xiūxí, kěshì yuè pǎo yuè qīngsōng, xiànzài yǐjīng néng pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí le. Mànpǎo búdàn ràng wǒ shòu le liǎng gōngjīn, érqiě ràng wǒ wǎnshàng shuì de bǐjiào hǎo. Yǐqián wǒ shàngkè lǎoshì dǎ kēshuì, xiànzài bǐjiào yǒu jīngshén le. Wǒ juéde yùndòng duì niànshū yě hěn yǒu hǎochù, suǒyǐ xiànzài chángcháng qǐng tóngxué gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù pǎo.
passage.english: I used to exercise very little and thought running was terribly tiring. Last month my doctor said I was too heavy and suggested I jog on the sports field every day. At first I wanted to rest after ten minutes, but the more I ran, the easier it got, and now I can run for half an hour. Jogging has not only helped me lose two kilos but also helped me sleep better at night. I used to doze off in class all the time; now I have more energy. I think exercise is good for studying too, so now I often ask classmates to come running with me.

questions.why: 醫生……建議我每天去操場慢跑: 建議 + person + action is the doctor's advice. 繼續, 改善 and 恢復 can't be followed by 我 + something to do.
越跑越輕鬆: the more the writer runs, the easier it gets. 越 … 越 come as a pair, so 更, 還 and 也 can't answer the first 越.
不但……，而且……: 而且 adds the second, bigger gain (better sleep). 所以, 可是 and 然後 don't pair with 不但.
以前我上課老是打瞌睡: the writer always used to doze off in class. 從小 would need 就, 到底 belongs in a question, and 來不及打瞌睡 makes no sense.
運動對念書很有好處: exercise is good for studying (對……有好處). 運動 can't 有興趣 or 有精神 for something, and 有情況 makes no sense here.

passage.traditional: 我家樓下有一位老先生，今年七十歲了。以前他{1}在家看電視，很少出門。去年他女兒建議他多活動，他就開始每天早上去公園散步。{2}他來說，一開始每天早上出門是很辛苦的事，可是他越走{3}有精神，現在每天能走一個小時。他還在公園交了很多朋友。現在他不但身體健康了，{4}心情也好多了。他常說，這樣的生活對老人很有{5}。
passage.simplified: 我家楼下有一位老先生，今年七十岁了。以前他{1}在家看电视，很少出门。去年他女儿建议他多活动，他就开始每天早上去公园散步。{2}他来说，一开始每天早上出门是很辛苦的事，可是他越走{3}有精神，现在每天能走一个小时。他还在公园交了很多朋友。现在他不但身体健康了，{4}心情也好多了。他常说，这样的生活对老人很有{5}。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià yǒu yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng, jīnnián qīshí suì le. Yǐqián tā lǎoshì zài jiā kàn diànshì, hěn shǎo chūmén. Qùnián tā nǚ'ér jiànyì tā duō huódòng, tā jiù kāishǐ měi tiān zǎoshàng qù gōngyuán sànbù. Duì tā lái shuō, yìkāishǐ měi tiān zǎoshàng chūmén shì hěn xīnkǔ de shì, kěshì tā yuè zǒu yuè yǒu jīngshén, xiànzài měi tiān néng zǒu yí ge xiǎoshí. Tā hái zài gōngyuán jiāo le hěn duō péngyǒu. Xiànzài tā búdàn shēntǐ jiànkāng le, érqiě xīnqíng yě hǎo duō le. Tā cháng shuō, zhèyàng de shēnghuó duì lǎorén hěn yǒu hǎochù.
passage.english: An old gentleman lives downstairs from us; he is seventy this year. He used to sit at home watching TV all the time and seldom went out. Last year his daughter advised him to move about more, so he started walking in the park every morning. For him, going out every morning was hard at first, but the more he walked, the more energy he had, and now he can walk for an hour every day. He has also made many friends in the park. Now he is not only healthier but also in a much better mood. He often says this kind of life is good for old people.

questions.why: 以前他老是在家看電視: he always used to stay home watching TV. 從小 would need 就, 到底 belongs in a question, and 繼續 needs something already going on.
對他來說: from his point of view, going out every morning was hard at first. 來說 goes only with 對, not with 跟, 給 or 把.

focus.en: for …; as far as … is concerned

questions.why: 越走越有精神: the more he walks, the more energy he has. 越 … 越 come as a pair, so 更, 還 and 很 can't answer the first 越.
不但身體健康了，而且心情也好多了: 而且 adds the second gain to 不但. 所以, 然後 and 或是 don't pair with 不但.
這樣的生活對老人很有好處: this kind of life is good for old people (對……有好處). A way of life can't 有興趣 or 有精神 for someone, and 有情況 makes no sense here.

text.traditional: 我在一家公司上班。去年老闆發現，很多同事中午吃完飯就一直坐在電腦前面，下午都沒什麼精神，工作也做得很慢。為了改善這個情況，老闆在公司裡開了一間小健身房，還請了一位教練，每個星期一、三、五中午教大家運動半個小時。一開始很多人覺得麻煩，不想參加；可是運動了一個月以後，大家發現下午不但比較有精神，而且工作也做得比較快了。對我來說，最大的好處是背和脖子都不痛了。現在我差不多每天中午都去健身房，有時候也跟同事去公司附近的公園慢跑。
text.simplified: 我在一家公司上班。去年老板发现，很多同事中午吃完饭就一直坐在电脑前面，下午都没什么精神，工作也做得很慢。为了改善这个情况，老板在公司里开了一间小健身房，还请了一位教练，每个星期一、三、五中午教大家运动半个小时。一开始很多人觉得麻烦，不想参加；可是运动了一个月以后，大家发现下午不但比较有精神，而且工作也做得比较快了。对我来说，最大的好处是背和脖子都不痛了。现在我差不多每天中午都去健身房，有时候也跟同事去公司附近的公园慢跑。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān. Qùnián lǎobǎn fāxiàn, hěn duō tóngshì zhōngwǔ chī wán fàn jiù yìzhí zuò zài diànnǎo qiánmiàn, xiàwǔ dōu méi shénme jīngshén, gōngzuò yě zuò de hěn màn. Wèile gǎishàn zhège qíngkuàng, lǎobǎn zài gōngsī lǐ kāi le yì jiān xiǎo jiànshēnfáng, hái qǐng le yí wèi jiàoliàn, měi ge xīngqíyī, sān, wǔ zhōngwǔ jiāo dàjiā yùndòng bàn ge xiǎoshí. Yìkāishǐ hěn duō rén juéde máfán, bù xiǎng cānjiā; kěshì yùndòng le yí ge yuè yǐhòu, dàjiā fāxiàn xiàwǔ búdàn bǐjiào yǒu jīngshén, érqiě gōngzuò yě zuò de bǐjiào kuài le. Duì wǒ lái shuō, zuì dà de hǎochù shì bèi hé bózi dōu bú tòng le. Xiànzài wǒ chàbùduō měi tiān zhōngwǔ dōu qù jiànshēnfáng, yǒu shíhòu yě gēn tóngshì qù gōngsī fùjìn de gōngyuán mànpǎo.
text.english: I work at a company. Last year the boss noticed that many of my coworkers sat at their computers all the time after lunch, had little energy in the afternoon and worked slowly. To improve this, the boss opened a small gym in the company and hired a coach, who teaches everyone a half-hour workout at noon every Monday, Wednesday and Friday. At first many people found it a bother and didn't want to take part; but after a month of exercise, everyone found they not only had more energy in the afternoon but also worked faster. For me, the biggest benefit is that my back and neck no longer hurt. Now I go to the gym at noon almost every day, and sometimes I jog in the park near the company with coworkers.

text.traditional: 我兒子今年十歲。以前他一回家就坐在沙發上玩手機，週末也不想出門，跟我們說的話越來越少。對他來說，運動是最無聊的事。去年夏天，我們決定每個星期六早上一家人一起去附近的學校打籃球。一開始他常常說不想去，可是後來他越打越喜歡，現在每個星期六都是他叫我們起床。打完球，我們常常一起去吃早飯，一邊吃一邊聊天。我發現，他不但身體越來越好，跟我們說的話也比以前多了。
text.simplified: 我儿子今年十岁。以前他一回家就坐在沙发上玩手机，周末也不想出门，跟我们说的话越来越少。对他来说，运动是最无聊的事。去年夏天，我们决定每个星期六早上一家人一起去附近的学校打篮球。一开始他常常说不想去，可是后来他越打越喜欢，现在每个星期六都是他叫我们起床。打完球，我们常常一起去吃早饭，一边吃一边聊天。我发现，他不但身体越来越好，跟我们说的话也比以前多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ érzi jīnnián shí suì. Yǐqián tā yì huí jiā jiù zuò zài shāfā shàng wán shǒujī, zhōumò yě bù xiǎng chūmén, gēn wǒmen shuō de huà yuè lái yuè shǎo. Duì tā lái shuō, yùndòng shì zuì wúliáo de shì. Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒmen juédìng měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng yì jiā rén yìqǐ qù fùjìn de xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú. Yìkāishǐ tā chángcháng shuō bù xiǎng qù, kěshì hòulái tā yuè dǎ yuè xǐhuān, xiànzài měi ge xīngqíliù dōu shì tā jiào wǒmen qǐchuáng. Dǎ wán qiú, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù chī zǎofàn, yìbiān chī yìbiān liáotiān. Wǒ fāxiàn, tā búdàn shēntǐ yuè lái yuè hǎo, gēn wǒmen shuō de huà yě bǐ yǐqián duō le.
text.english: My son is ten. He used to sit on the sofa playing on his phone as soon as he got home, didn't want to go out at weekends, and talked with us less and less. To him, exercise was the most boring thing there was. Last summer we decided that every Saturday morning the whole family would play basketball at a school nearby. At first he often said he didn't want to go, but later, the more he played, the more he liked it, and now he is the one who wakes us up every Saturday. After the game we often go for breakfast together, eating and chatting. I've found that he is not only getting healthier, but also talks with us more than before.

prompt.traditional: 以前兒子覺得運動怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 以前儿子觉得运动怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yǐqián érzi juéde yùndòng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What did the son think of exercise before?

choices.pinyin: Huì ràng tā juéde hěn lèi.

questions.why: 對他來說，運動是最無聊的事: to him, exercise was the most boring thing of all. He preferred his phone, and the passage never says he found it tiring or healthy back then.

text.traditional: 上個週末，我的兩個日本朋友來台灣玩。為了讓他們了解台灣的夜市文化，我帶他們去逛夜市。那天晚上人多得不得了，我們擠了半天才走到賣臭豆腐的地方。我推薦他們吃吃看，可是一個朋友聞到味道就不敢吃了，只好買了一碗芒果冰。還有一個朋友吃了一點以後，覺得越吃越香，一個人吃完了一大盤。後來他想買一件毛衣，老闆說一件八百塊，我幫他跟老闆殺價，最後六百塊就買到了。回去的時候，他們都說吃得太飽了，明天還想再來。
text.simplified: 上个周末，我的两个日本朋友来台湾玩。为了让他们了解台湾的夜市文化，我带他们去逛夜市。那天晚上人多得不得了，我们挤了半天才走到卖臭豆腐的地方。我推荐他们吃吃看，可是一个朋友闻到味道就不敢吃了，只好买了一碗芒果冰。还有一个朋友吃了一点以后，觉得越吃越香，一个人吃完了一大盘。后来他想买一件毛衣，老板说一件八百块，我帮他跟老板杀价，最后六百块就买到了。回去的时候，他们都说吃得太饱了，明天还想再来。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ de liǎng ge Rìběn péngyǒu lái Táiwān wán. Wèile ràng tāmen liǎojiě Táiwān de yèshì wénhuà, wǒ dài tāmen qù guàng yèshì. Nà tiān wǎnshàng rén duō de bùdéliǎo, wǒmen jǐ le bàntiān cái zǒu dào mài chòudòufǔ de dìfāng. Wǒ tuījiàn tāmen chīchī kàn, kěshì yí ge péngyǒu wén dào wèidào jiù bù gǎn chī le, zhǐhǎo mǎi le yì wǎn mángguǒbīng. Hái yǒu yí ge péngyǒu chī le yìdiǎn yǐhòu, juéde yuè chī yuè xiāng, yí ge rén chī wán le yí dà pán. Hòulái tā xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn máoyī, lǎobǎn shuō yí jiàn bābǎi kuài, wǒ bāng tā gēn lǎobǎn shājià, zuìhòu liùbǎi kuài jiù mǎi dào le. Huíqù de shíhòu, tāmen dōu shuō chī de tài bǎo le, míngtiān hái xiǎng zài lái.
text.english: Last weekend two Japanese friends of mine came to Taiwan on holiday. To show them Taiwan's night-market culture, I took them to a night market. It was incredibly crowded that evening, and it took us ages to squeeze our way to the stinky tofu stall. I told them to try it, but one friend didn't dare eat it once he smelled it, so he had to buy a bowl of mango ice instead. My other friend had a little, found it tastier with every bite and finished a big plate by himself. Later he wanted a sweater; the owner said NT$800, I haggled with the owner for him, and in the end he got it for 600. On the way back they both said they were too full, and that they wanted to come back tomorrow.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人為什麼帶朋友去逛夜市？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人为什么带朋友去逛夜市？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén wèishénme dài péngyǒu qù guàng yèshì?
prompt.english: Why did the writer take the friends to the night market?

choices.english: The friends wanted Taiwanese street food.

choices.traditional: 想介紹台灣的夜市文化
choices.simplified: 想介绍台湾的夜市文化
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng jièshào Táiwān de yèshì wénhuà.

choices.english: To let the friends practise Chinese.

choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu xiǎng mǎi piányí de yīfu.

questions.why: 為了讓他們了解台灣的夜市文化: to show them Taiwan's night-market culture. The friends never ask for street food or cheap clothes (the stinky tofu was the writer's idea, and the sweater came up later), and Chinese practice is never mentioned.

prompt.traditional: 那個不敢吃臭豆腐的朋友後來怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 那个不敢吃臭豆腐的朋友后来怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Nàge bù gǎn chī chòudòufǔ de péngyǒu hòulái zěnme le?
prompt.english: What did the friend who didn't dare eat the stinky tofu do?

choices.pinyin: Tā chī wán le yí dà pán.
Tā yuè chī yuè juéde xiāng.
choices.english: He liked it more with every bite.

choices.pinyin: Tā gǎi chī le bié de dōngxi.
Tā shénme dōu méi chī jiù zǒu le.

questions.why: 只好買了一碗芒果冰: with no other choice, he got mango ice instead. Finishing a big plate and liking it more with every bite were the other friend.

prompt.traditional: 朋友買毛衣的時候，寫這篇文章的人做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 朋友买毛衣的时候，写这篇文章的人做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Péngyǒu mǎi máoyī de shíhòu, xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer do when the friend bought the sweater?

choices.english: Helped the friend choose a colour.
Recommended the sweater to the friend.

questions.why: 我幫他跟老闆殺價: the writer haggled the price down from 800 to 600 (殺價 = 講價). The writer recommended the stinky tofu, not the sweater, and says nothing about paying or colours.

text.traditional: 我跟室友一起租了一間公寓，房租每個月一萬兩千塊，我們一個人付一半。我們說好了，每個星期六一起打掃：我負責掃地、倒垃圾，她負責擦桌子、洗碗。可是我的室友總是很晚才起床，常常到了中午還沒把碗洗完，廚房裡到處都是髒碗筷。上個星期六，房東來收房租，看到廚房那麼亂，非常不高興。後來我們決定，誰先把自己的家事做完，誰就可以決定晚上看什麼電影。現在我的室友每個星期六都很早就起床了。
text.simplified: 我跟室友一起租了一间公寓，房租每个月一万两千块，我们一个人付一半。我们说好了，每个星期六一起打扫：我负责扫地、倒垃圾，她负责擦桌子、洗碗。可是我的室友总是很晚才起床，常常到了中午还没把碗洗完，厨房里到处都是脏碗筷。上个星期六，房东来收房租，看到厨房那么乱，非常不高兴。后来我们决定，谁先把自己的家事做完，谁就可以决定晚上看什么电影。现在我的室友每个星期六都很早就起床了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu yìqǐ zū le yì jiān gōngyù, fángzū měi ge yuè yíwàn liǎngqiān kuài, wǒmen yí ge rén fù yíbàn. Wǒmen shuō hǎo le, měi ge xīngqíliù yìqǐ dǎsǎo: wǒ fùzé sǎodì, dào lèsè, tā fùzé cā zhuōzi, xǐ wǎn. Kěshì wǒ de shìyǒu zǒngshì hěn wǎn cái qǐchuáng, chángcháng dào le zhōngwǔ hái méi bǎ wǎn xǐ wán, chúfáng lǐ dàochù dōu shì zāng wǎnkuài. Shàng ge xīngqíliù, fángdōng lái shōu fángzū, kàn dào chúfáng nàme luàn, fēicháng bù gāoxìng. Hòulái wǒmen juédìng, shéi xiān bǎ zìjǐ de jiāshì zuò wán, shéi jiù kěyǐ juédìng wǎnshàng kàn shénme diànyǐng. Xiànzài wǒ de shìyǒu měi ge xīngqíliù dōu hěn zǎo jiù qǐchuáng le.
text.english: My roommate and I rent an apartment together. The rent is NT$12,000 a month, and we each pay half. We agreed to clean together every Saturday: I sweep the floor and take out the trash, and she wipes the tables and washes the dishes. But my roommate always gets up very late, often hasn't finished the dishes by noon, and dirty dishes are everywhere in the kitchen. Last Saturday the landlord came to collect the rent, saw the messy kitchen and was very unhappy. Later we decided that whoever finishes her own chores first gets to decide which movie we watch that evening. Now my roommate gets up early every Saturday.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人每個月要付多少房租？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人每个月要付多少房租？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén měi ge yuè yào fù duōshǎo fángzū?
prompt.english: How much rent does the writer pay each month?

questions.why: The rent is 12,000 a month and 我們一個人付一半: each pays half, 6,000. 12,000 is the whole rent, not the writer's share.

prompt.traditional: 房東為什麼生氣？
prompt.simplified: 房东为什么生气？

prompt.english: Why was the landlord angry?

It was too noisy at night.
The kitchen was dirty and messy.
The trash hadn't been taken out.

questions.why: 看到廚房那麼亂，非常不高興: he saw the kitchen full of dirty dishes. The living room, noise and the trash are never mentioned.

questions.why: 誰先把自己的家事做完，誰就可以決定晚上看什麼電影: whoever finishes her chores first picks the evening's movie. They don't swap chores, and there is no treat for getting up late and no deadline.

picture.alt: A sunny club fair on a university campus: tents in blue, orange, green and red, students walking between them, trees and brick buildings behind. Two young men with backpacks stand in front. On the left, under a blue tent, an acoustic guitar stands on a black stand next to a table with a red cloth; nobody is holding it. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers stands near it with his hands in his pockets, leaning forward and looking right, at the next table. On the right, at a table with a blue cloth, a young man with wavy brown shoulder-length hair, a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt, dark green trousers and a white backpack holds a calligraphy brush up in his right hand and looks down at a sheet of white paper held by a wooden weight, his left hand resting on the table; a pot of brushes and an ink stone stand on the table. Far behind him on the right, people in black clothes do kung fu on a red carpet.

A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt sits at a table between two small boys, smiling, and holds out a blue crayon to the boy on the right, who reaches for it. The boy on the left has curly brown hair and an orange T-shirt and draws with a red crayon on a picture with a yellow sun and green trees. The boy on the right has short black hair and a dark blue T-shirt, holds a green crayon in his other hand and has drawn a house, trees and a sun. A box of crayons and a cup of crayons stand on the table. Nobody is reading. In the back, a woman with reddish-brown hair and a green apron works at a table.
