lines.simplified: 别想太多！你的技巧是社团里最好的，大家当然都问你。
lines.pinyin: Bié xiǎng tài duō! Nǐ de jìqiǎo shì shètuán lǐ zuì hǎo de, dàjiā dāngrán dōu wèn nǐ.
lines.english: Don't read too much into it! Your skills are the best in the club, so of course everyone asks you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那她為什麼每次都坐在我旁邊？
lines.simplified: 那她为什么每次都坐在我旁边？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā wèishénme měi cì dōu zuò zài wǒ pángbiān?
lines.english: Then why does she sit next to me every time?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 因為你那裡離門口最近，她每次都最晚到。她是對吉他感興趣，不是對你。
lines.simplified: 因为你那里离门口最近，她每次都最晚到。她是对吉他感兴趣，不是对你。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ nàlǐ lí ménkǒu zuì jìn, tā měi cì dōu zuì wǎn dào. Tā shì duì jítā gǎnxìngqù, bú shì duì nǐ.
lines.english: Because your spot is closest to the door, and she always arrives last. It's the guitar she's interested in, not you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的的意思是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的的意思是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de de yìsi shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng měi cì dōu zǎo dào.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng xiǎng xué hǎo jítā.
choices.english: The girl wants to get good at guitar.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那個女生想多認識男的
choices.simplified: 那个女生想多认识男的
choices.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng xiǎng duō rènshì nán de.
choices.english: The girl wants to get to know the man.

questions.why: 她是對吉他感興趣，不是對你: what the girl is interested in is the guitar, not the man; she asks him because his skills are the best and sits by him because his spot is nearest the door and she comes last. Getting to know him is only the man's hope, and she arrives late, not early.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才有人打電話找妳，她沒說自己是誰，可是我一聽就聽出來是妳媽媽。
lines.simplified: 刚才有人打电话找你，她没说自己是谁，可是我一听就听出来是你妈妈。
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà zhǎo nǐ, tā méi shuō zìjǐ shì shéi, kěshì wǒ yì tīng jiù tīng chūlái shì nǐ māma.
lines.english: Someone called for you just now. She didn't say who she was, but I could tell it was your mom as soon as I heard her.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼聽得出來？你沒見過我媽媽啊！
lines.simplified: 你怎么听得出来？你没见过我妈妈啊！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme tīng de chūlái? Nǐ méi jiàn guo wǒ māma a!
lines.english: How could you tell? You've never met my mom!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒見過，照片也沒看過，可是她的聲音跟妳的一樣啊！
lines.simplified: 没见过，照片也没看过，可是她的声音跟你的一样啊！
lines.pinyin: Méi jiàn guo, zhàopiàn yě méi kàn guo, kěshì tā de shēngyīn gēn nǐ de yíyàng a!
lines.english: I haven't met her or even seen a photo, but her voice is just like yours!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈，很多人都這麼說。
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈，很多人都这么说。
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā, hěn duō rén dōu zhème shuō.
lines.english: Hahaha, lots of people say that.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的怎麼知道是誰打電話來的？
prompt.simplified: 男的怎么知道是谁打电话来的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zěnme zhīdào shì shéi dǎ diànhuà lái de?
prompt.english: How did the man know who called?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā gēn nǚ'ér de shēngyīn hěn xiàng.
choices.english: Her voice is like her daughter's.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiān shuō le zìjǐ shì shéi.
choices.english: She said who she was first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā kàn guo tā de zhàopiàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐqián tīng guo tā de shēngyīn.
choices.english: He had heard her voice before.

questions.why: 我一聽就聽出來: he could tell just by hearing her, because her voice is the same as the woman's (她的聲音跟妳的一樣). She didn't say who she was, he has never met her or seen her photo, and he only knew the daughter's voice, not hers.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六班上要辦活動，老師要我們兩個安排，你想出來要做什麼了嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六班上要办活动，老师要我们两个安排，你想出来要做什么了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù bān shàng yào bàn huódòng, lǎoshī yào wǒmen liǎng ge ānpái, nǐ xiǎng chūlái yào zuò shénme le ma?
lines.english: Our class is having an event this Saturday, and the teacher wants the two of us to plan it. Have you come up with what to do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 想出來了！上次大家一起去吃飯，很多人都不太說話，這次帶大家去外邊烤肉吧。
lines.simplified: 想出来了！上次大家一起去吃饭，很多人都不太说话，这次带大家去外边烤肉吧。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng chūlái le! Shàng cì dàjiā yìqǐ qù chīfàn, hěn duō rén dōu bú tài shuōhuà, zhè cì dài dàjiā qù wàibiān kǎoròu ba.
lines.english: I have! Last time we all went out to eat and lots of people hardly talked. This time let's take everyone outside for a barbecue.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是聽說那天會下大雨。
lines.simplified: 可是听说那天会下大雨。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tīngshuō nà tiān huì xià dà yǔ.
lines.english: But I heard it's going to pour that day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就在教室裡，讓每個人表演一首拿手的歌吧。
lines.simplified: 那就在教室里，让每个人表演一首拿手的歌吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù zài jiàoshì lǐ, ràng měi ge rén biǎoyǎn yì shǒu náshǒu de gē ba.
lines.english: Then let's stay in the classroom and have everyone perform the song they sing best.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後想出來的活動是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后想出来的活动是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu xiǎng chūlái de huódòng shì shénme?
prompt.english: What activity does the man come up with in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Taking everyone outside for a barbecue.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Singing for each other in the classroom.

questions.why: His first idea, a barbecue outside (去外邊烤肉), is dropped because of the rain, and eating out was last time's event. What he comes up with in the end is staying in the classroom while everyone performs a song.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是說要去健身房嗎？怎麼還在這裡？
lines.simplified: 你不是说要去健身房吗？怎么还在这里？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō yào qù jiànshēnfáng ma? Zěnme hái zài zhèlǐ?
lines.english: Didn't you say you were going to the gym? Why are you still here?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來要去，可是教練今天頭痛，下午不來了。
lines.simplified: 本来要去，可是教练今天头痛，下午不来了。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái yào qù, kěshì jiàoliàn jīntiān tóutòng, xiàwǔ bù lái le.
lines.english: I was going to, but my coach has a headache today and isn't coming this afternoon.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你到底還去不去？
lines.simplified: 那你到底还去不去？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ dàodǐ hái qù bú qù?
lines.english: So are you going or not?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我先去操場慢跑，等教練明天來了，再去健身房。
lines.simplified: 我先去操场慢跑，等教练明天来了，再去健身房。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān qù cāochǎng mànpǎo, děng jiàoliàn míngtiān lái le, zài qù jiànshēnfáng.
lines.english: I'll go jogging on the sports field first, and go to the gym when the coach is back tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今天下午要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的今天下午要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīntiān xiàwǔ yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the man do this afternoon?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Take the coach to see a doctor.

questions.why: The coach has a headache and won't come this afternoon, so he will jog on the sports field first (先去操場慢跑) and go to the gym tomorrow when the coach is back. Nobody takes the coach to a doctor.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想趁著放假去花蓮玩，可是網頁上說，火車票都賣光了。
lines.simplified: 我想趁着放假去花莲玩，可是网页上说，火车票都卖光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe fàngjià qù Huālián wán, kěshì wǎngyè shàng shuō, huǒchē piào dōu mài guāng le.
lines.english: I want to make use of the holiday to visit Hualien, but the website says the train tickets are all sold out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你要開車去，還是坐飛機去？
lines.simplified: 那你要开车去，还是坐飞机去？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào kāichē qù, háishì zuò fēijī qù?
lines.english: Then will you drive, or fly?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我不會開車，機票又太貴，只好坐六個小時的巴士了。
lines.simplified: 我不会开车，机票又太贵，只好坐六个小时的巴士了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì kāichē, jīpiào yòu tài guì, zhǐhǎo zuò liù ge xiǎoshí de bāshì le.
lines.english: I can't drive, and plane tickets are too expensive, so I'll just have to take the six-hour bus.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 坐那麼久，不累嗎？
lines.simplified: 坐那么久，不累吗？
lines.pinyin: Zuò nàme jiǔ, bú lèi ma?
lines.english: Won't you be tired after so long?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還好，我可以在車上睡覺。
lines.simplified: 还好，我可以在车上睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Hái hǎo, wǒ kěyǐ zài chē shàng shuìjiào.
lines.english: It's fine. I can sleep on the bus.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼去花蓮？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么去花莲？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme qù Huālián?
prompt.english: How is the man going to get to Hualien?

questions.why: The train tickets are sold out (賣光了), he can't drive and plane tickets are too expensive, so he has no choice but to take the six-hour bus (只好坐六個小時的巴士了).

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你參加了什麼社團？覺得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你参加了什么社团？觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ cānjiā le shénme shètuán? Juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: Which clubs did you join? How are they?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 吉他社跟功夫社。吉他社的社員都很好，大家常常互相幫忙。功夫社嘛……
lines.simplified: 吉他社跟功夫社。吉他社的社员都很好，大家常常互相帮忙。功夫社嘛……
lines.pinyin: Jítā shè gēn gōngfu shè. Jítā shè de shèyuán dōu hěn hǎo, dàjiā chángcháng hùxiāng bāngmáng. Gōngfu shè ma……
lines.english: The guitar club and the kung fu club. The guitar club members are all nice; we often help each other. The kung fu club, well…

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 怎麼了？教練不好嗎？
lines.simplified: 怎么了？教练不好吗？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme le? Jiàoliàn bù hǎo ma?
lines.english: What's wrong? Is the coach not good?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 教練很厲害，可是每次練習都要先跑操場，跑完我累得一點都不想動。
lines.simplified: 教练很厉害，可是每次练习都要先跑操场，跑完我累得一点都不想动。
lines.pinyin: Jiàoliàn hěn lìhài, kěshì měi cì liànxí dōu yào xiān pǎo cāochǎng, pǎo wán wǒ lèi de yìdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng dòng.
lines.english: The coach is amazing, but every practice starts with running laps of the field, and afterwards I'm too tired to move at all.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你還要繼續參加嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你还要继续参加吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ hái yào jìxù cānjiā ma?
lines.english: Then are you going to keep going?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 要啊！下個月功夫社要表演，我已經跟教練說好要上去表演了。
lines.simplified: 要啊！下个月功夫社要表演，我已经跟教练说好要上去表演了。
lines.pinyin: Yào a! Xià ge yuè gōngfu shè yào biǎoyǎn, wǒ yǐjīng gēn jiàoliàn shuō hǎo yào shàngqù biǎoyǎn le.
lines.english: Yes! The kung fu club has a show next month, and I've already told the coach I'll be on stage.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得功夫社怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得功夫社怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde gōngfu shè zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the kung fu club?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The members often help each other.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiàoliàn de jìqiǎo bú tài hǎo.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ jítā shè qīngsōng duō le.
choices.english: It's much more relaxed than the guitar club.

questions.why: 功夫社嘛…… opens the part he is less happy about: every practice starts with running, and he is too tired to move afterwards. The coach is good (很厲害), and the members helping each other is the guitar club.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼還要參加功夫社？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么还要参加功夫社？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme hái yào cānjiā gōngfu shè?
prompt.english: Why is the man going to stay in the kung fu club?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gēn jiàoliàn yíyàng lìhài.
choices.english: He wants to be as good as the coach.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè yào biǎoyǎn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He wants to practise running more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jítā shè méiyǒu gōngfu shè hǎo.
choices.english: The guitar club isn't as good as the kung fu club.

questions.why: He stays because the club performs next month and he has already promised the coach to be on stage (說好要上去表演了). He only says the coach is amazing, the running is what tires him, and he praises the guitar club.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個週末去醫院服務，都做了什麼？
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去医院服务，都做了什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù yīyuàn fúwù, dōu zuò le shénme?
lines.english: You did service at the hospital last weekend. What did you do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我陪一位老先生去檢查身體，還幫他掛號。他的家人都在國外，沒有人照顧他。
lines.simplified: 我陪一位老先生去检查身体，还帮他挂号。他的家人都在国外，没有人照顾他。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ péi yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng qù jiǎnchá shēntǐ, hái bāng tā guàhào. Tā de jiārén dōu zài guówài, méiyǒu rén zhàogù tā.
lines.english: I took an old man to his checkup and registered him at the counter. His family all live abroad, so nobody looks after him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你真有愛心！那醫院的工作你都會做嗎？
lines.simplified: 你真有爱心！那医院的工作你都会做吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn yǒu àixīn! Nà yīyuàn de gōngzuò nǐ dōu huì zuò ma?
lines.english: You really are caring! So can you do all the hospital work?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 掛號很簡單，住院、出院的事嘛……還得多學一學。下次社團會安排護士來教我們。
lines.simplified: 挂号很简单，住院、出院的事嘛……还得多学一学。下次社团会安排护士来教我们。
lines.pinyin: Guàhào hěn jiǎndān, zhùyuàn, chūyuàn de shì ma……hái děi duō xué yì xué. Xià cì shètuán huì ānpái hùshì lái jiāo wǒmen.
lines.english: Registering is easy. Admission and discharge, well… I still have a lot to learn. Next time the club will have a nurse come and teach us.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那位老先生現在怎麼樣了？
lines.simplified: 那位老先生现在怎么样了？
lines.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng xiànzài zěnmeyàng le?
lines.english: How is the old man now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生說他得住院幾天，我這個週末要去病房看他。
lines.simplified: 医生说他得住院几天，我这个周末要去病房看他。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā děi zhùyuàn jǐ tiān, wǒ zhège zhōumò yào qù bìngfáng kàn tā.
lines.english: The doctor says he has to stay in hospital for a few days. I'm going to visit him on the ward this weekend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得醫院的工作怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得医院的工作怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde yīyuàn de gōngzuò zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the hospital work?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hùshì yǐjīng jiāo guo tā le.
choices.english: A nurse has already taught him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng huì bàn chūyuàn le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā hái bú tài huì bàn zhùyuàn.
choices.english: He can't really handle admissions yet.

questions.why: 住院、出院的事嘛……還得多學一學: 嘛 opens the part he is unsure of; admissions and discharges he still has to learn. Registering is the easy part, and the nurse will only come next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那位老先生這幾天會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 那位老先生这几天会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zhè jǐ tiān huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What will happen to the old man over the next few days?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huì xiān huí jiā xiūxí jǐ tiān.
choices.english: He will go home to rest for a few days.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiārén huì lái yīyuàn péi tā.
choices.english: His family will come to the hospital to be with him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái děi zài yīyuàn zhù jǐ tiān.
choices.english: He has to stay in hospital a few more days.

questions.why: 醫生說他得住院幾天: the doctor says he must stay in hospital for a few days, and the man will visit him on the ward this weekend. His family is abroad, and he is not going home yet.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。

intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 喂，我是愛心服務社的社員。這個星期六我們要去安養院，早上九點在學校門口見面，坐車過去大概一個小時。
lines.simplified: 喂，我是爱心服务社的社员。这个星期六我们要去安养院，早上九点在学校门口见面，坐车过去大概一个小时。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, wǒ shì àixīn fúwù shè de shèyuán. Zhège xīngqíliù wǒmen yào qù ānyǎng yuàn, zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jiànmiàn, zuò chē guòqù dàgài yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Hello, I'm a member of the volunteer service club. This Saturday we're going to the nursing home. We meet at the school gate at nine in the morning; the ride there takes about an hour.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次我們要幫老人打掃房間、刷馬桶，打掃用的東西、午飯跟水，安養院都會準備。請你帶一件不要了的衣服，打掃的時候穿，弄髒了也沒關係。
lines.simplified: 这次我们要帮老人打扫房间、刷马桶，打扫用的东西、午饭跟水，安养院都会准备。请你带一件不要了的衣服，打扫的时候穿，弄脏了也没关系。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo fángjiān, shuā mǎtǒng, dǎsǎo yòng de dōngxi, wǔfàn gēn shuǐ, ānyǎng yuàn dōu huì zhǔnbèi. Qǐng nǐ dài yí jiàn bú yào le de yīfu, dǎsǎo de shíhòu chuān, nòng zāng le yě méiguānxi.
lines.english: This time we're cleaning the old people's rooms and scrubbing the toilets. The nursing home will have the cleaning things, lunch and water ready. Please bring a piece of clothing you don't want any more to wear while cleaning; it doesn't matter if it gets dirty.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 活動下午三點結束，再坐一個小時的車回學校。不能來的話，請今天晚上打電話告訴我。
lines.simplified: 活动下午三点结束，再坐一个小时的车回学校。不能来的话，请今天晚上打电话告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Huódòng xiàwǔ sān diǎn jiéshù, zài zuò yí ge xiǎoshí de chē huí xuéxiào. Bù néng lái de huà, qǐng jīntiān wǎnshàng dǎ diànhuà gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: The activity ends at three in the afternoon, and then it's another hour's ride back to school. If you can't come, please call me tonight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 參加這次活動的人要帶什麼？
prompt.simplified: 参加这次活动的人要带什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì huódòng de rén yào dài shénme?
prompt.english: What do the people going on this outing need to bring?

questions.why: The nursing home has the cleaning things, lunch and water ready; what to bring is a piece of clothing you don't want any more (一件不要了的衣服), to wear while cleaning.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們大概幾點會回到學校？
prompt.simplified: 他们大概几点会回到学校？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen dàgài jǐ diǎn huì huí dào xuéxiào?
prompt.english: About what time will they get back to school?

questions.why: The activity ends at three, and the ride back takes another hour (再坐一個小時的車回學校), so they are back at about four. Nine is when they meet, and ten when they reach the nursing home.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是英文系二年級的學生。我從小就對中華文化很感興趣，可是以前一直沒有機會學書法。

lines.english: Hello, everyone. I'm a second-year student in the English department. I've been interested in Chinese culture since I was little, but I never had a chance to learn calligraphy before.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上個學期我參加了功夫社，可是練習的時間跟我上課的時間一樣，去了兩次，就只好不去了。

活動：鋼琴社、吉他社、書法社、功夫社等二十個社團都會在圖書館前面擺攤子，社員會給大家介紹自己的社團。
表演：9月20日（星期三）中午12點，功夫社表演中國功夫
注意：想參加社團，請在攤子上寫你的名字跟電話。一個人只能參加三個社團。每天最早來的五十位同學，可以拿到一張明信片。

注意：想参加社团，请在摊子上写你的名字跟电话。一个人只能参加三个社团。每天最早来的五十位同学，可以拿到一张明信片。

Shíjiān: Jiǔ yuè shíbā rì dào èrshí'èr rì (xīngqíyī dào xīngqíwǔ) zǎoshàng shí diǎn dào xiàwǔ sì diǎn
Huódòng: Gāngqín shè, jítā shè, shūfǎ shè, gōngfu shè děng èrshí ge shètuán dōu huì zài túshūguǎn qiánmiàn bǎi tānzi, shèyuán huì gěi dàjiā jièshào zìjǐ de shètuán.

Zhùyì: Xiǎng cānjiā shètuán, qǐng zài tānzi shàng xiě nǐ de míngzi gēn diànhuà. Yí ge rén zhǐ néng cānjiā sān ge shètuán. Měi tiān zuì zǎo lái de wǔshí wèi tóngxué, kěyǐ ná dào yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn.

Time: September 18–22 (Monday to Friday), 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
What: twenty clubs, including the piano, guitar, calligraphy and kung fu clubs, will set up stalls in front of the library, and their members will tell you about their clubs.

passage.traditional: 開學第一個星期，圖書館前面{1}了很多社團的攤子。我把攤子都看了一遍，最後選擇了吉他社，{2}我的室友上個學期就參加了，我們可以一起去練習。第一次去練習的時候，教室裡{3}著二十幾個社員，大家都很客氣。我旁邊的男生教了我很多技巧，我們聊了一下，才知道他跟我是{4}一個系的。{5}他只比我大一歲，可是吉他學得比我好多了。
passage.simplified: 开学第一个星期，图书馆前面{1}了很多社团的摊子。我把摊子都看了一遍，最后选择了吉他社，{2}我的室友上个学期就参加了，我们可以一起去练习。第一次去练习的时候，教室里{3}着二十几个社员，大家都很客气。我旁边的男生教了我很多技巧，我们聊了一下，才知道他跟我是{4}一个系的。{5}他只比我大一岁，可是吉他学得比我好多了。
passage.pinyin: Kāixué dì yī ge xīngqí, túshūguǎn qiánmiàn bǎi le hěn duō shètuán de tānzi. Wǒ bǎ tānzi dōu kàn le yí biàn, zuìhòu xuǎnzé le jítā shè, yīnwèi wǒ de shìyǒu shàng ge xuéqí jiù cānjiā le, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù liànxí. Dì yī cì qù liànxí de shíhòu, jiàoshì lǐ zuò zhe èrshí jǐ ge shèyuán, dàjiā dōu hěn kèqì. Wǒ pángbiān de nánshēng jiāo le wǒ hěn duō jìqiǎo, wǒmen liáo le yíxià, cái zhīdào tā gēn wǒ shì tóng yí ge xì de. Suīrán tā zhǐ bǐ wǒ dà yí suì, kěshì jítā xué de bǐ wǒ hǎo duō le.
passage.english: In the first week of the semester, lots of club stalls were set up in front of the library. I went round all of them once and in the end chose the guitar club, because my roommate joined it last semester, so we could go to practice together. At my first practice, twenty-odd members were sitting in the classroom, all very friendly. The young man next to me taught me a lot of technique; we chatted a bit and only then found out that he and I are in the same department. Although he is only a year older than me, he plays far better than I do.

questions.why: Place + 擺了 + N: stalls are things that are set out (擺). 站 and 躺 are for people, and stalls are not stuck up (貼) like posters.
The roommate joining last semester is the reason for choosing the guitar club, so 因為. 所以 and 然後 would put last semester after this choice, and 除了 needs 還／也 after it.
Place + 坐著 + people: for people the verb shows their posture (坐). 放, 掛 and 停 say how things or cars are placed, not people.
跟……是同一個系的: two people in the same department. 各一個, 每一個 and 哪一個 can't name what two people share.
雖然……，可是……: only a year older, but much better at guitar. 可是 needs 雖然 in the first half; 不但 pairs with 而且, 為了 needs a goal, and 只要 needs 就.

passage.traditional: 上個週末天氣很好，愛心服務社{1}我們去安養院服務。安養院門口{2}著一張海報，上面寫著「歡迎大家來服務」。我們先幫老人打掃環境，再陪他們聊天。有一位老先生說，他年輕的時候跟我爸爸在{3}一家公司上班！我聽了，{4}打電話告訴爸爸，爸爸聽了也很高興。這次服務{5}讓我幫助了別人，而且讓我認識了一位新朋友。
passage.simplified: 上个周末天气很好，爱心服务社{1}我们去安养院服务。安养院门口{2}着一张海报，上面写着「欢迎大家来服务」。我们先帮老人打扫环境，再陪他们聊天。有一位老先生说，他年轻的时候跟我爸爸在{3}一家公司上班！我听了，{4}打电话告诉爸爸，爸爸听了也很高兴。这次服务{5}让我帮助了别人，而且让我认识了一位新朋友。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò tiānqì hěn hǎo, àixīn fúwù shè ānpái wǒmen qù ānyǎng yuàn fúwù. Ānyǎng yuàn ménkǒu tiē zhe yì zhāng hǎibào, shàngmiàn xiě zhe “Huānyíng dàjiā lái fúwù”. Wǒmen xiān bāng lǎorén dǎsǎo huánjìng, zài péi tāmen liáotiān. Yǒu yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng shuō, tā niánqīng de shíhòu gēn wǒ bàba zài tóng yì jiā gōngsī shàngbān! Wǒ tīng le, lìkè dǎ diànhuà gàosu bàba, bàba tīng le yě hěn gāoxìng. Zhè cì fúwù búdàn ràng wǒ bāngzhù le biérén, érqiě ràng wǒ rènshì le yí wèi xīn péngyǒu.
passage.english: Last weekend the weather was lovely, and the volunteer service club arranged for us to help at a nursing home. A poster was stuck up at its entrance, saying "Everyone is welcome to come and help". First we cleaned up for the old people, then we chatted with them. One old man said that when he was young he worked at the same company as my dad! When I heard that, I called my dad right away, and he was very happy to hear it too. This visit not only let me help others but also let me make a new friend.

questions.why: 社團安排我們去……服務: the club arranges for its members to go and help. 照顧, 處理 and 檢查 take something to look after, deal with or check, so they can't be followed by 我們去 + a place.
Place + 貼著 + 海報: a poster is stuck (貼) at the entrance. 坐 and 站 are for people, and 穿 is for clothes.
跟我爸爸在同一家公司上班: worked at the same company as my dad. 各一家, 每一家 and 哪一家 can't name the one company two people share.
我聽了，立刻打電話: hearing the news, I called Dad right away. 互相 needs two sides doing it to each other, 本來 needs a later change, and 從小 can't describe one reaction to news.
不但……，而且……: not only helped others but also made a friend. 而且 adds a second good thing, so it pairs with 不但, not with 雖然, 因為 or 只要.

text.traditional: 這學期我修了一門美術課，每個星期三下午上課，教我們的是一位美術系的老師。第一次上課，老師在桌上放了一個蘋果，要我們畫畫看。我覺得太簡單了，十分鐘就畫完了。老師看了以後說：「你只看了一下就開始畫，所以畫得一點都不像。」她要我們先看蘋果看二十分鐘，再開始畫。我這才發現，一個蘋果上有紅色、黃色，還有一點綠色。以前我只重視畫得快不快，從這次上課中，我學到了做事別太急，先看清楚了再做，常常會做得更好。
text.simplified: 这学期我修了一门美术课，每个星期三下午上课，教我们的是一位美术系的老师。第一次上课，老师在桌上放了一个苹果，要我们画画看。我觉得太简单了，十分钟就画完了。老师看了以后说：「你只看了一下就开始画，所以画得一点都不像。」她要我们先看苹果看二十分钟，再开始画。我这才发现，一个苹果上有红色、黄色，还有一点绿色。以前我只重视画得快不快，从这次上课中，我学到了做事别太急，先看清楚了再做，常常会做得更好。
text.pinyin: Zhè xuéqí wǒ xiū le yì mén měishù kè, měi ge xīngqísān xiàwǔ shàngkè, jiāo wǒmen de shì yí wèi měishù xì de lǎoshī. Dì yī cì shàngkè, lǎoshī zài zhuō shàng fàng le yí ge píngguǒ, yào wǒmen huà huà kàn. Wǒ juéde tài jiǎndān le, shí fēnzhōng jiù huà wán le. Lǎoshī kàn le yǐhòu shuō: “Nǐ zhǐ kàn le yíxià jiù kāishǐ huà, suǒyǐ huà de yìdiǎn dōu bú xiàng.” Tā yào wǒmen xiān kàn píngguǒ kàn èrshí fēnzhōng, zài kāishǐ huà. Wǒ zhè cái fāxiàn, yí ge píngguǒ shàng yǒu hóngsè, huángsè, hái yǒu yìdiǎn lǜsè. Yǐqián wǒ zhǐ zhòngshì huà de kuài bú kuài, cóng zhè cì shàngkè zhōng, wǒ xué dào le zuòshì bié tài jí, xiān kàn qīngchǔ le zài zuò, chángcháng huì zuò de gèng hǎo.
text.english: This semester I'm taking an art course. It meets every Wednesday afternoon and is taught by a teacher from the fine arts department. In the first class, the teacher put an apple on the table and had us try drawing it. I thought it was too easy and finished in ten minutes. The teacher looked at it and said, "You only glanced at it before you started drawing, so it doesn't look like it at all." She had us look at the apple for twenty minutes before starting. Only then did I notice that one apple has red, yellow and even a little green on it. I used to care only about drawing fast; from this class I learned not to rush: look carefully first, then act, and you often do better.

prompt.traditional: 第一次上課，這個人一開始覺得畫蘋果怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 第一次上课，这个人一开始觉得画苹果怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī cì shàngkè, zhège rén yìkāishǐ juéde huà píngguǒ zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: In the first class, what did the writer think of drawing the apple at first?

questions.why: 我覺得太簡單了，十分鐘就畫完了: at first the writer thought it was easy. It took only ten minutes, and the passage says nothing about finding it hard or interesting.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人從這次上課中學到了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人从这次上课中学到了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén cóng zhè cì shàngkè zhōng xué dào le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the writer learn from this class?

choices.pinyin: Duō liànxí jiù néng huà de hǎo.
choices.english: Practise more and you will draw well.

choices.pinyin: Huàhuà yào xiān xuǎn hǎo yánsè.
choices.english: Choose your colours before you draw.

choices.pinyin: Zuò de kuài bù yídìng zuò de hǎo.
choices.english: Doing something fast doesn't mean doing it well.

choices.pinyin: Hǎo lǎoshī néng ràng rén jìnbù.
choices.english: A good teacher helps you improve.

questions.why: 以前我只重視畫得快不快，從這次上課中，我學到了做事別太急: the writer used to care only about speed and learned that rushing doesn't give good work. The passage never says practice, choosing colours first or the teacher is the lesson.

text.traditional: 上個學期，我參加了學校的愛心服務社。社團每個月安排兩次活動，我最喜歡的是去育幼院。第一次去的時候，我想教孩子唱歌，可是他們都玩自己的，不聽我的話，我急得快哭了。一位老師告訴我：「妳先陪他們玩，等他們跟妳熟了，就會聽妳的話了。」後來，我每次去都先陪孩子玩半個小時，再教他們刷牙、穿衣服。現在那些孩子一看到我，就跑過來叫我「姐姐」。從這些經驗中，我知道了想讓別人聽你的話，得先讓他們喜歡你。這是課本上學不到的，對我來說非常寶貴。
text.simplified: 上个学期，我参加了学校的爱心服务社。社团每个月安排两次活动，我最喜欢的是去育幼院。第一次去的时候，我想教孩子唱歌，可是他们都玩自己的，不听我的话，我急得快哭了。一位老师告诉我：「你先陪他们玩，等他们跟你熟了，就会听你的话了。」后来，我每次去都先陪孩子玩半个小时，再教他们刷牙、穿衣服。现在那些孩子一看到我，就跑过来叫我「姐姐」。从这些经验中，我知道了想让别人听你的话，得先让他们喜欢你。这是课本上学不到的，对我来说非常宝贵。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xuéqí, wǒ cānjiā le xuéxiào de àixīn fúwù shè. Shètuán měi ge yuè ānpái liǎng cì huódòng, wǒ zuì xǐhuān de shì qù yùyòuyuàn. Dì yī cì qù de shíhòu, wǒ xiǎng jiāo háizi chànggē, kěshì tāmen dōu wán zìjǐ de, bù tīng wǒ de huà, wǒ jí de kuài kū le. Yí wèi lǎoshī gàosu wǒ: “Nǐ xiān péi tāmen wán, děng tāmen gēn nǐ shóu le, jiù huì tīng nǐ de huà le.” Hòulái, wǒ měi cì qù dōu xiān péi háizi wán bàn ge xiǎoshí, zài jiāo tāmen shuāyá, chuān yīfu. Xiànzài nàxiē háizi yí kàn dào wǒ, jiù pǎo guòlái jiào wǒ “jiějie”. Cóng zhèxiē jīngyàn zhōng, wǒ zhīdào le xiǎng ràng biérén tīng nǐ de huà, děi xiān ràng tāmen xǐhuān nǐ. Zhè shì kèběn shàng xué bú dào de, duì wǒ lái shuō fēicháng bǎoguì.
text.english: Last semester I joined the school's volunteer service club. The club arranges two outings a month, and my favourite is the orphanage. The first time I went, I wanted to teach the children a song, but they all played on their own and wouldn't listen to me; I was so upset I nearly cried. A teacher told me, "Play with them first. Once they know you, they'll listen to you." After that, every time I went I first played with the children for half an hour, then taught them to brush their teeth and get dressed. Now as soon as those children see me, they run over and call me "big sister". From these experiences I learned that if you want people to listen to you, you first have to make them like you. You can't learn that from a textbook, and to me it is very precious.

prompt.traditional: 第一次去育幼院的時候，她本來想做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 第一次去育幼院的时候，她本来想做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī cì qù yùyòuyuàn de shíhòu, tā běnlái xiǎng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: The first time she went to the orphanage, what did she plan to do?

choices.english: Teach the children to brush their teeth.
Teach the children to get dressed.

questions.why: 第一次去的時候，我想教孩子唱歌: her first plan was a song. Playing first was the teacher's advice for later visits, and tooth-brushing and dressing came after that.

prompt.traditional: 她從這些經驗中知道了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 她从这些经验中知道了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tā cóng zhèxiē jīngyàn zhōng zhīdào le shénme?
prompt.english: What did she learn from these experiences?

choices.pinyin: Jiāo háizi yào yuè zǎo yuè hǎo.
choices.english: The earlier you teach children, the better.

choices.pinyin: Kèběn néng jiāo wǒmen hěn duō.
Yào xiān ràng háizi xǐhuān zìjǐ.
choices.english: First get the children to like you.

questions.why: 從這些經驗中，我知道了……得先讓他們喜歡你: to be listened to, first make them like you. She says this is something textbooks can't teach, and the passage says nothing about singing making children happy or starting early.

text.traditional: 我家附近的便利商店最近在辦活動：買滿五十塊就送一張貼紙，貼紙滿十張，就可以換一個卡通娃娃。我妹妹很喜愛那個娃娃，為了得到它，她每天早上都去買豆漿和麵包，有時候連不需要的東西也買。一個星期以後，她已經有八張了，可是店員說，娃娃已經換光了，她難過得哭了。我只好上網買了一個一樣的娃娃送給她。我覺得商人很了解顧客的心理，像這樣的活動，連我這種不喜歡卡通的人都覺得很有吸引力。
text.simplified: 我家附近的便利商店最近在办活动：买满五十块就送一张贴纸，贴纸满十张，就可以换一个卡通娃娃。我妹妹很喜爱那个娃娃，为了得到它，她每天早上都去买豆浆和面包，有时候连不需要的东西也买。一个星期以后，她已经有八张了，可是店员说，娃娃已经换光了，她难过得哭了。我只好上网买了一个一样的娃娃送给她。我觉得商人很了解顾客的心理，像这样的活动，连我这种不喜欢卡通的人都觉得很有吸引力。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn de biànlì shāngdiàn zuìjìn zài bàn huódòng: mǎi mǎn wǔshí kuài jiù sòng yì zhāng tiēzhǐ, tiēzhǐ mǎn shí zhāng, jiù kěyǐ huàn yí ge kǎtōng wáwa. Wǒ mèimei hěn xǐ'ài nàge wáwa, wèile dédào tā, tā měi tiān zǎoshàng dōu qù mǎi dòujiāng hé miànbāo, yǒu shíhòu lián bù xūyào de dōngxi yě mǎi. Yí ge xīngqí yǐhòu, tā yǐjīng yǒu bā zhāng le, kěshì diànyuán shuō, wáwa yǐjīng huàn guāng le, tā nánguò de kū le. Wǒ zhǐhǎo shàngwǎng mǎi le yí ge yíyàng de wáwa sòng gěi tā. Wǒ juéde shāngrén hěn liǎojiě gùkè de xīnlǐ, xiàng zhèyàng de huódòng, lián wǒ zhè zhǒng bù xǐhuān kǎtōng de rén dōu juéde hěn yǒu xīyǐnlì.
text.english: The convenience store near my home is running a promotion: spend fifty dollars and you get a sticker, and once you have a full ten stickers you can get a cartoon doll. My younger sister loves that doll. To get it she went every morning to buy soy milk and bread, and sometimes even bought things she didn't need. A week later she already had eight, but the clerk said the dolls were all gone, and she was so sad she cried. I had no choice but to buy the same doll online and give it to her. I think business people understand customers' psychology very well: a promotion like this is attractive even to someone like me who doesn't like cartoons.

prompt.traditional: 一個星期以後，妹妹還差幾張貼紙？
prompt.simplified: 一个星期以后，妹妹还差几张贴纸？
prompt.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqí yǐhòu, mèimei hái chà jǐ zhāng tiēzhǐ?
prompt.english: After a week, how many more stickers did the sister need?

questions.why: 貼紙滿十張 gets a doll and she already had eight (已經有八張了), so she was two short. Eight is what she had and ten what she needed.

prompt.traditional: 妹妹為什麼哭了？
prompt.simplified: 妹妹为什么哭了？
prompt.pinyin: Mèimei wèishénme kū le?
prompt.english: Why did the younger sister cry?

choices.english: The clerk wouldn't give her stickers.

choices.pinyin: Tā mǎi le bù xūyào de dōngxi.
choices.english: She had bought things she didn't need.

questions.why: 店員說，娃娃已經換光了: all the dolls had been taken, so she cried. She got her stickers and loved the doll, and buying things she didn't need is not why she cried.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人覺得這種活動怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人觉得这种活动怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén juéde zhè zhǒng huódòng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the writer think of this kind of promotion?

choices.pinyin: Sòng de tiēzhǐ bú gòu duō.

questions.why: 連我這種不喜歡卡通的人都覺得很有吸引力: even the writer, who doesn't like cartoons, is drawn in. People buy things they don't need, so nobody saves money, and the writer never complains about the time or the number of stickers.

text.traditional: 上個星期五晚上，期末考考完了，我跟室友去KTV唱歌。我們選了學校附近的一家，因為那家是吃到飽的，除了唱歌，還可以吃各式各樣的小吃。我一直覺得自己唱歌不好聽，所以一開始只吃東西，不敢唱歌。後來室友點了一首我最拿手的歌，我就越來越興奮了。最後機器給我打了九十八分，室友都說我唱歌像歌星一樣好聽。我們一直唱歌，到半夜一點才回宿舍。可是第二天早上起來，因為前一天一直唱歌，我連一句話都說不出來了。
text.simplified: 上个星期五晚上，期末考考完了，我跟室友去KTV唱歌。我们选了学校附近的一家，因为那家是吃到饱的，除了唱歌，还可以吃各式各样的小吃。我一直觉得自己唱歌不好听，所以一开始只吃东西，不敢唱歌。后来室友点了一首我最拿手的歌，我就越来越兴奋了。最后机器给我打了九十八分，室友都说我唱歌像歌星一样好听。我们一直唱歌，到半夜一点才回宿舍。可是第二天早上起来，因为前一天一直唱歌，我连一句话都说不出来了。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng, qímòkǎo kǎo wán le, wǒ gēn shìyǒu qù KTV chànggē. Wǒmen xuǎn le xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā, yīnwèi nà jiā shì chīdàobǎo de, chúle chànggē, hái kěyǐ chī gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī. Wǒ yìzhí juéde zìjǐ chànggē bù hǎotīng, suǒyǐ yìkāishǐ zhǐ chī dōngxi, bù gǎn chànggē. Hòulái shìyǒu diǎn le yì shǒu wǒ zuì náshǒu de gē, wǒ jiù yuèláiyuè xīngfèn le. Zuìhòu jīqì gěi wǒ dǎ le jiǔshíbā fēn, shìyǒu dōu shuō wǒ chànggē xiàng gēxīng yíyàng hǎotīng. Wǒmen yìzhí chànggē, dào bànyè yì diǎn cái huí sùshè. Kěshì dì èr tiān zǎoshàng qǐlái, yīnwèi qián yì tiān yìzhí chànggē, wǒ lián yí jù huà dōu shuō bù chūlái le.
text.english: Last Friday evening, with finals over, my roommate and I went to sing at a KTV. We chose one near school, because it's all-you-can-eat: besides singing you can eat all kinds of snacks. I've always thought I sing badly, so at first I only ate and didn't dare to sing. Then my roommate picked the song I sing best, and I got more and more excited. In the end the machine gave me 98 points, and my roommates said I sounded as good as a pop star. We kept singing until one in the morning before going back to the dorm. But when I got up the next morning, after singing nonstop the night before, I couldn't say a single word.

prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼選了那家KTV？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么选了那家KTV？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme xuǎn le nà jiā KTV?
prompt.english: Why did they choose that KTV?

choices.pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō dōngxi kěyǐ chī.

questions.why: 因為那家是吃到飽的，除了唱歌，還可以吃各式各樣的小吃: they chose it because it is all-you-can-eat, with all kinds of snacks. Price is never mentioned, and the high score and the pop star are about the writer's singing later.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人一開始為什麼不唱歌？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人一开始为什么不唱歌？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén yìkāishǐ wèishénme bú chànggē?
prompt.english: Why didn't the writer sing at first?

choices.pinyin: Tā juéde jīqì fēnshù tài dī.
choices.english: Thought the machine scores too low.

choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi méiyǒu tā huì de gē.
choices.english: Thought there was no song they knew.

choices.pinyin: Tā juéde xiǎochī bǐ chànggē hǎo.
choices.english: Liked the snacks better than singing.

choices.traditional: 他以為自己不太會唱歌
choices.simplified: 他以为自己不太会唱歌
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi zìjǐ bú tài huì chànggē.
choices.english: Wrongly thought they were a poor singer.

questions.why: 我一直覺得自己唱歌不好聽，所以……不敢唱歌: the writer thought they sang badly, which the 98 points later proved wrong (以為). They did have a best song, the score came only later, and eating was what they did instead, not the reason.

prompt.traditional: 第二天早上，寫這篇文章的人怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 第二天早上，写这篇文章的人怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén zěnme le?
prompt.english: What was wrong with the writer the next morning?

choices.english: Couldn't get up in the morning.
Had a bit of a headache.

questions.why: 因為前一天一直唱歌，我連一句話都說不出來了: after singing nonstop the night before, the writer couldn't say a word. The writer did get up (第二天早上起來), and nothing is said about a stomach ache or a headache.

picture.alt: A sunny day outside a school building, under green trees. On a wooden bench sits a young woman with short wavy dark hair, round glasses and freckles, in a white shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and green trousers, a light backpack on one shoulder. She holds a closed yellow notebook against her chest and, smiling, turns to talk to her friend, one hand held out open. Her friend stands next to the bench: long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings, a short blue jacket over an orange top, a long white skirt and a black bag on her shoulder; she holds up her left wrist with a brown wristwatch and looks at the woman on the bench. In the background, two students with backpacks walk through the glass doors into the building.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 戴眼鏡的女生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 戴眼镜的女生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Dài yǎnjìng de nǚshēng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the young woman with glasses doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zhàn zhe kàn shǒu shàng de biǎo.
choices.english: She is standing and looking at the watch on her wrist.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò zhe gēn péngyǒu liáotiān.
choices.english: She is sitting and chatting with her friend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zǒu jìn hòumiàn de dàlóu.
choices.english: She is walking into the building behind.

questions.why: The woman with glasses sits on the bench, turned to her friend and talking. Her friend in the blue jacket is the one standing with the watch, and the two students in the back are the ones walking into the building.

picture.alt: A flower garden in the countryside on a sunny day: green hills and tall dark trees in the back, a stone house with a tiled roof and a wooden fence on the right, and beds of pink, orange, yellow, white and purple flowers all around. A young woman with long wavy dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves over an orange top and cream trousers, kneels on dark soil. Wearing gardening gloves, she presses a small plant with pink flowers into a hole in the soil, smiling. A small trowel lies on the soil beside her and a teal watering can stands on the right. passage.traditional: 我爸爸開了一家餐廳，管理二十多個員工，每天都忙到夜裡十一點才回家。他說，現在的體力{1}年輕的時候那麼好了，很多事情一個人已經做{2}了。上個月他告訴我們，明年他就要{3}了。他打算搬到鄉下去，每天早上種種花，下午跟朋友喝{4}茶、聊聊天。爸爸工作了三十年，一直都這麼累，{5}他想過輕鬆一點的生活。
passage.simplified: 我爸爸开了一家餐厅，管理二十多个员工，每天都忙到夜里十一点才回家。他说，现在的体力{1}年轻的时候那么好了，很多事情一个人已经做{2}了。上个月他告诉我们，明年他就要{3}了。他打算搬到乡下去，每天早上种种花，下午跟朋友喝{4}茶、聊聊天。爸爸工作了三十年，一直都这么累，{5}他想过轻松一点的生活。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ bàba kāi le yì jiā cāntīng, guǎnlǐ èrshí duō ge yuángōng, měi tiān dōu máng dào yèlǐ shíyī diǎn cái huí jiā. Tā shuō, xiànzài de tǐlì bú xiàng niánqīng de shíhòu nàme hǎo le, hěn duō shìqíng yí ge rén yǐjīng zuò bù liǎo le. Shàng ge yuè tā gàosu wǒmen, míngnián tā jiù yào tuìxiū le. Tā dǎsuàn bān dào xiāngxià qù, měi tiān zǎoshàng zhòngzhòng huā, xiàwǔ gēn péngyǒu hē ge chá, liáoliáo tiān. Bàba gōngzuò le sānshí nián, yìzhí dōu zhème lèi, nánguài tā xiǎng guò qīngsōng yìdiǎn de shēnghuó.
passage.english: My father opened a restaurant. He manages over twenty employees and is busy every day until eleven at night before he gets home. He says his stamina isn't as good as when he was young, and there's a lot he can no longer manage alone. Last month he told us he's retiring next year. He plans to move to the countryside, plant a few flowers every morning, and in the afternoon have some tea and chat with friends. Dad has worked for thirty years and has always been this tired; no wonder he wants a more relaxed life.

questions.why: 現在的體力不像年輕的時候那麼好: 不像 … 那麼 + Vs compares now with when he was young. 不但, 不久 and 不必 can't start a comparison with 那麼.
做不了: there is a lot he can no longer manage alone. 做不起, 做不懂 and 做不上 don't say that.
Tired, unable to manage the work, and moving to the countryside next year: he is retiring. He already works long hours, so 上班 and 加班 make no news, and 畢業 is for students.
喝個茶: V個N makes it a light, easy activity, like 種種花 and 聊聊天 around it. 喝飽茶 is not said, 喝過茶 doesn't fit a daily plan, and 喝起茶 needs 來.
Thirty tiring years explain his wish for an easy life: 難怪 (no wonder). 只要 needs a 就 clause, 雖然 needs 可是, and 為了 needs a main clause after it.

passage.traditional: 我是大學三年級的學生，為了存一點學費，從上個月{1}，我就在學校附近的一家咖啡店打工。在咖啡店工作不像我想的{2}輕鬆，客人多的時候，我一個人照顧{3}那麼多客人，還好老闆常常來幫忙。下班以後，我喜歡跟同事去夜市吃{4}東西、聊聊天。我覺得在咖啡店打工{5}能存學費，還能練習英文會話，因為常常有外國客人。
passage.simplified: 我是大学三年级的学生，为了存一点学费，从上个月{1}，我就在学校附近的一家咖啡店打工。在咖啡店工作不像我想的{2}轻松，客人多的时候，我一个人照顾{3}那么多客人，还好老板常常来帮忙。下班以后，我喜欢跟同事去夜市吃{4}东西、聊聊天。我觉得在咖啡店打工{5}能存学费，还能练习英文会话，因为常常有外国客人。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ shì dàxué sān niánjí de xuéshēng, wèile cún yìdiǎn xuéfèi, cóng shàng ge yuè qǐ, wǒ jiù zài xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā kāfēi diàn dǎgōng. Zài kāfēi diàn gōngzuò bú xiàng wǒ xiǎng de nàme qīngsōng, kèrén duō de shíhòu, wǒ yí ge rén zhàogù bù liǎo nàme duō kèrén, háihǎo lǎobǎn chángcháng lái bāngmáng. Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ xǐhuān gēn tóngshì qù yèshì chī ge dōngxi, liáoliáo tiān. Wǒ juéde zài kāfēi diàn dǎgōng búdàn néng cún xuéfèi, hái néng liànxí Yīngwén huìhuà, yīnwèi chángcháng yǒu wàiguó kèrén.
passage.english: I'm a third-year university student. To save a little for tuition, I've worked part-time since last month at a café near school. Working in a café isn't as easy as I thought: when it's busy I can't look after so many customers alone, but luckily the owner often comes to help. After work I like to go to the night market with coworkers for a bite and a chat. I think working at the café not only lets me save for tuition but also lets me practise English conversation, because there are often foreign customers.

questions.why: 從上個月起: starting from last month (從 + time + 起, then 就). 從上個月到 would need an end point, and 完 or 去 don't follow a time.
不像我想的那麼輕鬆: not as easy as I thought. 不像 … 那麼 + Vs is the pattern; 非常, 有點 and 太 can't follow 不像 + N in a comparison.
照顧不了那麼多客人: alone, the writer can't manage so many customers, so the owner helps. 照顧不起, 照顧不飽 and 照顧不懂 don't say that.
吃個東西: V個N makes it a quick, easy bite, like 聊聊天 next to it. 吃飽東西 is not said, 吃過 doesn't fit what the writer likes to do, and 吃起 needs 來.
不但……，還……: the job not only saves tuition but also gives English practice. 雖然 needs 可是, 只要 needs 就, and 因為 would give a reason, not a second gain.

text.traditional: 我姐姐大學念的是哲學。畢業以前，她很擔心找不到工作，可是後來發現，找工作不像她想的那麼難，一個月就在一家保險公司當了職員。不過那個工作很無聊，每天都在辦公室裡做一樣的事，所以她做了半年就不做了。後來，她決定去念研究所，研究廣告設計。念研究所的時候，她白天上課，晚上在一家廣告公司打工，常常忙到夜裡兩、三點才睡覺。雖然很累，可是她說，這是她第一次覺得自己做的事很有意思。今年六月她畢業了，那家廣告公司馬上請她去當正式的職員。
text.simplified: 我姐姐大学念的是哲学。毕业以前，她很担心找不到工作，可是后来发现，找工作不像她想的那么难，一个月就在一家保险公司当了职员。不过那个工作很无聊，每天都在办公室里做一样的事，所以她做了半年就不做了。后来，她决定去念研究所，研究广告设计。念研究所的时候，她白天上课，晚上在一家广告公司打工，常常忙到夜里两、三点才睡觉。虽然很累，可是她说，这是她第一次觉得自己做的事很有意思。今年六月她毕业了，那家广告公司马上请她去当正式的职员。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie dàxué niàn de shì zhéxué. Bìyè yǐqián, tā hěn dānxīn zhǎo bú dào gōngzuò, kěshì hòulái fāxiàn, zhǎo gōngzuò bú xiàng tā xiǎng de nàme nán, yí ge yuè jiù zài yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī dāng le zhíyuán. Búguò nàge gōngzuò hěn wúliáo, měi tiān dōu zài bàngōngshì lǐ zuò yíyàng de shì, suǒyǐ tā zuò le bàn nián jiù bú zuò le. Hòulái, tā juédìng qù niàn yánjiùsuǒ, yánjiù guǎnggào shèjì. Niàn yánjiùsuǒ de shíhòu, tā báitiān shàngkè, wǎnshàng zài yì jiā guǎnggào gōngsī dǎgōng, chángcháng máng dào yèlǐ liǎng, sān diǎn cái shuìjiào. Suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì tā shuō, zhè shì tā dì yī cì juéde zìjǐ zuò de shì hěn yǒu yìsi. Jīnnián liù yuè tā bìyè le, nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī mǎshàng qǐng tā qù dāng zhèngshì de zhíyuán.
text.english: My older sister studied philosophy at university. Before graduating she worried she wouldn't find a job, but it turned out that finding one wasn't as hard as she had thought: within a month she was a clerk at an insurance company. That job was boring, though, the same thing in the office every day, so after half a year she quit. Later she decided to go to graduate school to study advertising design. In graduate school she had classes in the daytime and worked part-time at an advertising company in the evenings, often busy until two or three at night before going to bed. Tired as she was, she said it was the first time she felt that what she did was interesting. She graduated this June, and that advertising company hired her right away as a regular employee.

text.traditional:
張經理：
您好！我在學校的網站上看到公司要找一位英文助理，所以寫這封信，向您介紹我自己。我今年大學四年級，是外語學院英文系的學生，聽力、會話都不錯。大學三年級的時候，我當過教授的助理，幫他翻譯了很多研究資料；也在一家貿易公司工作過，知道怎麼接電話、管理資料。我知道這個工作常常要加班，可是我年輕、體力好，一點也不怕。六月畢業以後，我就能每天去上班。我相信自己能做好這個工作，如果您覺得我可以，請打電話通知我。謝謝您！
林小雨 敬上 5月10日
text.simplified:
张经理：
您好！我在学校的网站上看到公司要找一位英文助理，所以写这封信，向您介绍我自己。我今年大学四年级，是外语学院英文系的学生，听力、会话都不错。大学三年级的时候，我当过教授的助理，帮他翻译了很多研究资料；也在一家贸易公司工作过，知道怎么接电话、管理资料。我知道这个工作常常要加班，可是我年轻、体力好，一点也不怕。六月毕业以后，我就能每天去上班。我相信自己能做好这个工作，如果您觉得我可以，请打电话通知我。谢谢您！
林小雨 敬上 5月10日
text.pinyin:
Zhāng jīnglǐ:
Nín hǎo! Wǒ zài xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng kàndào gōngsī yào zhǎo yí wèi Yīngwén zhùlǐ, suǒyǐ xiě zhè fēng xìn, xiàng nín jièshào wǒ zìjǐ. Wǒ jīnnián dàxué sì niánjí, shì wàiyǔ xuéyuàn Yīngwén xì de xuéshēng, tīnglì, huìhuà dōu búcuò. Dàxué sān niánjí de shíhòu, wǒ dāng guo jiàoshòu de zhùlǐ, bāng tā fānyì le hěn duō yánjiù zīliào; yě zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī gōngzuò guo, zhīdào zěnme jiē diànhuà, guǎnlǐ zīliào. Wǒ zhīdào zhège gōngzuò chángcháng yào jiābān, kěshì wǒ niánqīng, tǐlì hǎo, yìdiǎn yě bú pà. Liù yuè bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ jiù néng měi tiān qù shàngbān. Wǒ xiāngxìn zìjǐ néng zuò hǎo zhège gōngzuò, rúguǒ nín juéde wǒ kěyǐ, qǐng dǎ diànhuà tōngzhī wǒ. Xièxie nín!
Lín Xiǎoyǔ jìngshàng Wǔ yuè shí rì
text.english:
Dear Manager Zhang,
I saw on the school website that your company is looking for an English assistant, so I am writing to introduce myself. I am a fourth-year student in the English department of the College of Foreign Languages, and my listening and conversation are both good. In my third year I was a professor's assistant and translated a lot of research material for him; I have also worked at a trading company, so I know how to answer the phone and manage files. I know this job often means overtime, but I am young and have plenty of energy, so it doesn't scare me at all. After I graduate in June, I can come to work every day. I believe I can do this job well. If you think I could, please call to let me know. Thank you!
Respectfully yours, Lin Xiaoyu, May 10

text.traditional: 上個星期六是我室友的生日，為了讓她開心，我們六個同學決定帶她去唱KTV。學校附近的那家KTV比較便宜，可是因為是假日，已經客滿了，我們只好去一家比較遠的。那家KTV不但有吃到飽的晚餐，還有很多韓國歌。我們晚上七點到，室友最拿手的是韓國歌，她一唱就唱了一個小時。我唱得不好，機器給我打的分數很低，大家都笑了。唱了兩個小時，大家都唱累了，我們才把蛋糕拿出來，一起唱生日快樂歌。那天晚上，我們一直唱到十二點才回家。
text.simplified: 上个星期六是我室友的生日，为了让她开心，我们六个同学决定带她去唱KTV。学校附近的那家KTV比较便宜，可是因为是假日，已经客满了，我们只好去一家比较远的。那家KTV不但有吃到饱的晚餐，还有很多韩国歌。我们晚上七点到，室友最拿手的是韩国歌，她一唱就唱了一个小时。我唱得不好，机器给我打的分数很低，大家都笑了。唱了两个小时，大家都唱累了，我们才把蛋糕拿出来，一起唱生日快乐歌。那天晚上，我们一直唱到十二点才回家。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù shì wǒ shìyǒu de shēngrì, wèile ràng tā kāixīn, wǒmen liù ge tóngxué juédìng dài tā qù chàng KTV. Xuéxiào fùjìn de nà jiā KTV bǐjiào piányí, kěshì yīnwèi shì jiàrì, yǐjīng kèmǎn le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo qù yì jiā bǐjiào yuǎn de. Nà jiā KTV búdàn yǒu chīdàobǎo de wǎncān, hái yǒu hěn duō Hánguó gē. Wǒmen wǎnshàng qī diǎn dào, shìyǒu zuì náshǒu de shì Hánguó gē, tā yí chàng jiù chàng le yí ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ chàng de bù hǎo, jīqì gěi wǒ dǎ de fēnshù hěn dī, dàjiā dōu xiào le. Chàng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, dàjiā dōu chàng lèi le, wǒmen cái bǎ dàngāo ná chūlái, yìqǐ chàng shēngrì kuàilè gē. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen yìzhí chàng dào shí'èr diǎn cái huí jiā.
text.english: Last Saturday was my roommate's birthday. To make her happy, six of us classmates decided to take her to KTV. The KTV near school is cheaper, but because it was a holiday it was already full, so we had to go to one farther away. That KTV had not only an all-you-can-eat dinner but also lots of Korean songs. We got there at seven. My roommate is best at Korean songs, and once she started she sang for an hour. I sing badly; the machine gave me a very low score, and everyone laughed. After two hours of singing we were all tired, and only then did we bring out the cake and sing 'Happy Birthday' together. That night we kept singing until twelve before going home.

text.traditional: 我以前很討厭運動，每天只喜歡吃漢堡、薯條，喝可樂，體重越來越重，到了八十公斤。去年秋天，我跟同學去爬山，才爬了二十分鐘就累得不想走了。同學笑我說：「你才二十歲，體力怎麼這麼差？」回來以後，我參加了學校的一個慢跑社團。社團的教練說：「想減體重的話，不但要多運動，而且飲食也得改。」從那天開始，我每天早上去操場跑半個小時，三餐多吃青菜，少吃油的東西，也不喝可樂，改喝開水了。半年以後，我的體重減了八公斤，精神也好多了。現在，慢跑已經變成我生活中最快樂的事。
text.simplified: 我以前很讨厌运动，每天只喜欢吃汉堡、薯条，喝可乐，体重越来越重，到了八十公斤。去年秋天，我跟同学去爬山，才爬了二十分钟就累得不想走了。同学笑我说：「你才二十岁，体力怎么这么差？」回来以后，我参加了学校的一个慢跑社团。社团的教练说：「想减体重的话，不但要多运动，而且饮食也得改。」从那天开始，我每天早上去操场跑半个小时，三餐多吃青菜，少吃油的东西，也不喝可乐，改喝开水了。半年以后，我的体重减了八公斤，精神也好多了。现在，慢跑已经变成我生活中最快乐的事。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián hěn tǎoyàn yùndòng, měi tiān zhǐ xǐhuān chī hànbǎo, shǔtiáo, hē kělè, tǐzhòng yuè lái yuè zhòng, dào le bāshí gōngjīn. Qùnián qiūtiān, wǒ gēn tóngxué qù pá shān, cái pá le èrshí fēnzhōng jiù lèi de bù xiǎng zǒu le. Tóngxué xiào wǒ shuō: “Nǐ cái èrshí suì, tǐlì zěnme zhème chà?” Huílái yǐhòu, wǒ cānjiā le xuéxiào de yí ge mànpǎo shètuán. Shètuán de jiàoliàn shuō: “Xiǎng jiǎn tǐzhòng dehuà, búdàn yào duō yùndòng, érqiě yǐnshí yě děi gǎi.” Cóng nà tiān kāishǐ, wǒ měi tiān zǎoshàng qù cāochǎng pǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí, sāncān duō chī qīngcài, shǎo chī yóu de dōngxi, yě bù hē kělè, gǎi hē kāishuǐ le. Bàn nián yǐhòu, wǒ de tǐzhòng jiǎn le bā gōngjīn, jīngshén yě hǎo duō le. Xiànzài, mànpǎo yǐjīng biànchéng wǒ shēnghuó zhōng zuì kuàilè de shì.
text.english: I used to hate exercise. Every day I only liked eating burgers and fries and drinking cola, and I kept getting heavier, up to eighty kilograms. Last autumn I went hiking with classmates, and after only twenty minutes of climbing I was too tired to walk on. My classmates laughed: 'You're only twenty. How can your stamina be so poor?' When I got back, I joined a jogging club at school. The club's coach said, 'If you want to lose weight, you need not only more exercise but also a change of diet.' From that day on I ran on the track for half an hour every morning, ate more vegetables and less oily food at every meal, and stopped drinking cola, drinking water instead. Half a year later I had lost eight kilograms and had much more energy. Now jogging has become the happiest part of my life.

choices.pinyin: Yào duō yùndòng, yě yào gǎi yǐnshí.

prompt.pinyin: Diànyuán zài zuò shénme?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng ná zhe yì tái bǐdiàn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài gēn nánshēng jièshào píngbǎn.
choices.english: He is telling the young man about a tablet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ píngbǎn fàng jìn bēibāo lǐ.
choices.english: He is putting a tablet into a backpack.

questions.why: The clerk talks to the young man with his open hand held out toward the tablet on the counter: he is presenting it. The laptop is in the young man's hands, and nobody is touching the backpack.

picture.alt: The counter of the same electronics store. On the left, behind a white counter with a computer screen, a small clear card stand and a black tray, the smiling clerk in the teal shirt holds out a black smartphone, his mouth open as if calling out. On the right, by the glass door (sunny trees and buildings outside), the young man in the green jacket, red striped T-shirt and black backpack has turned back with a surprised face and reaches one hand out toward the phone; his other hand carries a white shopping bag with a dark box in it. Nobody is on the phone.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 店員在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 店员在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Diànyuán zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the store clerk doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài yòng shǒujī dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: He is making a phone call.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ shǒujī fàng zài zhuō shàng.
choices.english: He is putting the phone on the counter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào bǎ shǒujī huán gěi nánshēng.
choices.english: He is giving the phone back to the young man.

questions.why: The clerk holds the phone out to the young man, who turns and reaches for it: he is giving it back. He is not talking on it, and he holds it out rather than putting it down.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 新手機今天開始賣，店門口已經有好多人排隊了，恐怕得等兩個小時。
lines.simplified: 新手机今天开始卖，店门口已经有好多人排队了，恐怕得等两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Xīn shǒujī jīntiān kāishǐ mài, diàn ménkǒu yǐjīng yǒu hǎo duō rén páiduì le, kǒngpà děi děng liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: The new phone goes on sale today. Lots of people are already queuing at the shop door; I'm afraid we'll have to wait two hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 排隊太麻煩了。網路上也買得到，而且比較便宜，不如回家上網訂。
lines.simplified: 排队太麻烦了。网路上也买得到，而且比较便宜，不如回家上网订。
lines.pinyin: Páiduì tài máfán le. Wǎnglù shàng yě mǎi de dào, érqiě bǐjiào piányí, bùrú huí jiā shàngwǎng dìng.
lines.english: Queuing is too much trouble. You can get it online too, and it's cheaper. Better to go home and order it online.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是我今天就想用新手機……
lines.simplified: 可是我今天就想用新手机……
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ jīntiān jiù xiǎng yòng xīn shǒujī……
lines.english: But I wanted to use the new phone today…

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 網路上訂的，後天就送到了，只差兩天嘛！
lines.simplified: 网路上订的，后天就送到了，只差两天嘛！
lines.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng dìng de, hòutiān jiù sòng dào le, zhǐ chà liǎng tiān ma!
lines.english: If you order online, it arrives the day after tomorrow. That's only two days!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你說得有道理。那我們先去吃飯，回家再訂。
lines.simplified: 你说得有道理。那我们先去吃饭，回家再订。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de yǒudàolǐ. Nà wǒmen xiān qù chīfàn, huí jiā zài dìng.
lines.english: You have a point. Then let's eat first and order it when we get home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: In the end, what does the woman plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān shàngwǎng dìng, zài qù chīfàn.

questions.why: Her first idea was to queue for two hours; he says 不如回家上網訂 (better to order online at home) and she agrees: 先去吃飯，回家再訂. So no queue, and the order comes after dinner, not before.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 今天下課以後，我們一起去光華商場看筆電，好不好？
lines.simplified: 今天下课以后，我们一起去光华商场看笔电，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒmen yìqǐ qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng kàn bǐdiàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Shall we go to Guanghua Digital Plaza after class today and look at laptops?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我今天五點才下課，那家店六點就關門了，恐怕來不及。不如改天再去吧。
lines.simplified: 我今天五点才下课，那家店六点就关门了，恐怕来不及。不如改天再去吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǔ diǎn cái xiàkè, nà jiā diàn liù diǎn jiù guānmén le, kǒngpà láibùjí. Bùrú gǎitiān zài qù ba.
lines.english: I don't finish class until five today, and that shop closes at six. I'm afraid we won't make it. Better to go another day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那星期六上午呢？
lines.simplified: 那星期六上午呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà xīngqíliù shàngwǔ ne?
lines.english: Then how about Saturday morning?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 週末我要回家看爸爸媽媽。星期五下午我沒課，那天去比較好。
lines.simplified: 周末我要回家看爸爸妈妈。星期五下午我没课，那天去比较好。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ yào huí jiā kàn bàba māma. Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ wǒ méi kè, nà tiān qù bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.english: At the weekend I'm going home to see my parents. I have no class on Friday afternoon; that day is better.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，就這麼決定了。
lines.simplified: 好，就这么决定了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, jiù zhème juédìng le.
lines.english: OK, it's settled then.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們什麼時候要去光華商場？
prompt.simplified: 他们什么时候要去光华商场？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen shénme shíhòu yào qù Guānghuá Shāngchǎng?
prompt.english: When are they going to Guanghua Digital Plaza?

questions.why: He first suggests today, but she finishes at five and the shop closes at six, so she says 不如改天再去. Saturday morning is out because she goes home at the weekend; she is free on Friday afternoon and he agrees.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼了？好像不太高興。
lines.simplified: 你怎么了？好像不太高兴。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Hǎoxiàng bú tài gāoxìng.
lines.english: What's wrong? You don't look very happy.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 剛才我在咖啡廳寫報告，去洗手間的時候把筆電放在桌上，差一點就被人偷了。
lines.simplified: 刚才我在咖啡厅写报告，去洗手间的时候把笔电放在桌上，差一点就被人偷了。
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zài kāfēitīng xiě bàogào, qù xǐshǒujiān de shíhòu bǎ bǐdiàn fàng zài zhuō shàng, chàyìdiǎn jiù bèi rén tōu le.
lines.english: Just now I was writing a report in a café. When I went to the restroom I left my laptop on the table, and it was almost stolen.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那後來呢？
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà hòulái ne?
lines.english: Really? So what happened?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還好隔壁桌的小姐看到了，馬上跟那個人說那是我的東西。
lines.simplified: 还好隔壁桌的小姐看到了，马上跟那个人说那是我的东西。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo gébì zhuō de xiǎojiě kàn dào le, mǎshàng gēn nàge rén shuō nà shì wǒ de dōngxi.
lines.english: Luckily the woman at the next table saw it and told the person right away that it was mine.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 以後去洗手間，還是把筆電帶著吧。
lines.simplified: 以后去洗手间，还是把笔电带着吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǐhòu qù xǐshǒujiān, háishì bǎ bǐdiàn dài zhe ba.
lines.english: From now on, take your laptop with you to the restroom.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 在咖啡廳發生了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 在咖啡厅发生了什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Zài kāfēitīng fāshēng le shénme shì?
prompt.english: What happened in the café?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de bǐdiàn bèi rén tōu le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén xiǎng tōu tā de bǐdiàn.
choices.english: Someone tried to steal his laptop.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎojiě de bǐdiàn bèi rén tōu le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎojiě xiǎng ná tā de bǐdiàn.
choices.english: The woman wanted to take his laptop.

questions.why: 差一點就被人偷了 means it almost happened: someone went for his laptop to steal it, but the woman at the next table spoke up, so nothing was stolen. She was the one who helped, not the one taking it, and her own laptop is never mentioned.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看，這是我昨天買的平板，很輕吧？
lines.simplified: 你看，这是我昨天买的平板，很轻吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè shì wǒ zuótiān mǎi de píngbǎn, hěn qīng ba?
lines.english: Look, this is the tablet I bought yesterday. Light, isn't it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這是最新的產品，應該不便宜吧？兩萬塊？
lines.simplified: 这是最新的产品，应该不便宜吧？两万块？
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì zuì xīn de chǎnpǐn, yīnggāi bù piányí ba? Liǎngwàn kuài?
lines.english: That's the newest model; it can't have been cheap. Twenty thousand?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 本來要兩萬兩千，上個星期我差一點就買了。還好店員說這個星期打折，可以便宜四千，我就多等了幾天。
lines.simplified: 本来要两万两千，上个星期我差一点就买了。还好店员说这个星期打折，可以便宜四千，我就多等了几天。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái yào liǎngwàn liǎngqiān, shàng ge xīngqí wǒ chàyìdiǎn jiù mǎi le. Háihǎo diànyuán shuō zhège xīngqí dǎzhé, kěyǐ piányí sìqiān, wǒ jiù duō děng le jǐ tiān.
lines.english: It was 22,000, and last week I almost bought it. Luckily the clerk said it would be on sale this week, 4,000 off, so I waited a few more days.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳真會省錢！
lines.simplified: 你真会省钱！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn huì shěngqián!
lines.english: You really know how to save money!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的買這台平板花了多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 女的买这台平板花了多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de mǎi zhè tái píngbǎn huā le duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: How much did the woman pay for this tablet?

questions.why: 上個星期我差一點就買了: she almost bought it at 22,000 but did not; she waited for this week's discount of 4,000 and paid 18,000. 20,000 was only his guess, and 4,000 is the discount.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳瘦了不少，是不是天天去健身房？
lines.simplified: 你瘦了不少，是不是天天去健身房？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shòu le bù shǎo, shì bú shì tiāntiān qù jiànshēnfáng?
lines.english: You've lost quite a bit of weight. Do you go to the gym every day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 健身房太貴了，我去不起。我現在每天早上到操場慢跑半個小時，飯還是吃得跟以前一樣多。
lines.simplified: 健身房太贵了，我去不起。我现在每天早上到操场慢跑半个小时，饭还是吃得跟以前一样多。
lines.pinyin: Jiànshēnfáng tài guì le, wǒ qù bù qǐ. Wǒ xiànzài měi tiān zǎoshàng dào cāochǎng mànpǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí, fàn háishì chī de gēn yǐqián yíyàng duō.
lines.english: The gym is too expensive; I can't afford it. Now I jog on the sports field for half an hour every morning, and I still eat as much as before.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳每天都得很早起來吧？
lines.simplified: 那你每天都得很早起来吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ měi tiān dōu děi hěn zǎo qǐlái ba?
lines.english: Then you must get up early every day?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，六點就起來了。你明天要不要跟我一起去跑？
lines.simplified: 对啊，六点就起来了。你明天要不要跟我一起去跑？
lines.pinyin: Duì a, liù diǎn jiù qǐlái le. Nǐ míngtiān yào bú yào gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù pǎo?
lines.english: Yes, I'm up at six. Do you want to come running with me tomorrow?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼瘦了？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么瘦了？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme shòu le?
prompt.english: Why has the woman lost weight?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She works out at the gym every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng qù pǎobù.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān shǎo chī yìdiǎn fàn.
choices.english: She eats a little less every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她每天跟男的一起運動
choices.simplified: 她每天跟男的一起运动
choices.pinyin: Tā měi tiān gēn nán de yìqǐ yùndòng.
choices.english: She exercises with the man every day.

questions.why: She jogs on the sports field every morning (慢跑). The gym is too expensive for her (去不起), she eats as much as before, and running with him is only an invitation for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼買了這麼多瓶豆漿？你不是不喜歡喝嗎？
lines.simplified: 你怎么买了这么多瓶豆浆？你不是不喜欢喝吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme mǎi le zhème duō píng dòujiāng? Nǐ bú shì bù xǐhuān hē ma?
lines.english: Why did you buy so many bottles of soy milk? Don't you dislike it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為了換史努比娃娃啊！每次買滿八十塊就送一張貼紙，貼滿四十張就能換一個。
lines.simplified: 为了换史努比娃娃啊！每次买满八十块就送一张贴纸，贴满四十张就能换一个。
lines.pinyin: Wèile huàn Shǐnǔbǐ wáwa a! Měi cì mǎi mǎn bāshí kuài jiù sòng yì zhāng tiēzhǐ, tiē mǎn sìshí zhāng jiù néng huàn yí ge.
lines.english: To get a Snoopy doll! Every 80 dollars you spend gets a sticker, and when you have stuck on forty, you can trade them for one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是這麼多豆漿，你一個人喝得完嗎？
lines.simplified: 可是这么多豆浆，你一个人喝得完吗？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì zhème duō dòujiāng, nǐ yí ge rén hē de wán ma?
lines.english: But can you drink all that soy milk by yourself?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 喝不完的，只好送給室友了。
lines.simplified: 喝不完的，只好送给室友了。
lines.pinyin: Hē bù wán de, zhǐhǎo sòng gěi shìyǒu le.
lines.english: What I can't finish, I'll have to give to my roommate.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼買這麼多豆漿？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么买这么多豆浆？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme mǎi zhème duō dòujiāng?
prompt.english: Why does the man buy so much soy milk?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn yì zhāng hǎibào.
choices.english: He wants to trade for a poster.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He wants to give soy milk to his roommate.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng huàn yí ge wáwa.
choices.english: He wants to trade for a doll.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō hē yìdiǎn dòujiāng.
choices.english: He wants to drink more soy milk.

questions.why: 為了換史努比娃娃: he buys the soy milk for the stickers that add up to a Snoopy doll, not a poster. His roommate only gets what he can't finish, and he doesn't even like soy milk (你不是不喜歡喝嗎？).

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽媽，我的手機不見了，可以給我錢買一支新的嗎？
lines.simplified: 妈妈，我的手机不见了，可以给我钱买一支新的吗？
lines.pinyin: Māma, wǒ de shǒujī bújiàn le, kěyǐ gěi wǒ qián mǎi yì zhī xīn de ma?
lines.english: Mom, my phone is gone. Can you give me money for a new one?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 又不見了？這已經是今年第二支了，你真不愛惜東西。
lines.simplified: 又不见了？这已经是今年第二支了，你真不爱惜东西。
lines.pinyin: Yòu bújiàn le? Zhè yǐjīng shì jīnnián dì èr zhī le, nǐ zhēn bú àixí dōngxi.
lines.english: Gone again? That's already the second one this year. You really don't take care of your things.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次不是我自己丟的，是在公車上被偷的。
lines.simplified: 这次不是我自己丢的，是在公车上被偷的。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì bú shì wǒ zìjǐ diū de, shì zài gōngchē shàng bèi tōu de.
lines.english: I didn't lose it this time. It was stolen on the bus.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不管是不是你的錯，這次你都得用自己的零用錢買。
lines.simplified: 不管是不是你的错，这次你都得用自己的零用钱买。
lines.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì bú shì nǐ de cuò, zhè cì nǐ dōu děi yòng zìjǐ de língyòngqián mǎi.
lines.english: Whether it was your fault or not, this time you have to buy it with your own allowance.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我一個月的零用錢只有三千塊，最便宜的手機也要九千。
lines.simplified: 可是我一个月的零用钱只有三千块，最便宜的手机也要九千。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ yí ge yuè de língyòngqián zhǐ yǒu sānqiān kuài, zuì piányí de shǒujī yě yào jiǔqiān.
lines.english: But my allowance is only 3,000 a month, and the cheapest phone costs 9,000.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你就省一點，每個月的零用錢都別花。
lines.simplified: 那你就省一点，每个月的零用钱都别花。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jiù shěng yìdiǎn, měi ge yuè de língyòngqián dōu bié huā.
lines.english: Then save a bit: don't spend any of your allowance each month.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 媽媽的意思是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈的意思是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Māma de yìsi shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the mother mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā huì péi érzi qù mǎi shǒujī.
choices.english: She will go phone shopping with her son.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Érzi děi yòng zìjǐ de qián mǎi.

questions.why: The cheapest phone costs 9,000 and his allowance is 3,000 a month, so it takes three months' allowance (9,000 ÷ 3,000), all of it saved (每個月的零用錢都別花).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我妹妹九月就要上大學了，我想送她一台平板，妳覺得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 我妹妹九月就要上大学了，我想送她一台平板，你觉得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei jiǔ yuè jiù yào shàng dàxué le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yì tái píngbǎn, nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: My sister starts university in September. I'd like to give her a tablet. What do you think?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不錯啊！可是她會用嗎？
lines.simplified: 不错啊！可是她会用吗？
lines.pinyin: Búcuò a! Kěshì tā huì yòng ma?
lines.english: Nice idea! But will she use it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她不管去哪裡，都帶著好幾本書，背包重死了。平板又輕，又能看書、看新聞，她一定會喜歡。
lines.simplified: 她不管去哪里，都带着好几本书，背包重死了。平板又轻，又能看书、看新闻，她一定会喜欢。
lines.pinyin: Tā bùguǎn qù nǎlǐ, dōu dài zhe hǎojǐ běn shū, bēibāo zhòng sǐ le. Píngbǎn yòu qīng, yòu néng kàn shū, kàn xīnwén, tā yídìng huì xǐhuān.
lines.english: Wherever she goes, she carries several books; her backpack is terribly heavy. A tablet is light and she can read books and the news on it. She'll love it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 光華商場這個週末有活動，不管買什麼，買滿兩萬就送兩千，你要不要去看看？
lines.simplified: 光华商场这个周末有活动，不管买什么，买满两万就送两千，你要不要去看看？
lines.pinyin: Guānghuá Shāngchǎng zhège zhōumò yǒu huódòng, bùguǎn mǎi shénme, mǎi mǎn liǎngwàn jiù sòng liǎngqiān, nǐ yào bú yào qù kànkan?
lines.english: Guanghua Digital Plaza has an offer this weekend: whatever you buy, spend 20,000 and get 2,000 back. Want to go and have a look?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我只打算花大約一萬五，這個活動恐怕用不上。不過還是可以去看看。
lines.simplified: 我只打算花大约一万五，这个活动恐怕用不上。不过还是可以去看看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ dǎsuàn huā dàyuē yíwàn wǔ, zhège huódòng kǒngpà yòng bú shàng. Búguò háishì kěyǐ qù kànkan.
lines.english: I only plan to spend about 15,000, so I'm afraid that offer won't help me. But we can still go and look.

lines.traditional: 喂，是我。對不起，今天晚上一起吃飯，我恐怕不能去了。
lines.simplified: 喂，是我。对不起，今天晚上一起吃饭，我恐怕不能去了。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, shì wǒ. Duìbùqǐ, jīntiān wǎnshàng yìqǐ chīfàn, wǒ kǒngpà bù néng qù le.
lines.english: Hi, it's me. Sorry, I'm afraid I can't come to dinner with you tonight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 修理冰箱的人說下午兩點會來，我在家白等了三個小時，他五點才打電話來，說今天不能來了。我下午的工作都沒做，今天晚上得在家做完。
lines.simplified: 修理冰箱的人说下午两点会来，我在家白等了三个小时，他五点才打电话来，说今天不能来了。我下午的工作都没做，今天晚上得在家做完。
lines.pinyin: Xiūlǐ bīngxiāng de rén shuō xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn huì lái, wǒ zài jiā bái děng le sān ge xiǎoshí, tā wǔ diǎn cái dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō jīntiān bù néng lái le. Wǒ xiàwǔ de gōngzuò dōu méi zuò, jīntiān wǎnshàng děi zài jiā zuò wán.
lines.english: The fridge repairman said he'd come at two. I waited at home for three hours for nothing; he only called at five to say he couldn't come today. I got none of my afternoon's work done, so I have to finish it at home tonight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他明天早上九點會再來，所以我明天上午也得在家等他。我們改到星期五晚上吃，好不好？你聽到留言以後，回個電話給我。
lines.simplified: 他明天早上九点会再来，所以我明天上午也得在家等他。我们改到星期五晚上吃，好不好？你听到留言以后，回个电话给我。
lines.pinyin: Tā míngtiān zǎoshàng jiǔ diǎn huì zài lái, suǒyǐ wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ yě děi zài jiā děng tā. Wǒmen gǎi dào xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng chī, hǎo bù hǎo? Nǐ tīng dào liúyán yǐhòu, huí ge diànhuà gěi wǒ.
lines.english: He'll come again tomorrow at nine, so I have to wait at home tomorrow morning too. Shall we move dinner to Friday evening? Call me back when you get this message.

questions.why: 白等了三個小時 means he waited three hours for nothing: at five the repairman called to say he wasn't coming today. Two o'clock was only the promised time, and he is coming tomorrow at nine.

prompt.english: When does the speaker want to move the dinner to?

questions.why: 我們改到星期五晚上吃: he moves the dinner to Friday evening. Tonight he must finish his work at home, and tomorrow morning he is waiting for the repairman.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上個星期六，朋友說光華商場有一家店的平板很便宜，一台只要八千塊，我就坐了半個小時的捷運去買。
lines.simplified: 上个星期六，朋友说光华商场有一家店的平板很便宜，一台只要八千块，我就坐了半个小时的捷运去买。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù, péngyǒu shuō Guānghuá Shāngchǎng yǒu yì jiā diàn de píngbǎn hěn piányí, yì tái zhǐ yào bāqiān kuài, wǒ jiù zuò le bàn ge xiǎoshí de jiéyùn qù mǎi.
lines.english: Last Saturday a friend said a shop at Guanghua Digital Plaza had cheap tablets, only 8,000 each, so I took the MRT for half an hour to buy one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我十點就到了，那家店十一點才開門。開門以後，店員說便宜的平板只有十台，前一天就賣完了，以後也不會再賣，我真是白跑了。
lines.simplified: 我十点就到了，那家店十一点才开门。开门以后，店员说便宜的平板只有十台，前一天就卖完了，以后也不会再卖，我真是白跑了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shí diǎn jiù dào le, nà jiā diàn shíyī diǎn cái kāimén. Kāimén yǐhòu, diànyuán shuō piányí de píngbǎn zhǐ yǒu shí tái, qián yì tiān jiù mài wán le, yǐhòu yě bú huì zài mài, wǒ zhēn shì bái pǎo le.
lines.english: I got there at ten; the shop didn't open until eleven. When it opened, the clerk said there had only been ten cheap tablets, they sold out the day before, and there wouldn't be more. It was a wasted trip.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 回家以後，我上網打聽了一下，網路上的價格高了一點，一台要八千五，可是第二天就能送到。我想了想，就在網路上訂了一台。
lines.simplified: 回家以后，我上网打听了一下，网路上的价格高了一点，一台要八千五，可是第二天就能送到。我想了想，就在网路上订了一台。
lines.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ shàngwǎng dǎtīng le yíxià, wǎnglù shàng de jiàgé gāo le yìdiǎn, yì tái yào bāqiān wǔ, kěshì dì èr tiān jiù néng sòng dào. Wǒ xiǎng le xiǎng, jiù zài wǎnglù shàng dìng le yì tái.
lines.english: At home I looked around online: the price there was a bit higher, 8,500 each, but it could arrive the next day. I thought it over and ordered one online.

prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi shàngbān zú chángcháng chūchāi, xiǎng mǎi bǐ yī diǎn wǔ gōngjīn qīng, diànchí néng yòng chāoguò bā xiǎoshí, jiàgé bù chāoguò sānwàn yuán de bǐdiàn. Tā yīnggāi mǎi nǎ yì tái?
