prompt.english: A man buys a NT$31,000 laptop and a NT$8,000 fax machine. How much does he pay in all?

questions.why: The laptop is 2,000 off (29,000), but fax machines are not discounted (傳真機不打折), so he pays 29,000 + 8,000 = 37,000.

passage.traditional: 上個月我的手機壞了，想買一支新的。朋友說網路上比較便宜，可是{1}別人怎麼說，我都喜歡先去店裡看看。我去了好幾家店，最後在光華商場找到一支很輕的手機，跟我以前那支{2}，好用多了，可是{3}，要一萬五。我看了很久，{4}就付錢了，後來想到網路上可能比較便宜，我才沒買。第二天，哥哥換了新手機，就把他以前用的那支送給了我。要是那天買了，就{5}花錢了。
passage.simplified: 上个月我的手机坏了，想买一支新的。朋友说网路上比较便宜，可是{1}别人怎么说，我都喜欢先去店里看看。我去了好几家店，最后在光华商场找到一支很轻的手机，跟我以前那支{2}，好用多了，可是{3}，要一万五。我看了很久，{4}就付钱了，后来想到网路上可能比较便宜，我才没买。第二天，哥哥换了新手机，就把他以前用的那支送给了我。要是那天买了，就{5}花钱了。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ de shǒujī huài le, xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xīn de. Péngyǒu shuō wǎnglù shàng bǐjiào piányí, kěshì bùguǎn biérén zěnme shuō, wǒ dōu xǐhuān xiān qù diàn lǐ kànkan. Wǒ qù le hǎojǐ jiā diàn, zuìhòu zài Guānghuá Shāngchǎng zhǎo dào yì zhī hěn qīng de shǒujī, gēn wǒ yǐqián nà zhī bǐ qǐlái, hǎoyòng duō le, kěshì guì le yìdiǎn, yào yíwàn wǔ. Wǒ kàn le hěn jiǔ, chàyìdiǎn jiù fù qián le, hòulái xiǎng dào wǎnglù shàng kěnéng bǐjiào piányí, wǒ cái méi mǎi. Dì èr tiān, gēge huàn le xīn shǒujī, jiù bǎ tā yǐqián yòng de nà zhī sòng gěi le wǒ. Yàoshì nà tiān mǎi le, jiù bái huā qián le.
passage.english: Last month my phone broke and I wanted a new one. My friends said it's cheaper online, but whatever others say, I like to look in a shop first. I tried several shops and at last, at Guanghua Digital Plaza, found a very light phone, far handier than my old one, but a bit too expensive: 15,000. I looked at it for a long time and almost paid, but then I thought it might be cheaper online, so I didn't buy it. The next day my brother got a new phone and gave me his old one. If I had bought one that day, I would have spent the money for nothing.

questions.why: 不管 + a question (別人怎麼說) + 都: whatever others say, she still looks in a shop first. 雖然, 只要 and 不如 can't take a question word followed by 都.
跟我以前那支比起來，好用多了: compared with her old phone, this one is much handier. 一樣 and 差不多 clash with 多了, and 不如 can't follow 跟…… (it is A 不如 B).
可是 brings a small complaint, and 要一萬五 shows it is about the price: 貴了一點. She has just called the phone very light (很輕) and it is new, so 重 and 舊 contradict the text; a cheap price is no complaint.
差一點就付錢了……我才沒買: she almost paid but didn't. 一下子就付錢了 says she did pay, which 我才沒買 rules out; 有一點 and 白 can't come before 就付錢了.
Her brother gave her a phone the next day, so buying one would have been money spent for nothing: 白花錢. 才, 剛 and 不如 don't fit 就……花錢了.

passage.traditional: 我爸爸是上班族，常出差。以前他{1}出差多久，都得帶一台很重的筆電。上個月筆電壞了，店員說修理要花一萬多，{2}多花一點錢，換一台新的。我們看到一台平板，很輕，可是電池{3}，只能用六個小時。旁邊那台{4}這台貴兩千，電池能用十個小時，爸爸買了那台。回家以後，他以為自己忘了拿保證書，又坐了一個小時的車回店裡找，可是保證書就在袋子裡，這一個小時都{5}花了。
passage.simplified: 我爸爸是上班族，常出差。以前他{1}出差多久，都得带一台很重的笔电。上个月笔电坏了，店员说修理要花一万多，{2}多花一点钱，换一台新的。我们看到一台平板，很轻，可是电池{3}，只能用六个小时。旁边那台{4}这台贵两千，电池能用十个小时，爸爸买了那台。回家以后，他以为自己忘了拿保证书，又坐了一个小时的车回店里找，可是保证书就在袋子里，这一个小时都{5}花了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì shàngbān zú, cháng chūchāi. Yǐqián tā bùguǎn chūchāi duō jiǔ, dōu děi dài yì tái hěn zhòng de bǐdiàn. Shàng ge yuè bǐdiàn huài le, diànyuán shuō xiūlǐ yào huā yíwàn duō, bùrú duō huā yìdiǎn qián, huàn yì tái xīn de. Wǒmen kàn dào yì tái píngbǎn, hěn qīng, kěshì diànchí chà le yìdiǎn, zhǐ néng yòng liù ge xiǎoshí. Pángbiān nà tái bǐ zhè tái guì liǎngqiān, diànchí néng yòng shí ge xiǎoshí, bàba mǎi le nà tái. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tā yǐwéi zìjǐ wàng le ná bǎozhèngshū, yòu zuò le yí ge xiǎoshí de chē huí diàn lǐ zhǎo, kěshì bǎozhèngshū jiù zài dàizi lǐ, zhè yí ge xiǎoshí dōu bái huā le.
passage.english: My dad is an office worker and often travels for work. However long his trips, he used to have to take a very heavy laptop. Last month the laptop broke, and the clerk said a repair would cost over 10,000; better to spend a bit more and get a new one. We saw a tablet that was light, but its battery was a bit weak: only six hours. The one next to it cost 2,000 more, but its battery lasted ten hours, so Dad bought that one. At home he thought he had forgotten the warranty card, so he rode an hour back to the shop to look for it, but the card was in the bag all along: that hour was wasted.

questions.why: 不管出差多久……都得帶: however long the trip, he had to take the laptop. 因為, 雖然 and 不如 can't open a question (多久) followed by 都.
Repair costs over 10,000, so the clerk says 不如多花一點錢，換一台新的: better to pay a bit more for a new one. 不但 would need 而且, 因為 gives no reason here, and 不管 needs a question after it.
可是 and 只能用六個小時 show a weak point: the battery is 差了一點. The other three praise the battery, which 只能 contradicts.
A 比 B 貴兩千: the other one costs 2,000 more than this one. 跟、像 and 對 can't take 貴 + an amount.
The warranty card was in the bag all along, so the hour's ride back was wasted: 都白花了. 剛, 不如 and 才 can't follow 都 here or say the time was for nothing.

text.traditional: 我爸爸今年六十五歲，去年從公司退休了。以前上班的時候，他常常用傳真機，對新的3C產品一點興趣也沒有。上個月我送他一台平板，跟他說明平板的功能，教他上網看新聞。一開始他說，平板很輕，功能也多，電池也夠用，可是上面的字小了一點，看一下子眼睛就累了，不如看報紙。後來我幫他把字變大，他就越用越喜歡了。現在他出門的時候，不管是去公園還是去朋友家，都帶著平板。上個星期他去公園散步，差一點忘了把平板帶回家，還好旁邊的人叫了他。他認為科技產品真的能讓老人的生活更便利。
text.simplified: 我爸爸今年六十五岁，去年从公司退休了。以前上班的时候，他常常用传真机，对新的3C产品一点兴趣也没有。上个月我送他一台平板，跟他说明平板的功能，教他上网看新闻。一开始他说，平板很轻，功能也多，电池也够用，可是上面的字小了一点，看一下子眼睛就累了，不如看报纸。后来我帮他把字变大，他就越用越喜欢了。现在他出门的时候，不管是去公园还是去朋友家，都带着平板。上个星期他去公园散步，差一点忘了把平板带回家，还好旁边的人叫了他。他认为科技产品真的能让老人的生活更便利。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba jīnnián liùshíwǔ suì, qùnián cóng gōngsī tuìxiū le. Yǐqián shàngbān de shíhòu, tā chángcháng yòng chuánzhēnjī, duì xīn de 3C chǎnpǐn yìdiǎn xìngqù yě méiyǒu. Shàng ge yuè wǒ sòng tā yì tái píngbǎn, gēn tā shuōmíng píngbǎn de gōngnéng, jiāo tā shàngwǎng kàn xīnwén. Yìkāishǐ tā shuō, píngbǎn hěn qīng, gōngnéng yě duō, diànchí yě gòu yòng, kěshì shàngmiàn de zì xiǎo le yìdiǎn, kàn yíxiàzi yǎnjīng jiù lèi le, bùrú kàn bàozhǐ. Hòulái wǒ bāng tā bǎ zì biàn dà, tā jiù yuè yòng yuè xǐhuān le. Xiànzài tā chūmén de shíhòu, bùguǎn shì qù gōngyuán háishì qù péngyǒu jiā, dōu dài zhe píngbǎn. Shàng ge xīngqí tā qù gōngyuán sànbù, chàyìdiǎn wàng le bǎ píngbǎn dài huí jiā, háihǎo pángbiān de rén jiào le tā. Tā rènwéi kējì chǎnpǐn zhēn de néng ràng lǎorén de shēnghuó gèng biànlì.
text.english: My dad is 65 and retired from his company last year. When he worked he often used fax machines, and he had no interest at all in new electronics. Last month I gave him a tablet, explained what it can do and taught him to read the news online. At first he said the tablet was light, had lots of functions and enough battery, but the letters on it were a bit small and his eyes got tired after a moment, so he'd rather read the newspaper. Then I made the letters bigger for him, and the more he used it, the more he liked it. Now when he goes out, whether to the park or to a friend's home, he takes the tablet. Last week, on a walk in the park, he almost forgot to take it home, but luckily the person next to him called out. He thinks technology really can make old people's lives more convenient.

prompt.traditional: 爸爸一開始為什麼不喜歡用平板？
prompt.simplified: 爸爸一开始为什么不喜欢用平板？
prompt.pinyin: Bàba yìkāishǐ wèishénme bù xǐhuān yòng píngbǎn?
prompt.english: Why didn't the father like using the tablet at first?

choices.pinyin: Diànchí hěn kuài jiù méi diàn.
Shàngmiàn de zì yǒu yìdiǎn xiǎo.
choices.english: The letters on it were rather small.

questions.why: 上面的字小了一點，看一下子眼睛就累了: the letters were a bit too small. The same sentence says the tablet is light, has many functions and enough battery (很輕，功能也多，電池也夠用).

prompt.traditional: 爸爸現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 爸爸现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Bàba xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is the father now?

choices.english: He often takes the tablet out with him.

choices.pinyin: Zài gōngyuán bǎ píngbǎn diū le.
choices.english: He lost the tablet in the park.
He still works with fax machines.

choices.pinyin: Měi tiān dōu zài gōngyuán kàn xīnwén.
choices.english: He reads the news in the park every day.

questions.why: 不管是去公園還是去朋友家，都帶著平板: whenever he goes out, the tablet goes with him. He only almost forgot it in the park (差一點), he has retired from the job with the fax machines, and the park is only where he walked last week.

text.traditional: 上個月，我在百貨公司看到一個真皮背包，要四千塊，我覺得太貴了。後來在網路上看到一樣的背包，比百貨公司便宜一半，我馬上就買了。三天以後背包送到了，看起來跟照片上的一樣好看。可是才用了兩個星期，背包就壞了。我上網查了一下，發現很多人都在抱怨，說他們買到的背包不是真皮的。我打電話給賣背包的人，他說這種問題很正常，不能換新的。這次我白花了兩千塊。現在不管買什麼，我都會先上網看看別人的經驗。
text.simplified: 上个月，我在百货公司看到一个真皮背包，要四千块，我觉得太贵了。后来在网路上看到一样的背包，比百货公司便宜一半，我马上就买了。三天以后背包送到了，看起来跟照片上的一样好看。可是才用了两个星期，背包就坏了。我上网查了一下，发现很多人都在抱怨，说他们买到的背包不是真皮的。我打电话给卖背包的人，他说这种问题很正常，不能换新的。这次我白花了两千块。现在不管买什么，我都会先上网看看别人的经验。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ zài bǎihuò gōngsī kàn dào yí ge zhēn pí bēibāo, yào sìqiān kuài, wǒ juéde tài guì le. Hòulái zài wǎnglù shàng kàn dào yíyàng de bēibāo, bǐ bǎihuò gōngsī piányí yíbàn, wǒ mǎshàng jiù mǎi le. Sān tiān yǐhòu bēibāo sòng dào le, kànqǐlái gēn zhàopiàn shàng de yíyàng hǎokàn. Kěshì cái yòng le liǎng ge xīngqí, bēibāo jiù huài le. Wǒ shàngwǎng chá le yíxià, fāxiàn hěn duō rén dōu zài bàoyuàn, shuō tāmen mǎi dào de bēibāo bú shì zhēn pí de. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi mài bēibāo de rén, tā shuō zhè zhǒng wèntí hěn zhèngcháng, bù néng huàn xīn de. Zhè cì wǒ bái huā le liǎngqiān kuài. Xiànzài bùguǎn mǎi shénme, wǒ dōu huì xiān shàngwǎng kànkan biérén de jīngyàn.
text.english: Last month I saw a genuine leather backpack in a department store for 4,000 and thought it too expensive. Then I saw the same backpack online for half the department-store price and bought it at once. It arrived three days later and looked as nice as in the photo. But after only two weeks of use, it broke. I checked online and found lots of people complaining that the backpacks they got were not real leather. I called the seller, who said this kind of problem is normal and he couldn't exchange it. This time I wasted 2,000 dollars. Now, whatever I buy, I first look online at other people's experiences.

prompt.traditional: 這個人為什麼在網路上買這個背包？
prompt.simplified: 这个人为什么在网路上买这个背包？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén wèishénme zài wǎnglù shàng mǎi zhège bēibāo?
prompt.english: Why did this person buy the backpack online?

choices.traditional: 比百貨公司的便宜很多
choices.simplified: 比百货公司的便宜很多
choices.pinyin: Bǐ bǎihuò gōngsī de piányí hěn duō.
choices.english: It was much cheaper than the department store's.

choices.pinyin: Dāngtiān jiù néng sòng dào jiā.
choices.english: It could be delivered the same day.

choices.pinyin: Hěn duō rén dōu shuō hěn hǎoyòng.
choices.english: Many people said it was handy.

choices.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī de mài wán le.
choices.english: The department store had sold out.

questions.why: 比百貨公司便宜一半: half the 4,000 she saw in the department store, so much cheaper. The bag was still in the department store, it took three days to arrive, and people complained about it.

prompt.traditional: 這個人為什麼說自己白花了兩千塊？
prompt.simplified: 这个人为什么说自己白花了两千块？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén wèishénme shuō zìjǐ bái huā le liǎngqiān kuài?
prompt.english: Why does this person say the 2,000 dollars were wasted?

choices.pinyin: Mài de rén bú yuànyì huàn xīn de.
choices.english: The seller wouldn't exchange it for a new one.

choices.pinyin: Bēibāo sòng dào shí jiù huài le.
choices.english: The backpack was broken when it arrived.
The backpack looked worse than in the photo.

choices.pinyin: Mài de rén yìzhí bù jiē diànhuà.
choices.english: The seller never answered the phone.

questions.why: The bag broke after two weeks and the seller said it couldn't be exchanged (不能換新的), so the money brought nothing: 白花了. It arrived fine and looked like the photo, and the seller did answer her call.

text.traditional: 去年春假，我跟兩個同學去嘉義旅行。為了省錢，我們沒坐飛機，一個月以前就在網路上訂了火車票。很多人都趁著放假出去玩，車票一下子就賣光了，還好我們訂得早，才訂得到座位。到了嘉義，我們住在一家民宿，從火車站走路只要五分鐘。老闆很客氣，還告訴我們哪裡的小吃最有名。第二天我們去阿里山爬山，山上的風景美極了，不過比山下冷多了。回台北以前，我們買了很多當地的名產，連背包都放不下了。
text.simplified: 去年春假，我跟两个同学去嘉义旅行。为了省钱，我们没坐飞机，一个月以前就在网路上订了火车票。很多人都趁着放假出去玩，车票一下子就卖光了，还好我们订得早，才订得到座位。到了嘉义，我们住在一家民宿，从火车站走路只要五分钟。老板很客气，还告诉我们哪里的小吃最有名。第二天我们去阿里山爬山，山上的风景美极了，不过比山下冷多了。回台北以前，我们买了很多当地的名产，连背包都放不下了。
text.pinyin: Qùnián chūnjià, wǒ gēn liǎng ge tóngxué qù Jiāyì lǚxíng. Wèile shěngqián, wǒmen méi zuò fēijī, yí ge yuè yǐqián jiù zài wǎnglù shàng dìng le huǒchē piào. Hěn duō rén dōu chènzhe fàngjià chūqù wán, chēpiào yíxiàzi jiù mài guāng le, háihǎo wǒmen dìng de zǎo, cái dìng de dào zuòwèi. Dào le Jiāyì, wǒmen zhù zài yì jiā mínsù, cóng huǒchē zhàn zǒulù zhǐ yào wǔ fēnzhōng. Lǎobǎn hěn kèqì, hái gàosu wǒmen nǎlǐ de xiǎochī zuì yǒumíng. Dì èr tiān wǒmen qù Ālǐshān pá shān, shān shàng de fēngjǐng měi jí le, búguò bǐ shān xià lěng duō le. Huí Táiběi yǐqián, wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō dāngdì de míngchǎn, lián bēibāo dōu fàng bú xià le.
text.english: Last spring break, two classmates and I took a trip to Chiayi. To save money we didn't fly; a month ahead we booked train tickets online. Lots of people use the holiday to travel, and the tickets sold out in no time; luckily we booked early, so we got seats. In Chiayi we stayed at a B&B just a five-minute walk from the station. The owner was very kind and told us where the most famous street food was. The next day we hiked on Alishan; the view from the mountain was wonderful, but it was much colder than at the bottom. Before going back to Taipei we bought so many local specialties that our backpacks couldn't hold them all.

prompt.traditional: 他們為什麼訂得到座位？
prompt.simplified: 他们为什么订得到座位？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen wèishénme dìng de dào zuòwèi?
prompt.english: Why were they able to get seats?

choices.pinyin: Tāmen hěn zǎo jiù dìng piào le.
Tāmen shì zuò fēijī qù de.
Fàngjià de shíhòu rén bù duō.
choices.english: Few people travel in the holidays.

choices.pinyin: Chēpiào yíxiàzi jiù mài guāng le.

text.traditional: 我哥哥大學畢業以後，在一家貿易公司當職員。他剛進公司那年，每天五點就下班。從去年起，他當了經理的助理，常常得加班到晚上十點，不過週末還是不用上班。因為沒時間運動，三餐也不正常，他越來越胖，還常常頭痛。上個月他去看病，醫生說他不用吃藥，可是每天得睡滿七個小時。現在他晚上十一點以前一定睡覺，自己還決定每天早上去公園慢跑，晚餐也少吃油炸的東西。他說，雖然體重沒減多少，頭也還是有時候會痛，可是精神比以前好多了。
text.simplified: 我哥哥大学毕业以后，在一家贸易公司当职员。他刚进公司那年，每天五点就下班。从去年起，他当了经理的助理，常常得加班到晚上十点，不过周末还是不用上班。因为没时间运动，三餐也不正常，他越来越胖，还常常头痛。上个月他去看病，医生说他不用吃药，可是每天得睡满七个小时。现在他晚上十一点以前一定睡觉，自己还决定每天早上去公园慢跑，晚餐也少吃油炸的东西。他说，虽然体重没减多少，头也还是有时候会痛，可是精神比以前好多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī dāng zhíyuán. Tā gāng jìn gōngsī nà nián, měi tiān wǔ diǎn jiù xiàbān. Cóng qùnián qǐ, tā dāng le jīnglǐ de zhùlǐ, chángcháng děi jiābān dào wǎnshàng shí diǎn, búguò zhōumò háishì bú yòng shàngbān. Yīnwèi méi shíjiān yùndòng, sān cān yě bú zhèngcháng, tā yuèláiyuè pàng, hái chángcháng tóutòng. Shàng ge yuè tā qù kànbìng, yīshēng shuō tā bú yòng chī yào, kěshì měi tiān děi shuì mǎn qī ge xiǎoshí. Xiànzài tā wǎnshàng shíyī diǎn yǐqián yídìng shuìjiào, zìjǐ hái juédìng měi tiān zǎoshàng qù gōngyuán mànpǎo, wǎncān yě shǎo chī yóuzhá de dōngxi. Tā shuō, suīrán tǐzhòng méi jiǎn duōshǎo, tóu yě háishì yǒu shíhòu huì tòng, kěshì jīngshén bǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le.
text.english: After graduating, my older brother became a clerk at a trading company. In his first year there, he left work at five every day. Since last year he has been the manager's assistant and often has to work overtime until ten at night, though he still has weekends off. With no time to exercise and irregular meals, he got heavier and heavier and often had headaches. Last month he saw a doctor, who said he didn't need medicine but had to sleep a full seven hours a day. Now he always goes to bed before eleven, and he decided himself to jog in the park every morning and eat less fried food at dinner. He says that although he hasn't lost much weight and his head still aches sometimes, he has much more energy than before.

picture.alt: A bright school canteen with big windows, green trees outside and other students eating at tables in the back. Three young people sit side by side at a wooden table, each with a bowl of food on a blue tray. In the middle, a young man with wavy brown hair, a dark red shirt and a mustard-yellow sweater vest rests his cheek on one hand and looks down at a phone in the other hand; his eyebrows are raised and his mouth turns down, so he looks sad and worried. The dark blue bowl of noodles in front of him is untouched. On the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair, round glasses, a white collared shirt, a dark purple sweater vest and olive trousers puts one hand on his shoulder and holds the other hand out, smiling and talking to him. On the right, a girl with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, a blue jacket over an orange top and white trousers smiles at him and holds out an open hand. Chopsticks lie on the left tray.

picture.alt: Daytime outside an old house with a grey tiled roof and stone walls, under a blue sky with a few clouds. In the red wooden doorway stand an old man with grey hair in a bun, a white beard and a dark brown robe, one hand on the door frame, and an old woman with grey hair in a bun and a red robe, her hands pressed together in front of her chest; both are laughing and looking toward the monster. A red lantern hangs from the roof. Red firecrackers with gold bands lie on the stone steps and the ground and are going off with bright yellow sparks; bits of red paper fly through the air. On the right, a big furry teal-and-cream monster with one golden horn, a red-orange mane, wide frightened eyes and an open mouth full of fangs leaps away from the house with its paws in the air. lines.simplified: 可是那台比较重……好吧，我听你的。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nà tái bǐjiào zhòng……hǎo ba, wǒ tīng nǐ de.
lines.english: But that one's heavier... Oh, all right, I'll do as you say.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後可能會花多少錢買筆電？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后可能会花多少钱买笔电？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu kěnéng huì huā duōshǎo qián mǎi bǐdiàn?
prompt.english: How much will the man probably spend on a laptop in the end?

questions.why: 你不如多花三千塊，買旁邊那台: she says he would do better to spend 3,000 more on the other laptop, and he agrees (我聽妳的): 18,000 + 3,000 = 21,000.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想每天晚上去操場慢跑，妳要不要一起去？
lines.simplified: 我想每天晚上去操场慢跑，你要不要一起去？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng měi tiān wǎnshàng qù cāochǎng mànpǎo, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù?
lines.english: I want to go jogging on the sports field every evening. Do you want to come?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對我來說，晚上跑步太累了。我比較喜歡早上起來跑，跑完再吃早飯。
lines.simplified: 对我来说，晚上跑步太累了。我比较喜欢早上起来跑，跑完再吃早饭。
lines.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, wǎnshàng pǎobù tài lèi le. Wǒ bǐjiào xǐhuān zǎoshàng qǐlái pǎo, pǎo wán zài chī zǎofàn.
lines.english: For me, running in the evening is too tiring. I prefer to run when I get up in the morning, then have breakfast.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我早上常常來不及吃早飯就去上課了……
lines.simplified: 可是我早上常常来不及吃早饭就去上课了……
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ zǎoshàng chángcháng láibùjí chī zǎofàn jiù qù shàngkè le……
lines.english: But in the morning I often don't even have time for breakfast before class...

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們週末早上一起跑吧，你就不用趕了。
lines.simplified: 那我们周末早上一起跑吧，你就不用赶了。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen zhōumò zǎoshàng yìqǐ pǎo ba, nǐ jiù búyòng gǎn le.
lines.english: Then let's run together on weekend mornings. You won't have to rush.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議什麼時候一起跑步？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议什么时候一起跑步？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì shénme shíhòu yìqǐ pǎobù?
prompt.english: When does the woman suggest they run together?

questions.why: She finds evening runs too tiring, and he has no time on weekday mornings, so she suggests weekend mornings, when he won't have to rush. Every evening is his idea, and she runs before breakfast, not after.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳知道嗎？今年除夕的年夜飯是我爺爺做的。
lines.simplified: 你知道吗？今年除夕的年夜饭是我爷爷做的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Jīnnián chúxī de niányèfàn shì wǒ yéye zuò de.
lines.english: Guess what? This year's New Year's Eve dinner was cooked by my grandpa.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你爺爺會做菜啊？我以為都是你奶奶做的。
lines.simplified: 你爷爷会做菜啊？我以为都是你奶奶做的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yéye huì zuò cài a? Wǒ yǐwéi dōu shì nǐ nǎinai zuò de.
lines.english: Your grandpa can cook? I thought your grandma did all the cooking.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以前是。爺爺以前從來不進廚房，可是奶奶上個月腳受傷了，他只好自己學。
lines.simplified: 以前是。爷爷以前从来不进厨房，可是奶奶上个月脚受伤了，他只好自己学。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián shì. Yéye yǐqián cónglái bú jìn chúfáng, kěshì nǎinai shàng ge yuè jiǎo shòushāng le, tā zhǐhǎo zìjǐ xué.
lines.english: She used to. Grandpa never used to set foot in the kitchen, but Grandma hurt her foot last month, so he had to learn.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他做得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 那他做得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā zuò de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So how did he do?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 魚煎得有一點黑，米粉炒得還不錯。要不是我媽媽下午去幫他煮水餃，我們晚上就吃不到水餃了。
lines.simplified: 鱼煎得有一点黑，米粉炒得还不错。要不是我妈妈下午去帮他煮水饺，我们晚上就吃不到水饺了。
lines.pinyin: Yú jiān de yǒu yìdiǎn hēi, mǐfěn chǎo de hái búcuò. Yàobúshì wǒ māma xiàwǔ qù bāng tā zhǔ shuǐjiǎo, wǒmen wǎnshàng jiù chī bú dào shuǐjiǎo le.
lines.english: The fish came out a bit burnt, but the fried rice noodles were pretty good. If my mom hadn't gone over in the afternoon to help him boil the dumplings, we'd have had no dumplings that night.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽起來很豐富啊！明年也讓你爺爺做吧！
lines.simplified: 听起来很丰富啊！明年也让你爷爷做吧！
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn fēngfù a! Míngnián yě ràng nǐ yéye zuò ba!
lines.english: Sounds like a feast! Let your grandpa cook next year too!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爺爺以前怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 爷爷以前怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yéye yǐqián zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What was Grandpa like before?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi nián zuò yí cì niányèfàn.
choices.english: He cooked New Year's Eve dinner once a year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò cài de shì dōu jiāo gěi nǎinai.
choices.english: He left all the cooking to Grandma.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chángcháng chǎo mǐfěn gěi jiārén chī.
choices.english: He often fried rice noodles for the family.

questions.why: 從來不進廚房: Grandpa never even went into the kitchen; Grandma did the cooking. He only learned this year, after she hurt her foot.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of these is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Mom helped Grandpa in the afternoon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They had no dumplings that night.

questions.why: 要不是我媽媽…，我們就吃不到水餃了 says what would have happened without her: she did go and help him with the dumplings, so they had them. The fish was a bit burnt, and Grandma hurt her foot last month.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 寒假過得怎麼樣？你回台南過年了嗎？
lines.simplified: 寒假过得怎么样？你回台南过年了吗？
lines.pinyin: Hánjià guò de zěnmeyàng? Nǐ huí Táinán guònián le ma?
lines.english: How was your winter break? Did you go home to Tainan for New Year?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 回去了。高鐵票我一張都沒買到，本來想坐朋友的車，可是他的車坐滿了。要不是我哥哥開車來台北帶我回去，我今年就得一個人在台北過年了。
lines.simplified: 回去了。高铁票我一张都没买到，本来想坐朋友的车，可是他的车坐满了。要不是我哥哥开车来台北带我回去，我今年就得一个人在台北过年了。
lines.pinyin: Huíqù le. Gāotiě piào wǒ yì zhāng dōu méi mǎi dào, běnlái xiǎng zuò péngyǒu de chē, kěshì tā de chē zuò mǎn le. Yàobúshì wǒ gēge kāichē lái Táiběi dài wǒ huíqù, wǒ jīnnián jiù děi yí ge rén zài Táiběi guònián le.
lines.english: I did. I couldn't get a single high-speed rail ticket, and I'd hoped to ride with a friend, but his car was full. If my brother hadn't driven up to Taipei to take me home, I'd have spent New Year alone in Taipei.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你哥哥真好！你們家除夕都做什麼？
lines.simplified: 你哥哥真好！你们家除夕都做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēge zhēn hǎo! Nǐmen jiā chúxī dōu zuò shénme?
lines.english: Your brother's so nice! What does your family do on New Year's Eve?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 拜完祖先就吃年夜飯，接著大家一起聊天，還在門口放鞭炮。
lines.simplified: 拜完祖先就吃年夜饭，接着大家一起聊天，还在门口放鞭炮。
lines.pinyin: Bài wán zǔxiān jiù chī niányèfàn, jiēzhe dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, hái zài ménkǒu fàng biānpào.
lines.english: After worshipping the ancestors we have the New Year's Eve dinner, then everyone chats, and we set off firecrackers at the door.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們家從來不放鞭炮，我爸爸說聲音太大，會嚇到鄰居的小孩。
lines.simplified: 我们家从来不放鞭炮，我爸爸说声音太大，会吓到邻居的小孩。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen jiā cónglái bú fàng biānpào, wǒ bàba shuō shēngyīn tài dà, huì xià dào línjū de xiǎohái.
lines.english: My family never sets off firecrackers. My dad says they're too loud and would frighten the neighbours' children.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 今年過年，男的怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 今年过年，男的怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Jīnnián guònián, nán de zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What did the man do this New Year?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He took the high-speed rail home to Tainan.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He went home with a friend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén liú zài Táiběi.

questions.why: 要不是我哥哥開車來台北帶我回去: his brother did drive up and take him home. He got no high-speed rail ticket, his friend's car was full, and New Year alone in Taipei is only what would have happened otherwise.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的家過年的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的家过年的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiā guònián de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What is the woman's family like at New Year?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Her father is the one who sets off the firecrackers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They set off firecrackers with the neighbours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Setting off firecrackers isn't their custom.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: They often frighten the neighbours' children.

questions.why: 從來不放鞭炮: her family never sets off firecrackers, because her father thinks they would frighten the neighbours' children. Firecrackers at the door are what the man's family does.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 喂，是我。今天下午你開車幫我搬家，真是太感謝你了！
lines.simplified: 喂，是我。今天下午你开车帮我搬家，真是太感谢你了！
lines.pinyin: Wéi, shì wǒ. Jīntiān xiàwǔ nǐ kāichē bāng wǒ bānjiā, zhēn shì tài gǎnxiè nǐ le!
lines.english: Hello, it's me. Thank you so much for driving over to help me move this afternoon!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是當我到了新家，打開行李的時候，就發現少了一個藍色的袋子，裡面是我要帶回家過年的年糕。
lines.simplified: 可是当我到了新家，打开行李的时候，就发现少了一个蓝色的袋子，里面是我要带回家过年的年糕。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì dāng wǒ dào le xīn jiā, dǎkāi xínglǐ de shíhòu, jiù fāxiàn shǎo le yí ge lánsè de dàizi, lǐmiàn shì wǒ yào dài huí jiā guònián de niángāo.
lines.english: But when I got to the new place and opened my bags, I found a blue bag was missing, the one with the New Year cakes I'm taking home for New Year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我想起來了，我把它放在舊房子的冰箱裡，忘了拿走。房東說明天下午就要把冰箱搬走了，你明天早上可以幫我去拿嗎？鑰匙還在你那裡。
lines.simplified: 我想起来了，我把它放在旧房子的冰箱里，忘了拿走。房东说明天下午就要把冰箱搬走了，你明天早上可以帮我去拿吗？钥匙还在你那里。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐlái le, wǒ bǎ tā fàng zài jiù fángzi de bīngxiāng lǐ, wàng le ná zǒu. Fángdōng shuō míngtiān xiàwǔ jiù yào bǎ bīngxiāng bān zǒu le, nǐ míngtiān zǎoshàng kěyǐ bāng wǒ qù ná ma? Yàoshi hái zài nǐ nàlǐ.
lines.english: Now I remember: I put it in the fridge at the old house and forgot to take it. The landlord says he's moving the fridge out tomorrow afternoon. Could you go and get it for me tomorrow morning? You still have the key.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位小姐是什麼時候發現少了東西的？
prompt.simplified: 这位小姐是什么时候发现少了东西的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiǎojiě shì shénme shíhòu fāxiàn shǎo le dōngxi de?
prompt.english: When did the woman find that something was missing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái zài jiù fángzi de shíhòu.
choices.english: While she was still at the old house.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: When she got to the new place.

questions.why: 當我到了新家，打開行李的時候，就發現…: she noticed as soon as she unpacked at the new place. The fridge is only where she left the bag, and the landlord only told her he is moving the fridge.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那個藍色的袋子現在在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 那个蓝色的袋子现在在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Nàge lánsè de dàizi xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is the blue bag now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The landlord has taken it away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài xīn jiā de bīngxiāng lǐ.
choices.english: In the fridge at the new place.

questions.why: 忘了拿走: she forgot to take it, so it is still in the fridge at her old place. The landlord moves the fridge only tomorrow afternoon, and the bag never reached the car or the new place.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，春節快到了，這個星期六上午，社區要打掃環境，歡迎大家一起來幫忙。
lines.simplified: 大家好，春节快到了，这个星期六上午，社区要打扫环境，欢迎大家一起来帮忙。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, chūnjié kuài dào le, zhège xīngqíliù shàngwǔ, shèqū yào dǎsǎo huánjìng, huānyíng dàjiā yìqǐ lái bāngmáng.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. The Spring Festival is coming, and this Saturday morning the community is cleaning up the grounds. Everyone is welcome to come and help.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 家裡不要的舊家具，請在星期五晚上以前放到停車場旁邊，星期六早上會有人來搬走。可是像床、衣櫃這樣的大東西太重了，他們搬不走，請大家自己想辦法。
lines.simplified: 家里不要的旧家具，请在星期五晚上以前放到停车场旁边，星期六早上会有人来搬走。可是像床、衣柜这样的大东西太重了，他们搬不走，请大家自己想办法。
lines.pinyin: Jiā lǐ bú yào de jiù jiājù, qǐng zài xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng yǐqián fàng dào tíngchēchǎng pángbiān, xīngqíliù zǎoshàng huì yǒu rén lái bān zǒu. Kěshì xiàng chuáng, yīguì zhèyàng de dà dōngxi tài zhòng le, tāmen bān bù zǒu, qǐng dàjiā zìjǐ xiǎng bànfǎ.
lines.english: Please put old furniture you don't want next to the car park before Friday night; people will come on Saturday morning to take it away. But big things like beds and wardrobes are too heavy for them to take, so please make your own arrangements.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 星期六下午兩點，書法老師會在大門口寫春聯，當老師寫好一百張的時候，就會開始送給大家，一家一張。
lines.simplified: 星期六下午两点，书法老师会在大门口写春联，当老师写好一百张的时候，就会开始送给大家，一家一张。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqíliù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, shūfǎ lǎoshī huì zài dàmén kǒu xiě chūnlián, dāng lǎoshī xiě hǎo yìbǎi zhāng de shíhòu, jiù huì kāishǐ sòng gěi dàjiā, yì jiā yì zhāng.
lines.english: At two on Saturday afternoon a calligraphy teacher will write spring couplets at the main gate. Once the teacher has written a hundred, they will be given out, one per household.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 像衣櫃這樣的大東西，要怎麼辦？
prompt.simplified: 像衣柜这样的大东西，要怎么办？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàng yīguì zhèyàng de dà dōngxi, yào zěnme bàn?
prompt.english: What should people do with big things like wardrobes?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Someone will come for them on Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Put them next to the car park.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: People must deal with them themselves.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Leave them by the main gate.

questions.why: 他們搬不走: the people collecting furniture can't take beds or wardrobes away, so everyone must deal with them themselves. Only smaller furniture goes beside the car park for the Saturday pick-up.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 大家什麼時候可以拿到春聯？
prompt.simplified: 大家什么时候可以拿到春联？
prompt.pinyin: Dàjiā shénme shíhòu kěyǐ ná dào chūnlián?
prompt.english: When can people get a spring couplet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Once a hundred have been written.

questions.why: 當老師寫好一百張的時候，就會開始送: the couplets are handed out only once the teacher has finished a hundred. Two o'clock is when the writing starts, and the clean-up is in the morning.

text.traditional:
除夕：早上八點到下午兩點
春節：休息三天
春節以後：早上八點到晚上八點
過年要吃的年糕、蘿蔔糕，請在除夕前三天打電話來訂。去年很多客人來晚了，蘿蔔糕都讓別人買光了。
電話：2345-6789
好吃水餃店
text.simplified:
除夕：早上八点到下午两点
春节：休息三天
春节以后：早上八点到晚上八点
过年要吃的年糕、萝卜糕，请在除夕前三天打电话来订。去年很多客人来晚了，萝卜糕都让别人买光了。

passage.traditional: 今年除夕，我跟爸爸媽媽回到鄉下的爺爺奶奶家過年。奶奶準備了年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕{1}。我們拜完祖先，就聚在一起吃年夜飯。{2}外面的鞭炮一響，我的小妹妹就嚇得哭了。第二天下午，姐姐要回台北了，她把奶奶做的年糕帶{3}了一半。我想跟門上的春聯照相，才發現春聯已經{4}鄰居的小孩弄髒了。{5}爺爺又寫了一張，我們家今年就只能貼髒的春聯了。
passage.simplified: 今年除夕，我跟爸爸妈妈回到乡下的爷爷奶奶家过年。奶奶准备了年糕、发糕、萝卜糕{1}。我们拜完祖先，就聚在一起吃年夜饭。{2}外面的鞭炮一响，我的小妹妹就吓得哭了。第二天下午，姐姐要回台北了，她把奶奶做的年糕带{3}了一半。我想跟门上的春联照相，才发现春联已经{4}邻居的小孩弄脏了。{5}爷爷又写了一张，我们家今年就只能贴脏的春联了。
passage.pinyin: Jīnnián chúxī, wǒ gēn bàba māma huí dào xiāngxià de yéye nǎinai jiā guònián. Nǎinai zhǔnbèi le niángāo, fāgāo, luóbogāo děngděng. Wǒmen bài wán zǔxiān, jiù jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn. Dāng wàimiàn de biānpào yì xiǎng, wǒ de xiǎo mèimei jiù xià de kū le. Dì èr tiān xiàwǔ, jiějie yào huí Táiběi le, tā bǎ nǎinai zuò de niángāo dài zǒu le yíbàn. Wǒ xiǎng gēn mén shàng de chūnlián zhàoxiàng, cái fāxiàn chūnlián yǐjīng ràng línjū de xiǎohái nòng zāng le. Yàobúshì yéye yòu xiě le yì zhāng, wǒmen jiā jīnnián jiù zhǐ néng tiē zāng de chūnlián le.
passage.english: This New Year's Eve my parents and I went back to my grandparents' home in the countryside for New Year. Grandma had made New Year cakes, sponge cakes, radish cakes and so on. After we had worshipped the ancestors, we all gathered for the New Year's Eve dinner. As soon as the firecrackers went off outside, my little sister got so scared she cried. The next afternoon my older sister was going back to Taipei, and she took away half of the New Year cakes Grandma had made. I wanted a photo with the spring couplet on the door, and only then found that the neighbours' children had got it dirty. If Grandpa hadn't written another one, our home would have had to put up a dirty couplet this year.

questions.why: Examples + 等等 closes a list that could go on: 年糕、發糕、蘿蔔糕等等. 一些 would have to come before the nouns, and 還有 and 什麼 cannot end a list.
當 + what happens (鞭炮一響), 就 + what follows at once (小妹妹就嚇得哭了). 從, 對 and 向 cannot open a "when" clause.
帶走 = take away with her: the older sister left with half of the cakes. 帶到 needs a place after it, and 帶起 and 帶過 do not fit.
S + 讓 + the doer + V了 is a passive like 被: the couplet had been dirtied by the neighbours' children. 跟, 替 and 對 do not mark who did it.
要不是 + what really happened (Grandpa wrote a new one), then what would have happened without it (a dirty couplet). 雖然, 只要 and 不管 do not fit 就只能…了.

passage.traditional: 這個學期的期末報告，老師的要求特別多。同學們上個星期就交了，我修改了好幾次，昨天{1}完成。我從來{2}這麼努力地寫過報告！寫完以後，我開始打掃房間，準備回家過年。我把不要的舊書、舊衣服{3}，都放進一個大袋子裡，請室友出門的時候幫我帶{4}。她走了以後，我忽然想起來，袋子裡有一件紅色的毛衣，是媽媽送我的。我趕快跑出去，{5}室友還在等電梯，那件毛衣就被丟了。
passage.simplified: 这个学期的期末报告，老师的要求特别多。同学们上个星期就交了，我修改了好几次，昨天{1}完成。我从来{2}这么努力地写过报告！写完以后，我开始打扫房间，准备回家过年。我把不要的旧书、旧衣服{3}，都放进一个大袋子里，请室友出门的时候帮我带{4}。她走了以后，我忽然想起来，袋子里有一件红色的毛衣，是妈妈送我的。我赶快跑出去，{5}室友还在等电梯，那件毛衣就被丢了。
passage.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí de qímò bàogào, lǎoshī de yāoqiú tèbié duō. Tóngxuémen shàng ge xīngqí jiù jiāo le, wǒ xiūgǎi le hǎojǐ cì, zuótiān cái wánchéng. Wǒ cónglái méi zhème nǔlì de xiě guo bàogào! Xiě wán yǐhòu, wǒ kāishǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, zhǔnbèi huí jiā guònián. Wǒ bǎ bú yào de jiù shū, jiù yīfu děngděng, dōu fàng jìn yí ge dà dàizi lǐ, qǐng shìyǒu chūmén de shíhòu bāng wǒ dài zǒu. Tā zǒu le yǐhòu, wǒ hūrán xiǎng qǐlái, dàizi lǐ yǒu yí jiàn hóngsè de máoyī, shì māma sòng wǒ de. Wǒ gǎnkuài pǎo chūqù, yàobúshì shìyǒu hái zài děng diàntī, nà jiàn máoyī jiù bèi diū le.
passage.english: This semester's final report: the teacher had especially many requirements. My classmates handed theirs in last week; I revised mine several times and only finished it yesterday. I have never worked so hard on a report! When it was done, I started cleaning my room to get ready to go home for New Year. I put the old books, old clothes and so on that I didn't want into a big bag and asked my roommate to take it away when she went out. After she left, I suddenly remembered there was a red sweater in the bag, a present from Mom. I rushed out. If my roommate hadn't still been waiting for the lift, that sweater would have been thrown away.

questions.why: Time + 才 + V: the classmates handed theirs in last week, and after many revisions she finished only yesterday (昨天才完成). 就 would mean "early" and needs 了; 再 and 又 do not fit.
從來沒 + V過 = have never: 從來沒這麼努力地寫過. 從來不 is for habits and does not take 過.
Examples + 等等 closes a list that could go on: 舊書、舊衣服等等. 一些 would have to come before the nouns, and 還有 and 什麼 cannot end a list.
帶走 = take it away (out of the flat). 帶到 needs a place after it, and 帶完 and 帶起 do not fit.
要不是 + what really happened (the roommate was still waiting for the lift), then what would have happened otherwise (the sweater thrown out). 只要, 雖然 and 不管 do not fit.

text.traditional: 今年是我第一次去男朋友家過年。出發以前，我很緊張，不知道要帶什麼禮物。男朋友說帶什麼都無所謂，可是我媽媽說，最好帶一些橘子，因為橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。除夕晚上，他的爺爺、奶奶、哥哥、姐姐都在家。吃飯的時候，我不太敢說話，還差一點把碗掉到地上。奶奶煎的魚好吃極了，我吃了一塊又一塊，最後把魚都吃完了。這時候，大家都看著我。男朋友告訴我，年夜飯的魚不能吃完，要剩下一些，才會「年年有餘」。我的臉一下子就紅了。可是奶奶笑著說：「沒關係，明年妳再來，我煎兩條！」
text.simplified: 今年是我第一次去男朋友家过年。出发以前，我很紧张，不知道要带什么礼物。男朋友说带什么都无所谓，可是我妈妈说，最好带一些橘子，因为橘子有「大吉大利」的意思。除夕晚上，他的爷爷、奶奶、哥哥、姐姐都在家。吃饭的时候，我不太敢说话，还差一点把碗掉到地上。奶奶煎的鱼好吃极了，我吃了一块又一块，最后把鱼都吃完了。这时候，大家都看着我。男朋友告诉我，年夜饭的鱼不能吃完，要剩下一些，才会「年年有余」。我的脸一下子就红了。可是奶奶笑着说：「没关系，明年你再来，我煎两条！」
text.pinyin: Jīnnián shì wǒ dì yī cì qù nánpéngyǒu jiā guònián. Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, bù zhīdào yào dài shénme lǐwù. Nánpéngyǒu shuō dài shénme dōu wúsuǒwèi, kěshì wǒ māma shuō, zuìhǎo dài yìxiē júzi, yīnwèi júzi yǒu “dàjídàlì” de yìsi. Chúxī wǎnshàng, tā de yéye, nǎinai, gēge, jiějie dōu zài jiā. Chī fàn de shíhòu, wǒ bú tài gǎn shuōhuà, hái chà yìdiǎn bǎ wǎn diào dào dì shàng. Nǎinai jiān de yú hǎochī jí le, wǒ chī le yí kuài yòu yí kuài, zuìhòu bǎ yú dōu chī wán le. Zhè shíhòu, dàjiā dōu kànzhe wǒ. Nánpéngyǒu gàosu wǒ, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī wán, yào shèngxià yìxiē, cái huì “niánnián yǒuyú”. Wǒ de liǎn yíxiàzi jiù hóng le. Kěshì nǎinai xiàozhe shuō: “Méiguānxi, míngnián nǐ zài lái, wǒ jiān liǎng tiáo!”
text.english: This year was the first time I spent New Year at my boyfriend's home. Before we set off I was nervous and didn't know what to bring as a gift. My boyfriend said anything would do, but my mother said tangerines were best, because they mean 'great luck and fortune'. On New Year's Eve his grandparents, brother and sister were all at home. At dinner I hardly dared to talk, and I almost dropped my bowl on the floor. Grandma's fried fish was delicious; I ate piece after piece until I had finished the whole fish. Just then, everyone looked at me. My boyfriend told me the fish at New Year's Eve dinner mustn't be finished: some has to be left over for 'plenty every year'. My face went red at once. But Grandma laughed: 'Never mind. Come again next year and I'll fry two!'

text.traditional: 元宵節那天晚上，我帶妹妹去看燈會。我們本來想坐公車，可是來了三班都坐滿了，只好坐捷運去。燈會熱鬧極了，有很多畫著十二生肖的燈籠。妹妹屬虎，她說報紙上有一個很大的老虎燈籠，一定要去看。可是我們找了一個多小時都沒找到，後來問了工作人員才知道，那個燈籠壞了，下午就讓人搬走了。妹妹很難過，我只好買了一個小老虎燈籠送她。她說她從來沒收過這麼可愛的禮物，一下子就笑了。
text.simplified: 元宵节那天晚上，我带妹妹去看灯会。我们本来想坐公车，可是来了三班都坐满了，只好坐捷运去。灯会热闹极了，有很多画着十二生肖的灯笼。妹妹属虎，她说报纸上有一个很大的老虎灯笼，一定要去看。可是我们找了一个多小时都没找到，后来问了工作人员才知道，那个灯笼坏了，下午就让人搬走了。妹妹很难过，我只好买了一个小老虎灯笼送她。她说她从来没收过这么可爱的礼物，一下子就笑了。
text.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ dài mèimei qù kàn dēnghuì. Wǒmen běnlái xiǎng zuò gōngchē, kěshì lái le sān bān dōu zuò mǎn le, zhǐhǎo zuò jiéyùn qù. Dēnghuì rènao jí le, yǒu hěn duō huàzhe shí'èr shēngxiào de dēnglóng. Mèimei shǔ hǔ, tā shuō bàozhǐ shàng yǒu yí ge hěn dà de lǎohǔ dēnglóng, yídìng yào qù kàn. Kěshì wǒmen zhǎo le yí ge duō xiǎoshí dōu méi zhǎo dào, hòulái wèn le gōngzuò rényuán cái zhīdào, nàge dēnglóng huài le, xiàwǔ jiù ràng rén bān zǒu le. Mèimei hěn nánguò, wǒ zhǐhǎo mǎi le yí ge xiǎo lǎohǔ dēnglóng sòng tā. Tā shuō tā cónglái méi shōu guo zhème kě'ài de lǐwù, yíxiàzi jiù xiào le.
text.english: On the evening of the Lantern Festival I took my little sister to the lantern show. We meant to take the bus, but three came and all were full, so we had to take the MRT. The show was very lively, with lots of lanterns painted with the twelve zodiac animals. My sister was born in the year of the tiger, and she said the newspaper mentioned a huge tiger lantern she had to see. But we searched for over an hour without finding it. Then we asked the staff and learned that the lantern had broken and had been taken away that afternoon. My sister was very sad, so I bought her a little tiger lantern. She said she had never received such a cute present, and at once she was smiling.

choices.english: She found the big tiger lantern.
She was given a little lantern.

choices.pinyin: Kàn dào hěn duō shēngxiào dēnglóng.
choices.english: She saw lots of zodiac lanterns.
The staff gave her a present.

questions.why: She smiled after receiving the little tiger lantern bought for her (從來沒收過這麼可愛的禮物). They never found the big one, and the staff only explained what had happened to it.

text.traditional: 很多同學參加社團是為了交朋友，我參加吉他社，是因為我從小就對音樂很感興趣。社員每個星期三晚上一起練習，有時候也去安養院表演，陪老人聊天。去年，吉他社的老師退休了，大家都希望我來免費教新社員。我一開始不想答應，因為除了上課，我還在咖啡店打工，每天都很忙。後來我想，教別人能讓我學到很多，對將來找工作也有好處，就答應了。從那時候起，我每個星期就得多花六個小時準備，忙得不得了。雖然很累，可是我學到了很多在課堂上學不到的東西。
text.simplified: 很多同学参加社团是为了交朋友，我参加吉他社，是因为我从小就对音乐很感兴趣。社员每个星期三晚上一起练习，有时候也去安养院表演，陪老人聊天。去年，吉他社的老师退休了，大家都希望我来免费教新社员。我一开始不想答应，因为除了上课，我还在咖啡店打工，每天都很忙。后来我想，教别人能让我学到很多，对将来找工作也有好处，就答应了。从那时候起，我每个星期就得多花六个小时准备，忙得不得了。虽然很累，可是我学到了很多在课堂上学不到的东西。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō tóngxué cānjiā shètuán shì wèile jiāo péngyǒu, wǒ cānjiā jítā shè, shì yīnwèi wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù duì yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù. Shèyuán měi ge xīngqísān wǎnshàng yìqǐ liànxí, yǒu shíhòu yě qù ānyǎngyuàn biǎoyǎn, péi lǎorén liáotiān. Qùnián, jítā shè de lǎoshī tuìxiū le, dàjiā dōu xīwàng wǒ lái miǎnfèi jiāo xīn shèyuán. Wǒ yìkāishǐ bù xiǎng dāyìng, yīnwèi chúle shàngkè, wǒ hái zài kāfēi diàn dǎgōng, měi tiān dōu hěn máng. Hòulái wǒ xiǎng, jiāo biérén néng ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō, duì jiānglái zhǎo gōngzuò yě yǒu hǎochù, jiù dāyìng le. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ měi ge xīngqí jiù děi duō huā liù ge xiǎoshí zhǔnbèi, máng de bùdéliǎo. Suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì wǒ xué dào le hěn duō zài kètáng shàng xué bú dào de dōngxi.
text.english: Many students join clubs to make friends; I joined the guitar club because I've loved music since I was little. The members practise together every Wednesday evening and sometimes play at a nursing home and chat with the old people there. Last year the club's teacher retired, and everyone hoped I would teach the new members for free. At first I didn't want to agree, because besides classes I work part-time at a café and am busy every day. Then I thought that teaching others would teach me a lot and would also help me find a job later, so I agreed. Since then I have had to spend six more hours a week preparing, and I'm incredibly busy. It's tiring, but I've learned a lot that you can't learn in class.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人為什麼參加吉他社？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人为什么参加吉他社？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén wèishénme cānjiā jítā shè?
prompt.english: Why did the writer join the guitar club?

choices.english: The writer has always loved music.
To learn how to teach others.
To play at a nursing home.

questions.why: 從小就對音樂很感興趣: music has interested the writer since childhood. Making friends is why many other students join clubs, and the nursing-home shows and the teaching came with the club.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人後來為什麼答應了？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人后来为什么答应了？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén hòulái wèishénme dāyìng le?
prompt.english: Why did the writer agree in the end?

choices.pinyin: Kāfēi diàn de gōngzuò bù máng le.
choices.english: The café job was no longer busy.
Teaching guitar is easier than the part-time job.
It would let the writer save more money.

choices.pinyin: Duì yǐhòu zhǎo gōngzuò yǒu bāngzhù.
choices.english: It will help in finding a job later.

questions.why: 對將來找工作也有好處: teaching would teach the writer a lot and help with a job later. The teaching is unpaid (免費), nothing says the café got less busy, and it made the writer busier.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人從什麼時候起教新社員？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人从什么时候起教新社员？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén cóng shénme shíhòu qǐ jiāo xīn shèyuán?
prompt.english: Since when has the writer been teaching the new members?

questions.why: 去年…老師退休了 … 從那時候起: the writer began teaching after the club teacher retired last year. Childhood is when the love of music began, university is when the writer joined, and Wednesday evenings are practice.

text.traditional: 上個月，我跟一位室友一起在學校附近租了一間公寓。房租一個月一萬，我的房間比較大，付六千。水費包括在房租裡，電費我們自己付。我的室友什麼都好，房租從來不晚付，晚上也很安靜，就是不愛做家事。她常常把髒衣服丟在地上，好幾天都不洗，有時候還有蟲子。我們討論了很久，最後決定：我負責洗碗、倒垃圾，她負責掃地、洗衣服。不管是誰沒做好，都要請客。上個星期，我忘了倒垃圾，房間裡臭死了，只好請她吃牛排。
text.simplified: 上个月，我跟一位室友一起在学校附近租了一间公寓。房租一个月一万，我的房间比较大，付六千。水费包括在房租里，电费我们自己付。我的室友什么都好，房租从来不晚付，晚上也很安静，就是不爱做家事。她常常把脏衣服丢在地上，好几天都不洗，有时候还有虫子。我们讨论了很久，最后决定：我负责洗碗、倒垃圾，她负责扫地、洗衣服。不管是谁没做好，都要请客。上个星期，我忘了倒垃圾，房间里臭死了，只好请她吃牛排。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ gēn yí wèi shìyǒu yìqǐ zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū le yì jiān gōngyù. Fángzū yí ge yuè yí wàn, wǒ de fángjiān bǐjiào dà, fù liùqiān. Shuǐfèi bāokuò zài fángzū lǐ, diànfèi wǒmen zìjǐ fù. Wǒ de shìyǒu shénme dōu hǎo, fángzū cónglái bù wǎn fù, wǎnshàng yě hěn ānjìng, jiù shì bú ài zuò jiāshì. Tā chángcháng bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài dì shàng, hǎojǐ tiān dōu bù xǐ, yǒu shíhòu hái yǒu chóngzi. Wǒmen tǎolùn le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu juédìng: wǒ fùzé xǐ wǎn, dào lèsè, tā fùzé sǎodì, xǐ yīfu. Bùguǎn shì shéi méi zuò hǎo, dōu yào qǐngkè. Shàng ge xīngqí, wǒ wàng le dào lèsè, fángjiān lǐ chòu sǐ le, zhǐhǎo qǐng tā chī niúpái.
text.english: Last month a roommate and I rented a flat together near school. The rent is 10,000 a month; my room is bigger, so I pay 6,000. Water is included in the rent, and we pay for electricity ourselves. My roommate is great in every way: she never pays her rent late and she's quiet at night. She just doesn't like housework. She often drops her dirty clothes on the floor and leaves them unwashed for days, and sometimes there are bugs. We talked it over for a long time and finally decided: I wash the dishes and take out the rubbish, and she sweeps the floor and does the laundry. Whoever doesn't do their job has to treat the other to a meal. Last week I forgot to take out the rubbish, it stank in the room, and I had to treat her to a steak.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人每個月付多少房租？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人每个月付多少房租？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén měi ge yuè fù duōshǎo fángzū?
prompt.english: How much rent does the writer pay a month?

questions.why: The rent is 10,000 a month, but the writer has the bigger room and pays 6,000; the roommate pays 4,000, so it is not split in half. Water is included; electricity is paid separately.

prompt.traditional: 室友有什麼不好的習慣？
prompt.simplified: 室友有什么不好的习惯？
prompt.pinyin: Shìyǒu yǒu shénme bù hǎo de xíguàn?
prompt.english: What bad habit does the roommate have?

choices.english: She is often noisy at night.
She often pays the rent late.
She leaves dirty clothes lying around.
She often forgets to take out the rubbish.

questions.why: 常常把髒衣服丟在地上，好幾天都不洗: she drops dirty clothes on the floor and leaves them for days. She is quiet at night and never pays late, and the rubbish is the writer's job (the writer forgot it once).

prompt.traditional: 要是室友忘了掃地，會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 要是室友忘了扫地，会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yàoshì shìyǒu wàng le sǎodì, huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What happens if the roommate forgets to sweep the floor?

choices.english: She has to pay more rent.
She has to take out the rubbish.
She has to treat the writer to a meal.
She has to pay more of the electricity.

questions.why: 不管是誰沒做好，都要請客: whoever skips a chore pays for a meal, the roommate included. Last week the rule caught the writer, who forgot the rubbish and paid for the steak.

picture.alt: A sunny riverbank under a willow tree. An old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot, in a mustard-yellow robe, sits on a low stone wall with one hand on his chin, smiling and listening. A young man in a dark teal robe leans in behind him. On the left a child in a blue robe, hair in a bun with a red ribbon, talks with both hands open; on the right a child in a rust-red robe stands talking and points up at the bright sun in the top right corner. Behind them a grey stone arch bridge crosses the river, and a small covered wooden boat is tied to a post in the water near the bridge, with nobody on it.

prompt.traditional: 這位老先生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这位老先生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo xiānshēng zài zuò shénme?

choices.pinyin: Tā zuò zài qiáo pángbiān de chuán shàng xiūxí.

choices.speaker: N

picture.alt: Inside an old hall with red pillars, open to a courtyard with grey tiled roofs; the leaves of a big green tree fill the top of the picture. At the left end of a long dark wooden table sits an old man with a long grey beard and grey hair in a topknot tied with a blue ribbon, in a mustard-yellow robe; he smiles and talks with both hands open towards the others, looking at them, not at the table. An unrolled bamboo scroll lies on the table; nobody is reading it, holding a brush or writing. Facing him at the table sit three listeners, each with a hand at the chin: a man with a black beard in a teal robe, a smiling child in a brown robe, and a young woman with long black hair in a pink robe.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: The old man talks to the three people at the table with his hands open. Nobody is reading or writing: the bamboo scroll just lies open on the table while everyone looks at him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個週末去山上玩，好玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去山上玩，好玩吗？

lines.english: You went to the mountains last weekend. Was it fun?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好玩啊！我以為那兩天會下雨，還帶了一件雨衣，誰知道兩天都是大晴天。
lines.simplified: 好玩啊！我以为那两天会下雨，还带了一件雨衣，谁知道两天都是大晴天。
lines.pinyin: Hǎowán a! Wǒ yǐwéi nà liǎng tiān huì xià yǔ, hái dài le yí jiàn yǔyī, shéi zhīdào liǎng tiān dōu shì dà qíngtiān.
lines.english: It was! I thought it would rain those two days and even took a raincoat. Who knew both days would be bright and sunny.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你的雨衣不是白帶了嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你的雨衣不是白带了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ de yǔyī bú shì bái dài le ma?
lines.english: So you took the raincoat for nothing?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，一直放在背包裡，一次都沒穿。
lines.simplified: 对啊，一直放在背包里，一次都没穿。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, yìzhí fàng zài bēibāo lǐ, yí cì dōu méi chuān.
lines.english: Yes. It stayed in my backpack; I didn't wear it once.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的這次去山上，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 男的这次去山上，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zhè cì qù shān shàng, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: It didn't rain in the mountains those two days.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He wore his raincoat the whole time.

questions.why: 誰知道 brings in the surprise: he expected rain, but both days were sunny (大晴天), so no rain fell. He enjoyed the trip (好玩啊), and he did take the raincoat, but it stayed in his backpack (白帶了, taken for nothing).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳兒子今天第一天上小學，他哭了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你儿子今天第一天上小学，他哭了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ érzi jīntiān dì yī tiān shàng xiǎoxué, tā kū le ma?
lines.english: Your son started primary school today. Did he cry?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我以為他會一直哭，不讓我走，誰知道他一到學校就跟別的小朋友玩起來了。
lines.simplified: 我以为他会一直哭，不让我走，谁知道他一到学校就跟别的小朋友玩起来了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì yìzhí kū, bú ràng wǒ zǒu, shéi zhīdào tā yí dào xuéxiào jiù gēn bié de xiǎopéngyǒu wán qǐlái le.
lines.english: I thought he would cry the whole time and not let me go. Who knew that the moment he got to school he would start playing with the other children.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳可以放心了。
lines.simplified: 那你可以放心了。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ kěyǐ fàngxīn le.
lines.english: Then you can stop worrying.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是啊，他連看都沒看我一眼，我只好一個人回家了。
lines.simplified: 是啊，他连看都没看我一眼，我只好一个人回家了。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, tā lián kàn dōu méi kàn wǒ yì yǎn, wǒ zhǐhǎo yí ge rén huí jiā le.
lines.english: Yes. He didn't even glance at me, so I just went home on my own.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兒子到了學校以後，怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 儿子到了学校以后，怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Érzi dào le xuéxiào yǐhòu, zěnmeyàng?

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He smiled and said goodbye to his mother.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn kuài jiù gēn tóngxué wán le.
choices.english: He soon started playing with his classmates.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He went home with his mother.

questions.why: 誰知道 brings in what really happened: he started playing with the other children as soon as he arrived. Crying was only what his mother expected; he didn't even glance at her (連看都沒看我一眼), so there was no smiling goodbye, and she went home alone.

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 那他订好民宿了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā dìng hǎo mínsù le ma?

lines.pinyin: Hái méi, tā shuō dào le zài zhǎo. Tā shuō zǒu jiù zǒu, jīntiān zǎoshàng jiù yí ge rén zuò dì yī bān huǒchē qù le.
lines.english: Not yet; he says he'll find one when he gets there. He just upped and went: this morning he took the first train, on his own.

lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Wǒ bùguǎn qù nǎlǐ, dōu děi xiān jìhuà yì liǎng ge yuè.
lines.english: Lucky him! Wherever I go, I have to plan for a month or two first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 哥哥這次去花蓮，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥这次去花莲，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge zhè cì qù Huālián, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: About the brother's trip to Hualien, which is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He has already booked a B&B.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ qù de.

questions.why: 說走就走: he went as soon as he had said he would, with no planning. He saw the photos last night, hasn't booked anywhere to stay, and left alone on this morning's first train. The month or two of planning is the woman's own habit.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生要我多運動，我打算下個月開始，每天去操場慢跑。
lines.simplified: 医生要我多运动，我打算下个月开始，每天去操场慢跑。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng yào wǒ duō yùndòng, wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè kāishǐ, měi tiān qù cāochǎng mànpǎo.
lines.english: The doctor wants me to exercise more. I plan to start next month, jogging at the sports field every day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 為什麼要等到下個月？明天早上我陪你去吧！
lines.simplified: 为什么要等到下个月？明天早上我陪你去吧！
lines.pinyin: Wèishénme yào děng dào xià ge yuè? Míngtiān zǎoshàng wǒ péi nǐ qù ba!
lines.english: Why wait until next month? I'll go with you tomorrow morning!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天早上我有課。那這個週末好不好？
lines.simplified: 明天早上我有课。那这个周末好不好？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshàng wǒ yǒu kè. Nà zhège zhōumò hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: I have class tomorrow morning. How about this weekend?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不好。運動要說做就做。你的運動服呢？
lines.simplified: 不好。运动要说做就做。你的运动服呢？
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎo. Yùndòng yào shuō zuò jiù zuò. Nǐ de yùndòngfú ne?
lines.english: No. With exercise, you do it the moment you say it. Where are your sports clothes?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，我去換。
lines.simplified: 好吧，我去换。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, wǒ qù huàn.
lines.english: All right, I'll go and change.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們什麼時候去慢跑？
prompt.simplified: 他们什么时候去慢跑？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen shénme shíhòu qù mànpǎo?
prompt.english: When are they going jogging?

questions.why: 說做就做 means doing it the moment you decide. She turns down next month and the weekend, he has class tomorrow morning, and she sends him to change: they go today.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳買到演唱會的票了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你买到演唱会的票了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ mǎi dào yǎnchànghuì de piào le ma?
lines.english: Did you get the concert tickets?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 買到了！網路上八點開始賣，我八點一分上網的時候，只剩下兩張，差一點就買不到了。
lines.simplified: 买到了！网路上八点开始卖，我八点一分上网的时候，只剩下两张，差一点就买不到了。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi dào le! Wǎnglù shàng bā diǎn kāishǐ mài, wǒ bā diǎn yì fēn shàngwǎng de shíhòu, zhǐ shèngxià liǎng zhāng, chà yìdiǎn jiù mǎi bú dào le.
lines.english: I got them! They went on sale online at eight. When I went online at one minute past, only two were left. I almost didn't get any.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了！那我的呢？
lines.simplified: 太好了！那我的呢？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nà wǒ de ne?
lines.english: Great! And mine?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對不起，我只買到我自己和我妹妹的。
lines.simplified: 对不起，我只买到我自己和我妹妹的。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ zhǐ mǎi dào wǒ zìjǐ hé wǒ mèimei de.
lines.english: Sorry, I only got mine and my sister's.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這次買演唱會的票，哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 这次买演唱会的票，哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì mǎi yǎnchànghuì de piào, nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: About buying the concert tickets, which is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de méiyǒu mǎi dào piào.
choices.english: The woman didn't get any tickets.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de yě yǒu yì zhāng.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bā diǎn yǐqián jiù mài wán le.

questions.why: 差一點就買不到了 means she almost missed out, so she did get them: the last two, for herself and her sister. There is none for the man, and at one minute past eight two were still left.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日，你準備禮物了嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日，你准备礼物了吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān shì māma de shēngrì, nǐ zhǔnbèi lǐwù le ma?
lines.english: Tomorrow is Mom's birthday. Have you got her a present?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 啊！要不是妳說，我就忘了。我下課就去買。
lines.simplified: 啊！要不是你说，我就忘了。我下课就去买。
lines.pinyin: A! Yàobúshì nǐ shuō, wǒ jiù wàng le. Wǒ xiàkè jiù qù mǎi.
lines.english: Oh! If you hadn't said so, I'd have forgotten. I'll go and buy something after class.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我已經買了一束花，你買個蛋糕吧。
lines.simplified: 我已经买了一束花，你买个蛋糕吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng mǎi le yí shù huā, nǐ mǎi ge dàngāo ba.
lines.english: I've already bought a bunch of flowers. You get a cake.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，我去買她最喜歡的巧克力蛋糕。
lines.simplified: 好，我去买她最喜欢的巧克力蛋糕。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ qù mǎi tā zuì xǐhuān de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
lines.english: OK, I'll get her favourite chocolate cake.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He already has a present ready.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā chàdiǎn wàng le zhè jiàn shì.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào qù mǎi yí shù huā.
choices.english: He is going to buy flowers.

questions.why: 要不是妳說，我就忘了: if she hadn't mentioned it, he would have forgotten, so he almost forgot. He had nothing ready yet, the flowers are hers, and he will buy the cake after class.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你可來了！我在老師家樓下等了你快半個小時。
lines.simplified: 你可来了！我在老师家楼下等了你快半个小时。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kě lái le! Wǒ zài lǎoshī jiā lóuxià děng le nǐ kuài bàn ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: There you are at last! I've been waiting for you outside the teacher's building for almost half an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對不起，今天教師節放假，路上的車多得不得了。
lines.simplified: 对不起，今天教师节放假，路上的车多得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, jīntiān Jiàoshījié fàngjià, lù shàng de chē duō de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Sorry. It's the Teachers' Day holiday, and the traffic was terrible.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒關係。你給老師買了什麼？我寫了一張卡片，還買了一盒餅乾。
lines.simplified: 没关系。你给老师买了什么？我写了一张卡片，还买了一盒饼干。
lines.pinyin: Méiguānxi. Nǐ gěi lǎoshī mǎi le shénme? Wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yì hé bǐnggān.
lines.english: Never mind. What did you get the teacher? I wrote a card and bought a box of cookies.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來想買一束花，後來想起來老師最喜歡喝茶，就買了一盒茶。
lines.simplified: 我本来想买一束花，后来想起来老师最喜欢喝茶，就买了一盒茶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng mǎi yí shù huā, hòulái xiǎng qǐlái lǎoshī zuì xǐhuān hē chá, jiù mǎi le yì hé chá.
lines.english: I was going to buy flowers, but then I remembered she loves tea most, so I bought a box of tea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你可真了解老師！我們上去吧。
lines.simplified: 你可真了解老师！我们上去吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kě zhēn liǎojiě lǎoshī! Wǒmen shàngqù ba.
lines.english: You really know her! Let's go up.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「你可來了」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「你可来了」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō “nǐ kě lái le”, shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by “你可來了”?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā děng le nán de hěn jiǔ.
choices.english: She has waited a long time for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài kěyǐ lái le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de lái de tài zǎo le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā gāng dào lǎoshī jiā lóuxià.
choices.english: She has only just arrived outside.

questions.why: 你可來了 is relief after a long wait: here you are at last. She has waited almost half an hour, so he isn't early and she didn't just arrive; this 可 is emphasis, not 可以.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的給老師買了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的给老师买了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de gěi lǎoshī mǎi le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the man buy for the teacher?

questions.why: 本來想買一束花，後來想起來老師最喜歡喝茶: he remembered she loves tea and bought that instead of flowers. The card and the cookies are the woman's gifts.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳下個月要搬到台南去了，是真的嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你下个月要搬到台南去了，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ xià ge yuè yào bān dào Táinán qù le, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: I hear you're moving to Tainan next month. Is that true?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 誰說的？我可沒說要搬家。我只是說下個月要去台南住兩個星期。
lines.simplified: 谁说的？我可没说要搬家。我只是说下个月要去台南住两个星期。
lines.pinyin: Shéi shuō de? Wǒ kě méi shuō yào bānjiā. Wǒ zhǐshì shuō xià ge yuè yào qù Táinán zhù liǎng ge xīngqí.
lines.english: Who said that? I never said I was moving. I only said I'm going to stay in Tainan for two weeks next month.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去玩嗎？
lines.simplified: 去玩吗？
lines.pinyin: Qù wán ma?
lines.english: On holiday?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不是。教授要帶我們去看那裡的孔廟和老房子，了解古代的教育，還要去一所小學，看看現在的學生怎麼上課。回來以後，每個人都得交一篇報告。
lines.simplified: 不是。教授要带我们去看那里的孔庙和老房子，了解古代的教育，还要去一所小学，看看现在的学生怎么上课。回来以后，每个人都得交一篇报告。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì. Jiàoshòu yào dài wǒmen qù kàn nàlǐ de Kǒngmiào hé lǎo fángzi, liǎojiě gǔdài de jiàoyù, hái yào qù yì suǒ xiǎoxué, kànkàn xiànzài de xuéshēng zěnme shàngkè. Huílái yǐhòu, měi ge rén dōu děi jiāo yì piān bàogào.
lines.english: No. Our professor is taking us to see the Confucius Temple and the old houses there, to learn about education in ancient times, and to a primary school to see how pupils have class today. When we're back, everyone has to hand in a report.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽起來很有意思。不過台南現在很熱吧？
lines.simplified: 听起来很有意思。不过台南现在很热吧？
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái hěn yǒu yìsi. Búguò Táinán xiànzài hěn rè ba?
lines.english: Sounds interesting. But Tainan must be hot now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，聽說每天都有三十四度。
lines.simplified: 对，听说每天都有三十四度。
lines.pinyin: Duì, tīngshuō měi tiān dōu yǒu sānshísì dù.
lines.english: Yes, I hear it's thirty-four degrees every day.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: She has no plan to move.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào qù Táinán wán liǎng ge xīngqí.
choices.english: She is going to Tainan on holiday for two weeks.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào zài Táinán zhù yí ge yuè.
choices.english: She will stay in Tainan for a month.

questions.why: 我可沒說要搬家: 可 + 沒 firmly denies the rumour. She is only staying in Tainan for two weeks, and for a class trip, not a holiday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這次去台南，學生要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这次去台南，学生要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Táinán, xuéshēng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the students do on this trip to Tainan?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Teach children at a primary school.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù kàn Táinán de xīn fángzi.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān xiě yì piān bàogào.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Learn about education in the past.

questions.why: They visit the Confucius Temple and old houses to learn about education in ancient times (了解古代的教育). At the primary school they only watch a class, the houses are old, and there is one report after the trip, not one a day.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大家好，歡迎坐我們的船。我們會先往東開，經過一個小公園，再從那座橋下面過去。
lines.simplified: 大家好，欢迎坐我们的船。我们会先往东开，经过一个小公园，再从那座桥下面过去。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng zuò wǒmen de chuán. Wǒmen huì xiān wǎng dōng kāi, jīngguò yí ge xiǎo gōngyuán, zài cóng nà zuò qiáo xiàmiàn guòqù.
lines.english: Hello everyone, and welcome aboard. We'll head east first, past a small park, and then go under that bridge.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十點半，船會在一座老廟旁邊停下來，大家可以下船走一走、照照相。
lines.simplified: 十点半，船会在一座老庙旁边停下来，大家可以下船走一走、照照相。
lines.pinyin: Shí diǎn bàn, chuán huì zài yí zuò lǎo miào pángbiān tíng xiàlái, dàjiā kěyǐ xià chuán zǒu yì zǒu, zhào zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: At half past ten the boat will stop beside an old temple, and you can get off for a walk and some photos.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 廟裡有很多大樹，比較涼快，不過風很大，最好帶一件外套。
lines.simplified: 庙里有很多大树，比较凉快，不过风很大，最好带一件外套。
lines.pinyin: Miào lǐ yǒu hěn duō dà shù, bǐjiào liángkuài, búguò fēng hěn dà, zuìhǎo dài yí jiàn wàitào.
lines.english: There are lots of big trees in the temple grounds, so it's cooler, but it's windy, so you'd better take a jacket.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十一點我們必須準時開船，所以請大家在十點五十分以前回到船上。
lines.simplified: 十一点我们必须准时开船，所以请大家在十点五十分以前回到船上。
lines.pinyin: Shíyī diǎn wǒmen bìxū zhǔnshí kāi chuán, suǒyǐ qǐng dàjiā zài shí diǎn wǔshí fēn yǐqián huí dào chuán shàng.
lines.english: We must leave at eleven sharp, so please be back on board before ten fifty.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 船會在哪裡停下來？
prompt.simplified: 船会在哪里停下来？
prompt.pinyin: Chuán huì zài nǎlǐ tíng xiàlái?
prompt.english: Where will the boat stop?

questions.why: 停下來 is where the boat comes to a stop: beside the old temple at half past ten. It only passes the park and goes under the bridge, and the big trees are in the temple grounds.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 大家下船以後，有多少時間走走？
prompt.simplified: 大家下船以后，有多少时间走走？
prompt.pinyin: Dàjiā xià chuán yǐhòu, yǒu duōshǎo shíjiān zǒuzǒu?
prompt.english: Once off the boat, how long do people have to walk around?

questions.why: The boat stops at 10:30 and everyone must be back on board before 10:50: twenty minutes. Half an hour runs to the 11:00 departure, which is the boat's time, not the visitors'.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a self-introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，我是這學期教你們會話課的老師。我是美國人，十年前來台灣學過一年中文。
lines.simplified: 大家好，我是这学期教你们会话课的老师。我是美国人，十年前来台湾学过一年中文。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, wǒ shì zhè xuéqí jiāo nǐmen huìhuà kè de lǎoshī. Wǒ shì Měiguó rén, shí nián qián lái Táiwān xué guo yì nián Zhōngwén.
lines.english: Hello everyone. I'm your conversation teacher this semester. I'm American, and ten years ago I came to Taiwan to study Chinese for a year.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那時候我本來打算學完就回美國，誰知道我愛上了這裡的生活，就留下來了。
lines.simplified: 那时候我本来打算学完就回美国，谁知道我爱上了这里的生活，就留下来了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shíhòu wǒ běnlái dǎsuàn xué wán jiù huí Měiguó, shéi zhīdào wǒ ài shàng le zhèlǐ de shēnghuó, jiù liú xiàlái le.
lines.english: Back then I planned to go home to America as soon as I finished, but I fell in love with life here and stayed on.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我先在一家貿易公司工作了三年，後來發現自己最喜歡的還是教書，就來學校當老師了。
lines.simplified: 我先在一家贸易公司工作了三年，后来发现自己最喜欢的还是教书，就来学校当老师了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zài yì jiā màoyì gōngsī gōngzuò le sān nián, hòulái fāxiàn zìjǐ zuì xǐhuān de háishì jiāoshū, jiù lái xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī le.
lines.english: First I worked at a trading company for three years; later I found that what I liked best was teaching, so I came to the school as a teacher.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上課的時候，我只說中文。你們不能只聽不說，有任何問題都要馬上問我。
